Kael grabbed the Ember Vanguard spear with both hands.
The flames around the weapon became more dense.
It was time for him to intervene personally and remove the biggest threat.

chapters.title: Chapter 307: Battle With The Cindari Army III
paragraphs: Kael already knew that Lian was powerful, he had realized this the first time he saw him at the border entrance.
And even in their short previous battle, which had happened only a few hours ago, he had become even more certain of it.
But now he realized that all this time, no matter how much he thought he was giving Lian enough importance, he had actually been underestimating him.
The human he was looking at was so dangerous and powerful that he could change the entire direction of this battle by himself, and that was very dangerous.

It was a shame, he did not want to destroy this young human, but he had no choice, he had to kill Lian today, right now! Otherwise, he would become a variable that could put their entire civilization at risk.
Mana came out of his armor and moved into the tip of the spear.
The ground under his feet cracked, he suddenly jumped through the line of soldiers, and his height went higher than the short towers of the bridge.
He pulled the spear back.
[Ember Vanguard Art: Falling Sun Spear.]
A huge ball of fire formed around the weapon, its heat even reached the Ashfall battlefield from a distance.
The spear was thrown down from above toward Lian like a small sun, and the soldiers near its path moved away.
The impact of this attack could destroy a large part of the bridge and burn everyone around it.
Predator’s Instincts gave a clearer warning, the danger was real, but it was not deadly, at least not for the young Vorhelm.
Lian raised his head and smiled, was he going to retreat? Was he going to dodge? No, no, no.
Neither of them was insulting enough to the enemy.
He opened both of his hands. This time, Thunder Calamity gathered around both of his arms, and lightning wrapped around his shoulders and elbows like huge snakes.
The spear came closer, the air in front of it burned, and then he grabbed the shaft of the spear.
An explosion of fire and lightning covered the entire battlefield in white, and the pressure wave pushed the nearby soldiers several steps back.
The floor of the bridge broke under Lian’s feet, large cracks spread in several directions, and flames covered his entire body.
But Diamond Skin was active, the heat burned his skin and parts of his clothes turned to ash, but it could not force his hands away from the shaft.
Lian was pushed back only a few centimeters.
Kael was still holding the other end of the weapon, and his eyes opened wider in disbelief.
He had put all his weight, the speed of the fall, and his Mana into that attack.
But the human had caught it with his hands... how was this possible? He had not even suffered any real damage!
«Is this all your power?» Lian looked at him through the flames.
Kael clenched his teeth, when had he ever suffered such humiliation in his life? And against a human!?
He put more Mana into the spear, and the flames became stronger.
Lian released Thunder Calamity through the shaft, and the lightning entered the Ember Vanguard Spear through his hands.
In an instant, it traveled through the entire length of the weapon and reached Kael’s hands.
The border commander let out a muffled scream, the muscles in his arms tightened, and to prevent his arms from becoming completely paralyzed, he was forced to let go of the spear.
His body turned in the air and landed several meters away.
Lian threw the spear to the side, the weapon hit the stone floor and created a long crack.
But the commander did not retreat even without his weapon, flames formed around his fists and body.
"Die, you savage human!" He attacked Lian with an angry shout, his first punch came toward Lian’s face.
Predator’s Instincts sensed the direction of the danger before Kael’s shoulder had even fully moved.
Lian moved his head to the side, the flaming fist passed in front of his face, the heat burned his cheek, but the punch did not hit its target.
The young Vorhelm punched Kael in the stomach, he did not use any Skill, only his raw Body Strength of 760.
Kael’s armor was pushed inward, his eyes opened wide and the air left his lungs, his body left the ground and was thrown several meters back.
Even so, he turned in the air and landed on his feet, two deep lines appeared under his boots on the stone floor.
Kael wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his pride did not allow him to accept the difference in power.
No matter what it took, he had to kill this human today!
[Ember Vanguard: Burning Legion Step.]
Several flame images separated from his body, six Kaels attacked Lian from six different directions.
Every image had the heat, shape, and movement of the real one, they were not simple illusions.
Their fists, feet, and flaming weapons came closer at the same time.
True Sequence activated for a moment.
Lian watched the first exchange, one of the images passed through the chain around his arm, the second image created no weight or pressure when it hit the stone.
That was enough.
Predator’s Instincts was also giving a warning only from the left side.
He ignored the other images, moved his hand directly toward the left, and closed his fingers through the flames.
The real Kael’s throat was caught in his hand, and the other images shook at the same moment.
The commander’s eyes opened wider, Lian lifted him from the ground and slammed him directly onto the bridge.
The stone floor cracked under his body, and the shockwave put out the flames around him.
Before Kael could stand up, the young Vorhelm activated Thunder Step, a blue light appeared for a moment.
Lian appeared directly in front of him.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice formed around his right hand, his fingers turned into a long white claw.
A deep cold spread across the battlefield, and steam rose from the hot stones.
Kael reached his hand toward the Ember Vanguard Spear.
The weapon shook on the ground, its flames lit up again, and it quickly flew back toward its owner.
But Lian was faster. Glacial Reaper Claw landed on the shaft of the spear, at the same moment, ice spread from the point of contact.
The Ember flames burned harder to resist, red and white fought against each other on the weapon for a moment.
But Kael’s power was not enough to resist a Divine Skill.
The flames went out one after another, and ice covered the entire shaft, the blade, and the marks on the weapon.
The Ember Vanguard Spear became a frozen statue.
Kael was still reaching his hand toward the weapon, and Lian slightly pressed his claw fingers.
The sound of breaking ice and metal spread across the battlefield.
The spear broke in the middle, and the two frozen pieces fell to the ground.
All the Cindari soldiers saw the scene, the weapon that was the symbol of the Vhalaris border commander, the spear that had defended the borders of Emberroot for years.
It had broken between Lian’s fingers.
"How is this possible? My precious weapon...?" Kael whispered with hatred and disbelief, he could barely control the anger he was holding inside.
Every moment, he felt like he was about to explode from anger.
The army’s morale broke at that exact moment.
«I told you to return to the border.» Lian lowered the cold from his claw.
Kael’s face twisted with anger, he released all the Mana he had left, flames came out of his armor and body.
"Even if it means my own death! You must die today, human!"
Fire formed a much larger armor around his body, a flaming figure several times larger than his real body.
[Ember Vanguard’s Last Stand.]
The heat of the battlefield suddenly increased, the Cindari commander screamed from inside the flaming armor and attacked Lian.
Every step he took melted the stone floor, the nearby soldiers moved away from his path, this was his final attack.
All of his power, Mana, and will were gathered into one collision.
Lian activated Iron Fortress Charge, gray pressure formed around his entire body.
Then he added Thunder Calamity to it, lightning moved from his legs to his shoulders and wrapped around his body.
He also moved forward, the two figures collided from the front, but there was no equality between them.
Kael’s flaming armor split from the center at the moment of impact, Iron Fortress Charge passed through it like a huge hammer.
The flames were thrown to both sides.
Lian reached Kael’s real body without stopping, pulled his right fist back, and gathered all of Thunder Calamity on his knuckles.
Then he struck the center of Kael’s chest, the sound of thunder spread across all of Vhalaris.
A wave of lightning and pressure came out from the back of the border commander’s body, and his battle armor was crushed from the center.
The metal plates broke, his body was thrown backward like a bullet, and he passed between two lines of soldiers.
Several people fell to the ground when he hit them, and Kael finally crashed into the wall of one of the guard towers.
Part of the wall collapsed, and stone, roots, and dust spread across the ground.
The commander’s body fell among the ruins, he did not move for several moments, then he placed his hand on the ground and tried to stand up.
Lightning was still moving through his muscles and nerves, his hand shook, his elbow bent, and he fell back to the ground, his legs also could not move.
This battle had been unfair and one-sided from the very beginning.
Lian walked toward him without hurry, the sound of his footsteps could be heard across the sudden silence of the bridge.
The Cindari soldiers opened a path, no one dared to stand in front of him, fear had reached their very bodies.
After seeing that battle, all their will to resist and fight against the humans disappeared... from their point of view, doing something like that was no different from suicide.
Lian reached Kael, placed his foot on his crushed chest armor, he did not put much pressure on it, but it was enough to stop him from trying to stand again.
«It’s over.»
Kael looked at him with blood on his lips and face, pride, anger, and disbelief could all be seen in his eyes.
Their battle had lasted only a few minutes.
Lian still had not used Warrior’s Madness.
He had not released even a small amount of Bloodborne Calamity Domain or Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.
All the power Kael had shown as his final resistance had not been enough to force Lian to use his main Skills.
The defeat of the border commander was clear to everyone, it had been a completely one-sided battle that left no room for doubt.
The Cindari soldiers stood still.
Some lowered their weapons, some stepped back several steps, and several smaller commanders tried to keep their lines together, but their voices no longer had the same power as before.
«Put your weapons on the ground!» Rindo shouted from inside the entrance of Ashfall, his voice was strengthened by Mana.
«Those who surrender will not be killed!»
Several Rootbound Wardens looked at Kael, their commander was lying under Lian’s foot and could not move.
The man who had been in control of the entire Rootspire bridge only a few hours ago was now lying on the ground without his weapon and with his armor broken.
Logic told them that they should surrender.
One of the middle-ranking officers raised his sword in anger.
«No retreat!»
The nearby soldiers hesitated, and the officer shouted.
«Kill all the Outsiders!»
The remaining archers on the eastern towers turned their weapons.
This time, they did not aim at Lian, the arrows were aimed toward the infirmary, the wounded, and the weaker Awakeners, they no longer had the courage to target that monster.
"If you don’t surrender right now, I promise you, I’ll build a mountain out of your corpses and fill every river in this city with your blood." Lian turned his head toward them and said coldly.

«It’s over.»
Kael looked at him with blood on his lips and face, pride, anger, and disbelief could all be seen in his eyes.
Their battle had lasted only a few minutes.
Lian still had not used Warrior’s Madness.
He had not released even a small amount of Bloodborne Calamity Domain or Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.
All the power Kael had shown as his final resistance had not been enough to force Lian to use his main Skills.
The defeat of the border commander was clear to everyone, it had been a completely one-sided battle that left no room for doubt.
The Cindari soldiers stood still.
Some lowered their weapons, some stepped back several steps, and several smaller commanders tried to keep their lines together, but their voices no longer had the same power as before.
«Put your weapons on the ground!» Rindo shouted from inside the entrance of Ashfall, his voice was strengthened by Mana.
«Those who surrender will not be killed!»
Several Rootbound Wardens looked at Kael, their commander was lying under Lian’s foot and could not move.
The man who had been in control of the entire Rootspire bridge only a few hours ago was now lying on the ground without his weapon and with his armor broken.
Logic told them that they should surrender.
One of the middle-ranking officers raised his sword in anger.
«No retreat!»
The nearby soldiers hesitated, and the officer shouted.
«Kill all the Outsiders!»
The remaining archers on the eastern towers turned their weapons.
This time, they did not aim at Lian, the arrows were aimed toward the infirmary, the wounded, and the weaker Awakeners, they no longer had the courage to target that monster.
"If you don’t surrender right now, I promise you, I’ll build a mountain out of your corpses and fill every river in this city with your blood." Lian turned his head toward them and said coldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 308: Battle With The Cindari Army IV
paragraphs: As Lian’s words echoed through the area, the air around them seemed to become colder, and the pressure suddenly became several times stronger.
It was not only the Cindari who were overwhelmed by fear, even the Awakeners trembled in fear for a moment after hearing those words.
Then they remembered that the person who had said those words was actually a human just like them, and was also on their side, which made them let out a sigh of relief.
But the Cindari were still trembling in fear, those words had entered their very being like a blade and made their entire minds shake.
All the motivation they had to fight was gone, they wanted to lower their weapons and surrender.
Did they even have a chance to win at this point? They were facing a monster they had no hope of defeating.
At best, if they surrendered now, they could at least keep their lives, but if they were stupid enough to continue fighting, they would lose even that.
The Cindari looked at each other and had already made their decision.
Lian looked at them, this was the last chance he was giving them.
He could open Bloodborne Calamity Domain, he could kill all the soldiers around him in a short time and end the resistance forever.
But his goal was to capture Ashfall, not massacre all the Cindari in the city.
He could see that they had decided to surrender, so now was the best time, he raised his right hand.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Mana and lightning gathered from his body and the space around him, no real cloud appeared.
The huge ceiling of Emberroot roots and the buildings of Vhalaris covered the sky.
But lightning did not need clouds to appear, blue and white branches came out from around Lian’s hand.
First one branch.
Then five.
Then dozens of strands of lightning spread above the bridge.
The Cindari officer still had not lowered his sword when Lian closed his fingers.
The lightning fell, each branch hit one of the bows, weapons, armor, or firing towers.
The bows exploded before they could be fired.
The arrows fell from the strings, some weapons were knocked out of their owners’ hands, the bodies of the archers shook under the pressure of the lightning and collapsed onto the platforms.
Several branches hit the bases of the towers and shut down the firing systems.
Lian had controlled the power of the attack, the lightning could have burned the hearts and brains of everyone on the towers in an instant.
But instead, it only stopped their nerves and muscles from working for a while, the commanding officer also screamed when the lightning hit his sword.
The weapon fell from his hand, he dropped to one knee and then fell unconscious onto the ground.
A heavy silence spread across the Cindari army.
First, one shield fell to the ground, then a spear was dropped, the sound of weapons hitting the stone floor continued one after another.
Some soldiers still wanted to resist, but when they saw their companions lowering their weapons, they also stepped back.
"We surrender! Please, have mercy on us!"
"We are ready to put down our weapons! Please, leave our people alone!"
The Awakeners came forward from inside Ashfall.
The Tanks and Warriors separated the prisoners.
The human archers were still ready on the rooftops to fire if the Cindari betrayed them.
Cassian ordered several groups to collect the soldiers’ seals, Potions, and weapons.
Marcus sent the defensive forces to both sides of the bridge.
«I told you beating them was better than running away.» Ethan moved through the prisoners with a big smile.
«It’s not over yet.» Rindo passed beside him.
The first encirclement army had almost been defeated, Kael had been captured, and two Ballistas had been destroyed.
The line of Rootbound Wardens had fallen apart, and most of the smaller officers had left the battlefield.
Ashfall was truly on the verge of becoming a fortress of the humans.
No one really thought everything would happen this quickly, everyone had expected longer conflicts, a bloodier battle with more casualties.
Especially the Awakeners, they had even expected that they might be the ones who lost in the end.
But the result was far beyond what any of them had expected, a complete victory without a single casualty on their side.
Perhaps the only person whose expression was not the same as usual at this moment was Seris, because she realized that the distance between her and her rival... was growing larger very quickly...
The Student Council President raised his hand to give the order to completely capture the bridges.

But before a single word could leave his mouth, the ground under everyone’s feet shook, it was not a vibration caused by an explosion, nor the collapse of a building, it was as if all of Vhalaris itself had reacted.
The red lines inside the walls, bridges, and towers went dark for a moment.
Then they returned with a golden light, the huge roots that the buildings and streets had been built on began to move.
The stone floor of the bridge moved up and down, the walls of Ashfall shook like parts of a living creature.
The wooden barriers moved aside, the defensive towers changed their angles.
The surrendered soldiers raised their heads, fear and despair on some of their faces turned into hope.
Kael gave a weak smile despite his blood and injuries.
Lian removed his foot from his chest.
Predator’s Instincts reacted.
This time, the warning was not short, a constant, heavy, and serious pressure spread through his entire body.
A danger approaching from the center of Vhalaris was different from every enemy he had seen until now.
Mana pressure spread from Rootspire, the golden roots of the city shone brighter with every step of that presence.
Tharos was stronger than Kael.
Kael was stronger than most of the commanders in the city.
But the power that was approaching now was on another level.
«Enough.» It was only one word, but the Cindari soldiers immediately lowered their heads.
Even the injured Rootbound Wardens tried to get down on one knee.
The remaining army lines on both sides of the main bridge moved aside, golden roots came out from under the stone floor.
They twisted around each other and formed living stairs in the center of the bridge.
Golden light moved between the roots, a man stepped onto the battlefield from inside that light and heat.
Maelor, the main Rootwarden of Vhalaris.
He was not wearing full battle armor.
A heavy black and gold cloak rested over his shoulders, and only a few metal plates covered parts of his chest and arms.
Even so, every step he took made the entire city react.
The roots opened a path for him, the light became brighter with his presence.
The air around him was heavy, not like Kael’s violent pressure, more like Vhalaris itself was present in the form of a person.
Maelor’s eyes first moved over the unconscious and captured soldiers, then stopped on the destroyed Ballistas and broken bridge.
Then he saw Kael, the border commander was lying among the ruins with his armor broken and his body paralyzed.
Finally, Maelor’s eyes stopped on Lian, there was no clear anger on his face and no surprise either, only a heavy calm that was more dangerous than any shout.
Lian gathered the remaining lightning around his fists again.
The defeat of Kael had only taken a few minutes, of course, he had expected this man to interfere and knew that he was the greatest threat.
After all, he was the only Level 30 creature present in this city, and he definitely had enough power that even Lian had to take him seriously.
"We accepted you as guests, and this is your answer?" Maelor said coldly, and he no longer had the kind expression he had before.

"Guests? Don’t you think that’s a stupid joke? Did you think we didn’t know your real goal? Did you think we didn’t know that you wanted to use us to find a way to escape to our world?" Lian also said with mockery.
At this point, there was no need to lie or hide the truth.
The city lord became silent, as if he had not expected the humans to know the truth...
"What? Don’t you have anything to say?"

"So you know the truth... then there is no need to hide it anymore... If you understand nothing about kindness, I will force you to tell me the way to your world with strength." Maelor added after a few moments of silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 309: Battle With The Cindari Army V
paragraphs: «It’s not too late, and I’ll give you one last chance.» Maelor looked at Lian again.
«Hand over the prisoners, put your weapons on the ground, answer the questions we ask you, and I guarantee that the rest of the Outsiders will stay alive.»
«I heard the same offer a few minutes ago.» Lian slightly turned his head toward Kael and his eyes fell on the defeated body of the border commander.
«The result is right there.» He did not know if these idiots were ever going to get tired of making offers.
Several Awakeners gave short smiles.
But not a single Cindari soldier laughed.
«Kael is the border commander.» Maelor was silent for a moment and then said.
The golden roots behind him rose into the air.
Some of them passed higher than the buildings beside the bridge and twisted above the battlefield like huge tentacles.
«I am Vhalaris itself, defeating him does not mean you can defeat me too!»
«Then defeating you should end the battle faster.» The lightning around Lian’s fists became stronger.
The city lord looked directly at this savage human and then released the true weight of his presence across the entire bridge.
The stone floor shook, the walls around them moved, and roots as thick as a human body came out from under the stone floor.

’His Level is not high, but I don’t know why I have a bad feeling about this.’ Lian frowned, ever since this Cindari arrived, his senses had been giving him a constant warning that was unlike anything he had felt from his previous enemies.
But if he only looked at him through his Level, a Level 30 creature, unless he was a Fallen, should not be any threat to him.
He thought for a moment and then understood the answer.
In fact, the answer was obvious and could be understood with one look.
Maelor was Level 30 by himself.
But as long as he fought inside Vhalaris, the entire city became part of his power.
The city lord slowly closed his fingers, the roots that had come out of the ground rushed toward Lian like huge snakes.
Every root was covered in layers of iron and Mana. Some of their tips were sharpened like spears, while others were made to wrap around and crush their targets.
Lian activated Thunder Step, blue lightning exploded where he had been standing, and the first wave of roots hit empty space and shattered the stone floor.
He appeared several meters away, but unlike normal attacks, the roots changed their path.
They twisted across the surface of the bridge, climbed up the walls, and rushed toward him again.
Lian activated Thunder Step for the second time, this time he appeared on the short wall of the bridge.
But the wall under his feet changed shape, stone and roots joined together and tried to swallow his foot like a huge mouth.
"So annoying." He jumped into the air and whispered calmly, now he understood the main reason why his enemy was so dangerous.
«Every stone, every wall, and every root in this city listens to my command, now do you understand? You have no chance!» Maelor said.
"Let me show you the true power of the Cindari!"
He closed his palm.
[Living City Dominion.]
The entire space around Lian changed, the two walls beside the bridge began to move.
Stone and iron pressed toward him from both sides, the stone floor under his feet rose up, roots twisted from above and below and blocked every way out.
In less than a second, he was trapped inside a cube made of stone, metal, and roots, the pressure increased from every direction.
"This is the first time I’ve experienced something like this." He looked at the cube he was trapped inside.
He had no doubt that if any other Awakener besides him were trapped inside it, their fate would be death, completely and without any chance.
But unfortunately, the city lord did not know that he had chosen the wrong enemy.
The sound of metal plates scraping against each other spread across the battlefield.
When the Cindari soldiers saw this scene, they raised their weapons again and one of the officers shouted.
«The Rootwarden is crushing him!»
Cheers rose from the army, at first they were scattered, and then more soldiers joined them.
Those who had lost hope a few moments ago after seeing Kael’s defeat now believed that Maelor was exactly what they needed to end this nightmare.
One of the Rootbound Wardens said excitedly.
«No Outsider can resist the city itself!»
On the human side, several people took a step back, Liana looked at the compressed structure that Lian was trapped inside.
«It’s getting smaller.»
Seraphina held the handle of her sword tighter, and worry could be seen in her eyes.
Seris, without any clear worry, only looked at the center of the structure.
«Can he get out of that?» Rindo asked, even though he had seen unbelievable things from Lian until now, he doubted that even Lian himself could escape from what he was seeing now.
«Yes.» Seris said.
Her tone was so confident that the Student Council President looked at her for a moment.
Inside the trap, the pressure increased every second.
Reinforced roots were wrapped around Lian’s chest, shoulders, and legs. Two walls were pressing his body from both sides, and the stone floor under his feet had risen.
[Diamond Skin.]
His skin and body tissues became hard, the pressure could crush a normal Warrior’s body in a few seconds.
The pressure was strong enough to crush and kill almost any Awakener who had not yet gone through the First Evolution.
But there were exceptions, for example, there was a good chance that Seris could escape from this.
And above them all... there was Lian.
His muscles tightened, the walls moved several more centimeters closer, but they could not crush his chest.
He placed both palms against the stone plates on both sides.
He could break it very soon, but he had decided to use it to some extent to gain experience and learn how to deal with attacks like this.
He realized that he could not break it with only raw strength and physical power, so Mana gathered inside his channels.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
A wave of destruction entered the structure around him directly.
For a moment, nothing changed, then very thin cracks appeared under his fingers.
The cracks spread across the stone, reached the Steel, entered the roots, and in less than a second, the entire chamber exploded from the inside.
"Huh? It... broke apart?" The sound of the explosion cut off the Cindari cheers.
Pieces of stone, roots, and metal spread across the entire bridge, thick dust covered the battlefield.
"How is that possible?"
"That thing carried the power of the city! How? Damn it, how?"
Several soldiers raised their shields to stop the pieces from hitting them.
A shadow moved through the dust, Lian calmly walked out, part of his armor was more damaged, and red lines could be seen on the skin of his hands and neck.
But there was no serious damage, his breathing was still steady.
The Cindari cheers went silent at that moment, the soldier who had shouted in victory a few seconds ago closed his mouth.
«You have a strong body.» Maelor kept the same expression, but his eyes became more serious.
«I’ve heard that before.» Lian brushed the dust off his shoulder.
Thunder Step activated, blue light cut through the battlefield.
He appeared directly in front of Maelor, and Thunder Calamity gathered around his right fist.
Lightning wrapped around his arm and shoulder, and his fist moved toward the city lord’s face.
But before it could hit, three layers of golden roots came out of the ground.

The first layer broke apart from Lian’s punch, the second lasted less than a moment, and the third also broke from the center, but that short delay gave Maelor enough time to move several meters back.
Even so, the lightning wave passed through the broken layer, and the electricity reached Maelor’s right arm.
His muscles tightened for a moment, and his fingers became numb.
The Rootwarden looked at his hand, a direct attack had reached him through the city’s full defense.
The Cindari soldiers saw it too.
The shield Maelor had created with Vhalaris’s power had failed to completely stop Lian’s punch.
The city lord no longer intended to test his power, he understood that he was not facing a normal enemy, and if he did not use everything he had, he would be in serious trouble.
He placed both hands on the ground, golden lines under his skin began to shine.
[Heartroot Invocation.]
[Guardian of the First City.]
The entire bridge shook, golden roots moved from the buildings, towers, and under the stone floor toward one point.
Steel separated from the walls, stones rose into the air, and thick roots twisted around each other.
Behind Maelor, a huge figure began to take shape.
First the legs.
Then a huge body.
Arms as thick as the guard towers.
And finally, a faceless head with a golden flame burning inside its opening.
The root giant was more than thirty meters tall.
Its body was made of iron, stone, and Mana.
Maelor was placed inside a transparent chamber in the center of its chest, roots wrapped around his body and connected him to the city’s Network.
The Guardian’s eyes opened with golden light, and a deep sound came from inside its body.
The Cindari soldiers remained still for several seconds, then one of the officers raised his sword.
«Vhalaris has awakened!» The shout spread through the army.
«The Rootwarden will not lose!»
Several soldiers who had dropped their weapons earlier picked them up again.
Hope returned this time much stronger, Kael had been defeated, but Kael was only one person.
The Guardian of the First City itself was considered the symbol of Vhalaris.
A giant that, according to the legends, had protected the city from the attacks of thousands of monsters in the past.
The weaker Awakeners unconsciously stepped back, the Guardian’s shadow covered a large part of the battlefield.
"Come on, a golem? How does something like this even get created randomly?" Lian did not know whether to laugh or be surprised.
Seeing a golem was not something he had expected.
Golems like this were generally rare, and it was very uncommon to see monsters that had the ability to control and create golems.

And the knowledge of creating them was still mostly in the hands of the native civilizations of the Ruined Realms, and the Awakeners had managed to obtain this knowledge from the remains of one of these civilizations in the past.
And that was why Lian did not expect the Cindari to be able to do something like this either, although this was more of a Skill than a science.
On the other hand, the other Awakeners were also shocked.
«Is he still Level 30?» Liana raised her head in disbelief.
Seraphina stepped forward.
«He still doesn’t need help.» But Seris grabbed her arm.
«If that thing falls on his head, even Lian—» Seraphina frowned.
Seris did not take her eyes off the Guardian.
«First, he needs to be able to hit him.»
The root giant raised its right fist, its movement seemed slow, but the size of its arm allowed it to cover a large distance in a short time.
The fist came down toward Lian, Thunder Step activated, he moved out of the way and the Guardian’s fist hit the bridge.
The stone floor shattered across a large area, and the shockwave forced the nearby soldiers and Awakeners to move back.
Before the dust could settle, hundreds of sharp roots came out from the Guardian’s shoulders and back.
Each one was like a long spear reinforced with Steel.
«Let’s see how many times you can run away.» Maelor said from inside the giant.
The roots shot forward, and Predator’s Instincts sent repeated warnings through Lian’s entire body.
Danger from above.
Behind him.
From the left.
Under his feet.
Thunder Step activated again and again, blue lights appeared at different points across the bridge.
Every time Lian moved past one of the attacks, several root spears landed where he had been standing and pierced through the stone.
One of the spears passed beside his face, the second came close to his shoulder...

The entire space around Lian changed, the two walls beside the bridge began to move.
Stone and iron pressed toward him from both sides, the stone floor under his feet rose up, roots twisted from above and below and blocked every way out.
In less than a second, he was trapped inside a cube made of stone, metal, and roots, the pressure increased from every direction.
"This is the first time I’ve experienced something like this." He looked at the cube he was trapped inside.
He had no doubt that if any other Awakener besides him were trapped inside it, their fate would be death, completely and without any chance.
But unfortunately, the city lord did not know that he had chosen the wrong enemy.
The sound of metal plates scraping against each other spread across the battlefield.
When the Cindari soldiers saw this scene, they raised their weapons again and one of the officers shouted.
«The Rootwarden is crushing him!»
Cheers rose from the army, at first they were scattered, and then more soldiers joined them.
Those who had lost hope a few moments ago after seeing Kael’s defeat now believed that Maelor was exactly what they needed to end this nightmare.
One of the Rootbound Wardens said excitedly.
«No Outsider can resist the city itself!»
On the human side, several people took a step back, Liana looked at the compressed structure that Lian was trapped inside.
«It’s getting smaller.»
Seraphina held the handle of her sword tighter, and worry could be seen in her eyes.
Seris, without any clear worry, only looked at the center of the structure.
«Can he get out of that?» Rindo asked, even though he had seen unbelievable things from Lian until now, he doubted that even Lian himself could escape from what he was seeing now.
«Yes.» Seris said.
Her tone was so confident that the Student Council President looked at her for a moment.
Inside the trap, the pressure increased every second.
Reinforced roots were wrapped around Lian’s chest, shoulders, and legs.
Two walls were pressing his body from both sides, and the stone floor under his feet had risen.
[Diamond Skin.]
His skin and body tissues became hard, the pressure could crush a normal Warrior’s body in a few seconds.
The pressure was strong enough to crush and kill almost any Awakener who had not yet gone through the First Evolution.
But there were exceptions, for example, there was a good chance that Seris could escape from this.
And above them all... there was Lian.
His muscles tightened, the walls moved several more centimeters closer, but they could not crush his chest.
He placed both palms against the stone plates on both sides.
He could break it very soon, but he had decided to use it to some extent to gain experience and learn how to deal with attacks like this.
He realized that he could not break it with only raw strength and physical power, so Mana gathered inside his channels.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
A wave of destruction entered the structure around him directly.
For a moment, nothing changed, then very thin cracks appeared under his fingers.
The cracks spread across the stone, reached the Steel, entered the roots, and in less than a second, the entire chamber exploded from the inside.
"Huh?
It... broke apart?" The sound of the explosion cut off the Cindari cheers.
Pieces of stone, roots, and metal spread across the entire bridge, thick dust covered the battlefield.
"How is that possible?"
"That thing carried the power of the city!
How?
Damn it, how?"
Several soldiers raised their shields to stop the pieces from hitting them.
A shadow moved through the dust, Lian calmly walked out, part of his armor was more damaged, and red lines could be seen on the skin of his hands and neck.
But there was no serious damage, his breathing was still steady.
The Cindari cheers went silent at that moment, the soldier who had shouted in victory a few seconds ago closed his mouth.
«You have a strong body.» Maelor kept the same expression, but his eyes became more serious.
«I’ve heard that before.» Lian brushed the dust off his shoulder.
Thunder Step activated, blue light cut through the battlefield.
He appeared directly in front of Maelor, and Thunder Calamity gathered around his right fist.
Lightning wrapped around his arm and shoulder, and his fist moved toward the city lord’s face.
But before it could hit, three layers of golden roots came out of the ground.

The first layer broke apart from Lian’s punch, the second lasted less than a moment, and the third also broke from the center, but that short delay gave Maelor enough time to move several meters back.
Even so, the lightning wave passed through the broken layer, and the electricity reached Maelor’s right arm.
His muscles tightened for a moment, and his fingers became numb.
The Rootwarden looked at his hand, a direct attack had reached him through the city’s full defense.
The Cindari soldiers saw it too.
The shield Maelor had created with Vhalaris’s power had failed to completely stop Lian’s punch.
The city lord no longer intended to test his power, he understood that he was not facing a normal enemy, and if he did not use everything he had, he would be in serious trouble.
He placed both hands on the ground, golden lines under his skin began to shine.
[Heartroot Invocation.]
[Guardian of the First City.]
The entire bridge shook, golden roots moved from the buildings, towers, and under the stone floor toward one point.
Steel separated from the walls, stones rose into the air, and thick roots twisted around each other.
Behind Maelor, a huge figure began to take shape.
First the legs.
Then a huge body.
Arms as thick as the guard towers.
And finally, a faceless head with a golden flame burning inside its opening.
The root giant was more than thirty meters tall.
Its body was made of iron, stone, and Mana.
Maelor was placed inside a transparent chamber in the center of its chest, roots wrapped around his body and connected him to the city’s Network.
The Guardian’s eyes opened with golden light, and a deep sound came from inside its body.
The Cindari soldiers remained still for several seconds, then one of the officers raised his sword.
«Vhalaris has awakened!» The shout spread through the army.
«The Rootwarden will not lose!»
Several soldiers who had dropped their weapons earlier picked them up again.
Hope returned this time much stronger, Kael had been defeated, but Kael was only one person.
The Guardian of the First City itself was considered the symbol of Vhalaris.
A giant that, according to the legends, had protected the city from the attacks of thousands of monsters in the past.
The weaker Awakeners unconsciously stepped back, the Guardian’s shadow covered a large part of the battlefield.
"Come on, a golem?
How does something like this even get created randomly?" Lian did not know whether to laugh or be surprised.
Seeing a golem was not something he had expected.
Golems like this were generally rare, and it was very uncommon to see monsters that had the ability to control and create golems.

And the knowledge of creating them was still mostly in the hands of the native civilizations of the Ruined Realms, and the Awakeners had managed to obtain this knowledge from the remains of one of these civilizations in the past.
And that was why Lian did not expect the Cindari to be able to do something like this either, although this was more of a Skill than a science.
On the other hand, the other Awakeners were also shocked.
«Is he still Level 30?» Liana raised her head in disbelief.
Seraphina stepped forward.
«He still doesn’t need help.» But Seris grabbed her arm.
«If that thing falls on his head, even Lian—» Seraphina frowned.
Seris did not take her eyes off the Guardian.
«First, he needs to be able to hit him.»
The root giant raised its right fist, its movement seemed slow, but the size of its arm allowed it to cover a large distance in a short time.
The fist came down toward Lian, Thunder Step activated, he moved out of the way and the Guardian’s fist hit the bridge.
The stone floor shattered across a large area, and the shockwave forced the nearby soldiers and Awakeners to move back.
Before the dust could settle, hundreds of sharp roots came out from the Guardian’s shoulders and back.
Each one was like a long spear reinforced with Steel.
«Let’s see how many times you can run away.» Maelor said from inside the giant.
The roots shot forward, and Predator’s Instincts sent repeated warnings through Lian’s entire body.
Danger from above.
Behind him.
From the left.
Under his feet.
Thunder Step activated again and again, blue lights appeared at different points across the bridge.
Every time Lian moved past one of the attacks, several root spears landed where he had been standing and pierced through the stone.
One of the spears passed beside his face, the second came close to his shoulder...

chapters.title: Chapter 310: Battle With The Cindari Army VI
paragraphs: With the feeling of danger, Lian activated Glacial Reaper Claw, an ice claw formed around his right hand and with one movement, he cut the root in half.
Ice spread from the point of contact and froze a large part of it.
He appeared at another point.
He gathered Thunder Calamity around his left fist and punched the Guardian’s knee.
The lightning entered the iron and part of the knee exploded.
But new roots came out from inside the body and filled the empty space within a few seconds.
Lian cut the Guardian’s left arm with Glacial Reaper Claw, but the roots grew back again.
He destroyed part of its side with Cataclysm Pulse and the structure repaired itself from the inside again.
It did not matter how much he attacked, how much he destroyed, it repaired itself again!
«You cannot destroy a city with your fists.» Maelor said from the center of the chest.
Lian stood on one of the exposed roots, his eyes fixed directly on the city lord in the center of the Guardian.
«I don’t need to destroy the whole city, I only need to pull you out of it.» His ice claw broke the root under his feet.
Maelor created several new layers of roots in front of the chest chamber and the Guardian attacked again.
This time, instead of responding immediately, Lian watched several movements.
The left fist came up, golden light entered the Guardian’s legs from the roots under the bridge.
Then it moved up along the central pillar and was transferred to the left shoulder, when the arm moved, the light in the other parts became weaker.
The next attack was done with the right leg, the same pattern again, Mana first came from the ground, then the central pillar, and then the target limb.
[Echo Adaptation.]
The images and rhythms were recorded in Lian’s mind.
Echo Adaptation did not directly show him a magical weakness.
But it placed the repeated attacks next to each other, every time the Guardian moved one part of its body with full power, the other parts received less Mana for a moment.
Lian intentionally stood several meters in front of the Guardian, Maelor thought an opportunity had appeared.
The giant’s right fist rose, and golden light moved from its legs into the central pillar.
Then it moved toward the right shoulder, at that moment, the defense in front of the chest became weaker.
Lian activated Thunder Step, blue light passed beside the Guardian’s fist, he appeared directly in front of the center of its chest.
[Thunder Calamity.]
His lightning-covered fist hit the golem’s layers.
The first layer broke, the second shattered, and the third exploded from the lightning wave, the attack passed through the chamber and reached Maelor’s body.
The Rootwarden was thrown backward inside the Guardian.
Blood ran from the corner of his mouth, for a moment, his control over the giant body was disturbed.
The Guardian staggered, one of its feet dragged across the bridge and broke part of the stone floor.
Echo Adaptation was deactivated, Lian no longer needed it.
The city lord wiped the blood from his lips, the pride and calmness from his face had been replaced by cold anger.
«Then I’ll bury Ashfall with you.» He opened both hands.
All the roots in the district began to move, not only the roots of the Guardian.
Under the infirmary.
The council building.
The towers where the human archers were stationed.
And the houses where the injured Awakeners had taken shelter.
Hundreds of roots came out from under the ground, some broke through walls, some moved toward the roofs like spears.
The others wrapped around the buildings to crush them.
«Everyone, fall back!» Rindo shouted.
Seraphina raised her sword, prismatic light spread around the infirmary and deflected the first wave of roots.
Liana sent Shadow Wolf underground to stop the roots near the wounded.
Marcus and several Tanks stood in front of the central building.
But there were too many attacks.
If Maelor continued to use the entire city, even if he himself was defeated, dozens of Awakeners would be killed.
Lian made his decision, his eyes moved between the Guardian, the main bridge, and the network of roots around Ashfall.
He did not intend to freeze all of Vhalaris.
Not the civilians, not the buildings farther away, but only the parts that were directly connected to Maelor and the Guardian.
Cold Mana flowed through his entire body.
[Eternal Frozen Apocalypse.]
At the first moment, the sounds became weaker.
The temperature of the area dropped at an unnatural speed, the breath of the soldiers and Awakeners could be seen in the air.
The moisture between the roots and stones turned into white crystals in an instant, the wave of cold spread from under Lian’s feet.
First the surface of the bridge, then the Guardian’s roots, then the networks that stretched from Ashfall toward the giant body.
The golden roots froze in the middle of their movement, the light inside them stopped.
The spears moving toward the infirmary turned into white and motionless pillars several meters before reaching their target.
The stone floor of the bridge was covered by a deep layer of ice, the cold reached the Guardian’s feet.
The roots tried to pull back, but it was too late, the ice passed through their surface and entered their inner layers.
The giant’s feet froze to the bridge, then the cold moved up from its knees and the wave of ice reached the Cindari army as well.
Lian controlled its strength, the soldiers’ bodies did not freeze, but their armor, boots, and weapons became stuck to the surface of the bridge.
Many of them lost the ability to move, several fell to their knees from the cold and the entire battlefield became silent for a moment.
The only sound was the quiet cracking of ice.
One of the Cindari looked in fear at a root that had stopped beside his face.
«Heartroot... froze.»
His voice was so weak that only the people nearby heard it, but the meaning could be seen in everyone’s eyes.
The Heartroot Network was something the generations of Cindari had considered alive, eternal, and impossible to defeat.
Now it had become motionless in front of their eyes, the hope that had returned with Maelor’s arrival broke again, and this time it broke even deeper.
Inside the Guardian, Maelor tried to strengthen his connection to the roots.
He sent golden Mana into the network, but there was no response.
He tried again, parts of the ice cracked, but the roots did not move.
«Impossible.»
«I think I’ve heard that word a lot today.» Lian walked across the frozen surface, the sound of his boots on the ice spread through the silence of the battlefield.
The city lord shouted and released all of his remaining Mana, golden flames came out from inside the Guardian.
Heat passed through the cracks in the ice, parts of the giant body began to shake and the ice on its shoulder and chest started to crack.
The Guardian tried to free its arms, but before it could completely break free, Lian activated Glacial Reaper Claw.
The claw formed around his right hand again, Thunder Step removed the distance between him and the Guardian in an instant.
Lian appeared on the center of the giant’s chest, he pushed the claw into a crack that had been created earlier by Thunder Calamity.
The cold entered the Guardian directly.
The ice did not spread from the outside to the inside, this time it started from the heart of the giant body.
The central roots froze, the chamber around Maelor turned white.
The Rootwarden shouted and sent all the free roots toward Lian.
They came out from the Guardian’s shoulders and neck, but the young Vorhelm clenched his left hand.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
The wave of destruction was released from inside the chest.
The frozen roots could not absorb the pressure or spread it through the network, all of them cracked at the same time.
First, a deep sound came from inside the Guardian, then cracks spread across the chest, shoulders, and neck.
The thirty-meter body collapsed from the center, the giant’s head separated from its neck and its right arm broke into several huge pieces.
The shoulders and torso turned into piles of stone and frozen roots.
Large pieces fell onto the bridge, the Cindari soldiers moved back in fear.
The Awakeners created Barriers to stop the ruins from hitting them.
Lian entered the central chamber through the collapsed heart of the Guardian.
Maelor was still connected to several roots, he raised his hand to create another Barrier, the golden roots tried to gather in front of him.
But most of them were frozen or broken, an incomplete Barrier formed, which Lian broke with his fist.
His hand closed around Maelor’s throat, the Rootwarden was separated from the root network.
The young Vorhelm pulled him out of the Guardian’s heart, both of them fell from the height and the cold wind moved around them.
Before hitting the ground, the city lord released golden flames from his body.
A wave of Mana pushed Lian’s hand away, he spun in the air and landed on the bridge, his feet slid several meters across the ice, but he kept his balance.
Lian also landed several steps away.
Maelor had still not surrendered. Blood could be seen on his lips and robes.
His connection to the city Network was almost completely cut off and the Guardian had been destroyed, but golden lines on his body were still shining.
He placed both hands on his chest.
«The First Root...»
A white and golden flame came out from his heart.
[First Root’s Final Ember.]
The Mana pressure increased for a moment, flames covered Maelor’s entire body.
An unclear image of a tall figure wearing a crown appeared behind him.
Something that seemed to be a reflection of the power of the founder of the first Cindari civilization.
Maelor’s muscles became stronger, his speed increased, and the cracks on his armor and body were covered by a layer of golden fire.
He rushed toward Lian, this time his movement was faster than all of his previous attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 311: Battle With The Cindari Army ( Final )
paragraphs: The first punch hit his chest, Diamond Skin took most of the pressure, but Lian took one step back.
The second attack came from the right and hit his shoulder, the golden flame spread across his skin.
Maelor created a short root from the palm of his hand and sent it toward Lian’s side like a spear.
Lian turned his body, the tip of the root only cut through the surface of his skin.
The fourth attack moved toward his face.
Predator’s Instincts warned him, and he moved his head to the side.
The fist passed in front of his eyes.
The city lord’s hand had not fully moved back yet when Thunder Calamity gathered around Lian’s fist.
The punch hit the Rootwarden’s chest directly, the golden Barrier around his body resisted for a moment.
Then it broke with a loud sound.
The lightning wave entered Maelor’s body, he was thrown backward, but before he could fall, Thunder Step activated and Lian appeared behind him.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
There was not enough distance for a full Charge, but the raw Power and the compressed pressure of the Skill were enough.
Lian’s shoulder hit Maelor’s back, the Rootwarden was slammed directly into the ground and the bridge under his body cracked.
The white and golden flame shook for a moment.
The city lord placed his hand on the ground and tried to stand up, but deep cold formed beside his neck.
Glacial Reaper Claw was only a few centimeters away from his skin.
The claw had not entered his body, but the cold was close enough to burn the skin of his neck and part of his face.
«It’s over.» Lian said.
Maelor stared at the surface of the bridge with heavy breaths, he moved his hand to summon the roots.
Nothing responded.
He tried again.
Only a few weak golden lines under the ice moved slightly and then went dark.
Vhalaris no longer responded to his command.
He raised his head, the Guardian had been destroyed, and huge pieces of its body were scattered across the bridge.
Kael was still lying motionless among the ruins, most of the army was frozen, injured, or disarmed.
And Lian still did not even look like he had become truly serious.
Maelor said nothing for several seconds, then placed his hand on the ground.
Not to attack, not to summon the city, but to admit his defeat, he was not stupid, first of all, he had no strength left to continue and he knew that if he continued, he might make this human angry.
He did not want to watch all of his people get killed...
The Cindari saw the scene, when Maelor arrived, hope had returned to their faces.
When the Guardian of the First City appeared, even the soldiers who had dropped their weapons became ready to fight again.
They were sure that no creature inside Vhalaris could defeat the Rootwarden.
But the Guardian was now nothing more than a mass of frozen roots and broken stones.
Maelor was lying on the ground under Lian’s Glacial Reaper Claw.
One young soldier dropped his shield, the sound of metal hitting the frozen surface spread through the silence of the battlefield.
Another soldier only looked at Maelor, as if he was still waiting for his commander to stand up and say that everything had been part of his plan.
«Rootwarden...» an injured officer said in a shaking voice.
Maelor turned his head slightly, his voice was weak, but clear.
«Put your weapons down.»
«But Vhalaris—» The officer resisted for a moment.
«It’s over.» Maelor said more firmly this time.
The officer’s sword lowered, then fell to the ground, and one after another, weapons were dropped.
Shields.
Spears.
Bows.
Swords.
There was no other commander left who could give them hope.
Kael had been defeated, Maelor had surrendered.
And the human who had defeated both of them still did not look tired, and on the Awakener side, there was silence for several seconds.
Many still could not believe that the battle was really over, then one of the Awakeners raised his sword and shouted in victory.
His voice spread across the battlefield and several others joined him.
«Vhalaris is ours!»
More cheers rose.
«Keep the formation!» But Rindo immediately stepped forward, his voice was spread across all of Ashfall with Mana.
«Nothing is over yet.» He pointed toward the groups near the bridge.
«Disarm all the soldiers.»
«No one attacks those who have surrendered.» Then he looked at the Healers.
«Check our wounded.» He paused for a moment.
«Treat the Cindari who are in danger of dying too.»
Several Awakeners looked at him in surprise, and the Student Council President made his voice harder.
«We are not going to become the thing we hate, every soldier who has surrendered is a prisoner of war.»
«Anyone who attacks a prisoner or a civilian will be punished by me.»
Orders were given one after another.
Marcus became responsible for the defense of the western bridge.
Despite his injured shoulder, he sent a group of Tanks and Warriors toward the entrance to prevent a sudden attack by fresh forces.
Seraphina and Liana returned to the center of Ashfall.
Seraphina strengthened the defensive Barriers around the infirmary and the council building.
Liana moved Shadow Wolf through the side paths to find hidden soldiers or forces that were still resisting.
«First Rootspire and then the Archive, no document should be destroyed, check all of them.» Cassian gathered the Awakeners.
«If there is anything about the Forgotten Tree, other cities, or the Black Silence corruption, find it.» Rindo nodded.
Ethan became responsible for moving the prisoners.
This choice seemed strange at first, but Rindo sent two organized groups of Warriors with him and repeated several times.
«Don’t hit anyone without a reason.»
«I’m not that unreliable.» Ethan said with annoyance.
«You are.» Marcus answered from a distance.
Seris stayed near Lian and Maelor.
Every time the Rootwarden made the smallest movement, her cold eyes remained fixed on his hands and the golden lines on his body.
The Mages went toward the remaining Ballistas.
Most of the equipment on the main bridge had been destroyed, but several Ballistas at the other entrances were still intact.
They tried to understand the Cindari control system and turn the weapons toward the outside of the city.
The Healers moved across the entire bridge, first the injured Awakeners were treated.
Then the Cindari who had deadly wounds.
Some soldiers moved back in fear when the human Healers approached them, but after seeing that they truly did not intend to kill them, their resistance became weaker.
The Cindari civilians remained inside their homes, watching the change in control of the city from behind windows, half-open doors, and the upper bridges.
There was no official flag for the humans, but the Ashfall guards were now standing on the towers.
The military entrances were under the control of the Awakeners, and the Vhalaris soldiers were taken with their hands tied toward the empty prisons.
By sunset, Ashfall Ward was no longer an area that the Cindari had given to the Outsiders for temporary shelter.
It had become a human fortress.
Maelor, Kael, Tharos, and several other surviving commanders were placed in separate cells.
Several layers of Suppression chains were used for Maelor, the main seals were attached around his wrists, neck, and chest.
The same seals that had been used to suppress the power of humans were now being used to suppress their own power.

Night had not fully arrived yet, the red light of the city’s roots entered through the window and fell across the maps spread over the table.
The city lord sat on a metal chair, Suppression chains were wrapped around his body.
Part of his neck and face had been burned by Glacial Reaper Claw, and the marks of lightning could be seen on his chest and arms.
Even so, he was conscious, and unlike Kael, he did not turn the loss of his pride into open anger.
There were four people in the room.
Lian.
Rindo.
Seraphina.
And Cassian.
The rest of the group were outside as well, listening to this interrogation, an interrogation that was extremely important to them.
«How many cities do you have?» Rindo asked without any introduction.
Maelor was silent for a while, his eyes moved across the map of Emberroot, but he said nothing.
Lian placed his right hand on the table.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
The full claw formed and cold gathered around his fingers, a layer of white ice moved across the surface of the table from under his hand.
"For every question you refuse to answer, ten of your soldiers will die, and if you stay silent until all of them are dead, I’ll go after your people next." He then said in a cold tone.

The second attack came from the right and hit his shoulder, the golden flame spread across his skin.
Maelor created a short root from the palm of his hand and sent it toward Lian’s side like a spear.
Lian turned his body, the tip of the root only cut through the surface of his skin.
The fourth attack moved toward his face.
Predator’s Instincts warned him, and he moved his head to the side.
The fist passed in front of his eyes.
The city lord’s hand had not fully moved back yet when Thunder Calamity gathered around Lian’s fist.
The punch hit the Rootwarden’s chest directly, the golden Barrier around his body resisted for a moment.
Then it broke with a loud sound.
The lightning wave entered Maelor’s body, he was thrown backward, but before he could fall, Thunder Step activated and Lian appeared behind him.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
There was not enough distance for a full Charge, but the raw Power and the compressed pressure of the Skill were enough.
Lian’s shoulder hit Maelor’s back, the Rootwarden was slammed directly into the ground and the bridge under his body cracked.
The white and golden flame shook for a moment.
The city lord placed his hand on the ground and tried to stand up, but deep cold formed beside his neck.
Glacial Reaper Claw was only a few centimeters away from his skin.
The claw had not entered his body, but the cold was close enough to burn the skin of his neck and part of his face.
«It’s over.» Lian said.
Maelor stared at the surface of the bridge with heavy breaths, he moved his hand to summon the roots.
Nothing responded.
He tried again.
Only a few weak golden lines under the ice moved slightly and then went dark.
Vhalaris no longer responded to his command.
He raised his head, the Guardian had been destroyed, and huge pieces of its body were scattered across the bridge.
Kael was still lying motionless among the ruins, most of the army was frozen, injured, or disarmed.
And Lian still did not even look like he had become truly serious.
Maelor said nothing for several seconds, then placed his hand on the ground.
Not to attack, not to summon the city, but to admit his defeat, he was not stupid, first of all, he had no strength left to continue and he knew that if he continued, he might make this human angry.
He did not want to watch all of his people get killed...
The Cindari saw the scene, when Maelor arrived, hope had returned to their faces.

Swords.

chapters.title: Chapter 312: Interrogation
paragraphs: "For every question you refuse to answer, ten of your soldiers will die, and if you stay silent until all of them are dead, I will go after your people next." He then said in a cold tone.
After the battle, he had realized that this former city lord truly cared about his people and was willing to put aside even his pride to protect them.
This was a weakness that could be used very well.
Maelor gave it a brief look.
He did not want to speak, he did not want to give them any information, but he had no choice...
"Five cities." He then said.
Cassian immediately picked up a pen.
"The names and distances."
Maelor looked at Rindo, when he realized that they really intended to record all the information, he slowly began to explain.
"Vhalaris is the governmental and military center of the western part of Emberroot."
"We already know this." Rindo said.
"Cinderhold is in the east, with fast forces, it is about two days away."
"The largest military center?" Cassian marked it on the map.
"Most of the war Forges are there, armor, Ballista, Ember Weapons and army equipment are made there." Maelor nodded.
"If they have already received the news of Vhalaris’s fall, how long will it take them to send forces?" Rindo asked.
"The main force will take two days, the advance groups will be faster."
"How much faster?"
"If they use military Beasts, less than one day."
The atmosphere in the room became heavier, they did not have much time.
"Emberwell is in the southeast, four days away, it is the center for storing water and food and breeding Beasts."
"Ashenreach is the third city, and five days to the north, it is generally a common city and there is nothing special about it."

"And the last city is Rootcrown, our oldest city, about seven days to the east and the closest city to the Forgotten Tree." Maelor finished his explanation, even though he felt guilty for answering, he knew that if he stayed silent, the price would be the deaths of his people.
"Is it still inhabited?" Rindo asked with some curiosity, considering that the last city was close to the Forgotten Tree.
"Part of it, the western districts are still active, but the eastern part has been abandoned in recent years, the Death Zone gets closer every year."
Cassian drew the approximate route on the map.
Five cities.
Vhalaris.
Cinderhold.
Emberwell.
Ashenreach.
And Rootcrown.
Vhalaris was now under the control of the humans, but the other four cities could still have armies and resources.
Cinderhold was the closest and most dangerous threat.
"How did your civilization form?" Lian then asked, this was what he was more curious about, especially because he still knew little about the history of this world.
"What does this question have to do with the current situation?" Maelor paused for a longer moment.
"Answer."
The city lord stared at him, then after a few seconds, leaned back against the chair.
"Before the Cindari, there were other civilizations in this world, we do not know their exact number.
"Our world was full of cities, Kingdoms and races, most of which did not even leave a name behind."
"They faced something that was later called The Black Silence."
Lian stayed silent, he already knew this much, but since it was new information for Cassian and Rindo, he let him continue.
"At first, the corruption only appeared in limited areas, then more creatures began to change."
"The waters turned black, plants started eating living creatures, and in the end it spread across the entire world." Maelor’s voice was calm, but even he felt sadness while saying it.

"The leaders of the old civilizations united, things happened that caused the world to split and become different, and in the end they tried to contain the Titan in the final battle and stop the Black Silence."
"Did they succeed?" Cassian asked.
"If they had succeeded, the world would not be like this now." Maelor gave a bitter smile and then continued.
"Almost all the leaders, commanders and warriors who took part in the final battle were killed, only one person returned, Cindar Vael."
The name remained in the room for a moment.
"The founder of our civilization."
"Was he a Cindari?" Rindo asked.
"No." Maelor said and added.
"There was no race called Cindari at all."
"Cindar Vael was one of the survivors of the old civilizations, when he returned from the final battle, he carried a piece of the First Root and an unending fire with him."
"He gathered the scattered survivors, built Rootcrown, and taught them how to grow, use Mana and connect to the living roots."
"The next generations called themselves Cindari in his honor."
Lian said nothing, but Aurelia’s voice echoed in his mind again, the last words she whispered.
"One of us allowed The Black Silence to enter."
That sentence pierced his mind again like a thorn.
He had guessed that one of the leaders of the old civilizations might have betrayed them, although he was not sure, but Aurelia’s words had created such a thought in his mind.
And the result of that battle also clearly showed that only one person had survived and managed to return.
Cindar Vael.
This did not prove anything, it was possible that he was simply the only person who survived by luck or power.
Maybe the others had sacrificed themselves to save him.

But for one person among all the surviving leaders to return alive, carrying a piece of the First Root and an eternal fire, and then build a new civilization on the ruins of the world, was too suspicious.
And there was still something else bothering him, what exactly did it mean that someone had allowed the Black Silence to enter?
Lian’s frown became deeper and Serafina noticed the change in his expression.
"What are you thinking about?"
Lian looked at her for a moment, he decided not to say all of his guesses yet.
"Why was he the only one who survived."
"We do not know the answer either." Maelor answered coldly.
"How can we learn more about him?" Vorhelm paused for a moment and then asked.
"Almost nowhere, a large part of the records from the first years of our civilization was destroyed."
"The founder himself did not allow everything to be recorded, the only place where something might still remain is the First Archive under Rootcrown."
"Of course, some of them were destroyed over time and some sections were forbidden for the next generations, even I was not allowed to see all of them."
"Maybe that Archive can help with the mystery of the Forgotten Tree and help us understand exactly what is happening to it." Lian looked at the others and made his point.
"So we have another Archive that we have to enter." Cassian sighed.
Rindo looked at him but said nothing, since the person who was going there was a monster among humans, there was no need to give advice or warnings.
"Now my question." Cassian got their attention again and looked directly at Maelor.
"Why did you frame us? You killed the Archivist, put my dagger inside his body and sent the guards exactly when we entered the room."
Maelor did not deny it, his silence was enough to confirm it.
"Why?"
"We needed a reason, so we could keep you there for as long as necessary."

"And then? Information, a way through the Rift, if we could not find a way into your world through the other Outsiders, we would interrogate those three separately, using whatever method was necessary."
There was no need for him to explain what he meant, torture, months or years of imprisonment.
Using Pain, Mana Extraction or any other tool that the Cindari had inside Rootspire.
Rindo pressed his fist against the table.
If Lian had not attacked the prison, Marcus, Ethan and Cassian might have stayed there for an unknown amount of time.
The three-day period and then execution was only a lie, those three were only supposed to be a backup plan, of course, they had not been personally chosen and were mostly random.
It was their own stupidity that made them fall into the trap.
"Then why did you do nothing while we were in prison?" Cassian asked.
"I was waiting to see how the other humans would react, I wanted to understand how far you would go to save three people, and besides, our main focus was on that other human." Maelor answered.
He meant Aren.
"Because he has been here for a long time, he knows more than you and unlike you, he cannot understand our language, that is why we needed to focus more on him." Then curiosity appeared in his eyes.
"How can you speak our language from the moment you arrive? How can you read our writing? But after years, he still barely knows a few words?"
"That has nothing to do with you." Lian simply answered.
Maelor stared at him for a few seconds, then understood that he would not get an answer.
"What do you know about why the Forgotten Tree dried up?" Lian changed the subject.
"If we knew, do you think we would be looking for a way to escape to your world?" The city lord gave a short and bitter laugh.
"The area around the Forgotten Tree is no longer a forest."
"It is a killing ground, the waters have turned black, the rivers that used to come out of the roots of the tree now smell of death, the plants have either completely dried up or changed."
"Some of them attack any living creature that comes close."
"What about the monsters?" Serafina asked.
"Most of them have been corrupted, their power level gets higher every year, some of them no longer look like their original species."
"Our last exploration group had seventy-three people and only three returned."
The room became silent and Maelor continued.

"And all three died a few days later, one burned from the inside, one of their bodies turned into roots, the third tried to kill everyone in the medical center before dying, we do not know what happened to them."
"So you did not send anyone else." Serafina asked heavily.
"No, if getting close was possible, we would have found a way to heal the tree ourselves, no one dares to enter that area anymore."
Lian looked at the map, there was no ready answer in Vhalaris.
Neither Maelor knew the reason why the tree was drying up, nor did the city’s Archives record a way to heal it.
And the Cindari groups had not been able to enter the Death Zone either.
There was no other way left, he had to reach the Forgotten Tree himself.
