chapters.title: Chapter 332: The Forgotten Tree VIII
paragraphs: [Race: Cindari]
[Level: 35]
Seris stared at the panel without moving for several seconds.
Level 35.
The number alone did not explain everything, but it was enough for her to understand that the man standing a few meters ahead of her could not be compared to Maelor or Kael.
Maelor had become dangerous inside Vhalaris because of Territorial Covenant.
Kael was a powerful military commander.
But the man in front of her was not connected to the city’s defensive network, he had no army behind him and he was not even wearing heavy armor.
Even so, he was walking alone inside the Dead Zone, a place where entire Cindari Expeditions had failed to return from.
And worst of all, he knew exactly what stage the Cocoon had reached, and he was also the current leader of all the Cindari in this Emberroot forest.
They were facing one of the most powerful beings in this small world.
Caelus did not take his eyes off the Cocoon.
The white and black roots around Selina were still slowly contracting in a steady rhythm, and the golden light inside them was slowly mixing with dark spots.
"You Outsiders should not be here." After several seconds, he finally spoke.
"I think that applies to you too, and I thought Cindari were afraid of coming here." Seris held her sword in front of her body and her eyes moved across the dead ground around them for a moment.
"I am different from the others." Caelus turned his head slightly toward her this time, his face still calm.
Then he looked at the Cocoon again.
"And I have no choice but to come here to observe the process of the new Vessel’s formation."
The young Pendragon narrowed her eyes slightly, there was no doubt anymore, he not only knew what had happened to Selina, but he also knew about the process of her transformation.
"So you really know what is happening here."
"More than you should know."

"We are not going to let that girl become a Vessel for that Corruption or whatever it is." Seris took one step forward, the blade of her sword lowered slightly, but her body became more aggressive instead.
Caelus looked directly at Seris for several seconds... it was more like the look of someone listening to a child talking about something much bigger than what they could understand.
"This process was planned years before you were born." He continued with an unsettling calmness.
"That girl’s fate is to become the new Vessel."
The young Pendragon frowned and was about to say something, but the leader of the Cindari continued.
"Neither you, your friend, nor any other Outsider can stop it."
"I don’t know why...but I have a feeling that the death of this tree is your fault too." Seris thought for a moment and looked at the dry roots of the Forgotten Tree.
Caelus gave no answer, he neither confirmed nor denied it, but only stayed silent for several seconds, and that silence was worse than any confession.
Aren had kept himself back until then, but he could no longer stay quiet.
Twenty-five years.
He had spent twenty-five years of his life in this world.
He had seen people who entered this Realm with him die.
He had seen their groups being hunted.
He had seen the fear Cindari had of the Black Silence.
He had seen Corrupted bodies.
And now he was standing in front of a man who seemed to know all of this and was still deliberately allowing the disaster to be released again.
"Are you crazy?"
Caelus gave him a short look and Aren raised his voice.
"Do you understand what you’re doing? Black Silence isn’t some normal disease! That thing almost destroyed this entire world!"
"Look at this!" He pointed at the dead and abandoned area around the tree.
"This thing you see around us is the result of it!"
The leader of the Cindari remained calm and did not seem to care, and there was no sign of concern in his eyes either.
"And now you’re releasing it again yourselves? Why?"
This question was not really coming from anger, but from being unable to understand.
Even after everything he had seen, Aren could not imagine the logic behind doing something like this.
"Power? Immortality? Revenge? What is worth destroying your entire world with your own hands?" Then he pointed at the Cocoon.
"And why a Human?" His voice became lower for a moment.
"Why should a Human be the new Vessel?"
"You don’t understand." Caelus showed a small change in his expression for the first time.
It was not sadness or something as simple as anger, but something like pity, as if he felt sorry for them.
"Then explain!" Aren answered harshly.

"There is no need, in the end, all of this is for Salvation, what was started by our Founder will finally be completed by my hands..." The leader of the Cindari said slowly, but with hidden excitement.
"Salvation for you, and your world too." Seris immediately cut him off and raised her sword.
"If that thing is released, our world will be in danger too, so I don’t care if you call what you’re doing Salvation or some other bullshit." And her eyes moved to Selina.
"And there is no way I’m going to let a Human become the Vessel of that thing."
This time Caelus actually frowned because of the question and for a moment his eyes moved from Seris to Aren.
"You...know?"
"Know what? What do we know?"
Caelus looked carefully at both of them for several seconds, the calmness that had been on his face until then was replaced by a kind of cold evaluation.
"That’s strange, you know that a Calamity can enter your world from this Realm...but you don’t know why a Human was chosen."
"What do you mean?" Seris asked immediately, she felt like this bastard was playing with words with them, how could he twist everything this much?
It was one of those times when she wished Lian was here, of course, even without him they would not have a problem, she just did not like this part of talking very much.
"That Human was not chosen by me."
This time even Seris stood completely still for a moment.
What did he mean by saying that this Cindari man had not chosen her? If she had not been chosen by the current leader of the entire race, then who had chosen her?
"Then who chose her?" Aren reacted faster.
"The dead don’t need to know." Caelus looked at him, the previous pity completely gone.
"You will be the only dead one here." Seris’s fingers tightened around the hilt of her sword and her gaze became cold.
"The children of Father will be eternal." Caelus answered without hurry.
Seris did not ask any more questions, she felt that whatever this thing in front of them was, it had gone crazy and there was no need to talk anymore.
It was time to use the same method as before, the method that always worked.
She moved and her sword came up from the right.
[Moonless Severance.]
Mana gathered on the blade, but unlike a normal Sword Aura, it did not leave the sword.
At the moment of the Slash, no wave could be seen, no bright light, no Projectile, only the slow movement of the blade through the air could be seen.
Caelus did not even move, for a moment, the attack seemed like a complete Miss.
Then the space between them suddenly split, though not in a physical way.
Instead, the cutting line that Seris had compressed Mana into along its path was released with a delay of less than a blink.
The ten-meter distance was practically removed from the equation and the leader of the Cindari moved his head slightly backward at the last moment.
The sound of cloth being cut was heard and a thin line appeared on the chest of his black and white robe.
One second later... blood... a red drop came out from under the cloth.
Caelus looked down and ran his finger over the cut, the tip of his finger became covered in blood.
"Interesting." His expression finally changed again, mixed with interest.
Seris did not wait for praise and her body disappeared, Mana was released from her legs and she closed the distance in a few fast steps.
The sword rose.
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
The first Slash came from above, then the second, then the third and...
But every time the sword moved, dozens of thin Sword Aura lines separated from the path of the blade.
They were not Illusions or empty Afterimages, each one was a real Slash!
In less than a second, the space around Caelus was filled with hundreds of thin cuts and forced him to raise his right hand.
[Crown of Thorns.]
White and black roots came out of the ground and wrapped around his body, forming the first layer of the Barrier.
The Slashes hit it and the sound of metal and wood colliding filled the air.
The first layer cracked and... broke.
New roots replaced it and then the second layer formed.
But Thousand Petal Swordstorm continued and it was not going to stop that easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 333: The Forgotten Tree IX
paragraphs: Dozens of cuts landed on the Barrier and the cracks spread.
The second layer also collapsed and then a thicker third layer formed.
But Seris did not stop moving, every step came with a Slash, every Slash created dozens of Mana blades.
Crown of Thorns started to shake under the pressure.
And the young Pendragon reached close range.
[King’s Breaker.]
Her sword struck directly at the center of the Barrier and the Skill was designed to destroy defensive structures.
The first strike disturbed the defensive Mana, thin cracks appeared in the layer of roots.
The second strike caused more disturbance and then the Barrier started to lose its shape.
The third strike came and a short explosion sounded, and finally Crown of Thorns broke.
Seris did not stop for even a moment.
[Sovereign’s Judgment.]
Her sword rose for a moment, but this time the attack was not physical, instead, direct pressure on the enemy’s soul fell upon him.
For an ordinary person, the Skill could create a gap of several seconds between the mind’s command and the body’s movement.
The mind said move, but the body did not respond.
But against Caelus, the effect was much weaker...but not zero.
The man’s eyes froze for a moment and his fingers stopped moving, but the difference in power was much greater than what was needed to keep that situation going.
Only 0.8 seconds! It did not even reach one second.
But it was enough for Seris and gave her the chance she wanted.
[King’s Execution.]
She directly entered the killing range, the blade moved toward Caelus’s neck in a short path.
But suddenly, at the last moment, the man’s movement changed and he pulled his head back, his hand came up.
Seris’s sword changed its path slightly, instead of his neck, the blade landed on his shoulder, cutting from the shoulder to the upper part of his chest.
More blood came out.
Caelus took several steps back.
Aren watched the scene from a distance, for a moment he even forgot to breathe.
He knew that this girl was powerful but he did not expect her to be this strong, he thought they would have no chance in this battle and would lose.
But she had wounded the leader of the Cindari several times in less than a few minutes.
"Damn..."
Seris prepared her next attack.
But this time Caelus no longer had the same calm expression as before, his eyes moved from the wound on his chest back to the girl.
"Enough.
Mana was released and its pressure hit the surroundings like an invisible wave, the gray soil of the Dead Zone rose from the ground.
Aren unconsciously took one step back, even One lowered its body.
And then the ground started to move.
[First Root Dominion.]
The dead roots that had been lying dry and lifeless on the ground until a few moments ago suddenly shook.
One.
Ten.
Then dozens.
They came out of the ground, some white, some black and some so dry that they should have broken from a simple touch.
But under Caelus’s Skill, they moved like huge snakes.
The first root shot toward Seris, she cut it with her sword and the cut part fell to the ground but the remaining end suddenly split into two branches.
Seris frowned.
Two more roots came from the left and right, she cut one, jumped over the other and a third root came up from under her feet.
She turned her body and moved it away with the edge of her sword, although suddenly the number increased.
Four.
Eight.
Twelve.
One did not stay aside anymore, it jumped forward with a rough sound and its huge jaws closed around one of the roots.
With the huge force it used, the root broke in the middle.
One directly entered the group of roots, its natural armor took the attacks, and with its powerful legs it pressed several roots into the ground.
Then without slowing down, it Charged toward Caelus.
The leader of the Cindari looked at it and the huge ant closed the distance with brutal power.
The man moved aside but One changed its path at the last moment, its head and front part of its body hit Caelus’s side.
A heavy sound of impact was heard and the enemy was thrown several meters into the air, he landed on his feet and slid several more meters backward.
"So that ant isn’t only a means of transportation..." Aren said in disbelief and then looked at himself, he was not happy that he was the only one watching from the side.
He could not use all of his previous power, every time he raised his Mana too much, it put direct pressure on his Mana Channels.
But this pain was nothing compared to the victory they could gain and if he kept standing there, Seris and One would sooner or later be buried under the number of roots.
He put his hand on the ground, forced Mana through his Channels, pain immediately moved from his arm to his shoulder, he pressed his teeth together but endured it!
[Earth Spear.]
The ground under Caelus exploded, three stone spears came out from under his feet and forced him to dodge.
The second passed beside his body and the third forced him to take one step back.
Aren also put his other hand on the ground.
[Stone Coffin.]
Four thick walls of earth and stone rose around Caelus, closing from four directions and a roof also formed above them.
For several seconds the man was completely trapped inside.
Seris immediately saw the chance, lowered her sword and then, contrary to what Aren expected, put it inside its sheath.
[Stargrave Draw.]
Mana started gathering, not outside the blade but inside it and the pressure was compressed along the metal.
Every second that the sword remained inside the sheath, more energy was compressed into a single Slash, but this Skill had one clear weakness, Seris could not freely attack while Charging.
One stood between her and the Stone Coffin while Aren used all his remaining strength to keep the Coffin in place.
Although a strike came from inside and the right wall cracked.
The second strike came and the cracks became larger!
The leader of the Cindari wanted to force his way out! And considering the power he had, they only had a few seconds!
"Faster! I can’t hold him any longer."
Seris did not answer, Mana was still gathering, it was not time yet.
But when the third strike came from inside, part of the Stone Coffin broke, finally Caelus’s hand came out through the stone.
The dead roots around them started wrapping around the walls.
Aren put almost all of his remaining Mana into the ground, and the pain became stronger.
He was sure that he could not endure the enemy’s next attack, if only one more strike came from inside, the Coffin would definitely break! This was his limit!
"Now!" Seris opened her eyes, her hand on the hilt and finally pulled out the sword!
[Stargrave Draw.]
There was no big explosion, only a thin and almost invisible line from in front of Seris to the horizon of the Dead Zone.
For a fraction of a second, nothing happened, then the Stone Coffin split into two from the center.
The dry tree behind it was also cut along the same line, the huge trunk started sliding with a delay.
And part of Caelus’s side had been cut open and the wound continued from his lower ribs to his waist and a large amount of blood fell onto the ground.
Aren held his breath, it was one of the most incredible sword skills he had ever seen.
Seris raised her sword again, just because her attack had succeeded did not mean they had won and they needed to keep their guard up.

"I won’t hold back anymore, I didn’t want to go this far but it seems I have no choice." But Caelus was still standing, he looked at the wound on his side and then at the blood on the ground and then opened his hand.
[Father’s Blood.]
The blood on the ground shook, the drops rose against gravity and red threads separated from the ground and returned toward Caelus’s body.
The wound started closing, the flesh did not dry, it did not freeze but actually joined together.
The veins connected again, the skin closed over it.
Only a few seconds later, nothing remained of the deep wound except a red line.
"What the hell is this..." Seris said with a frown.
"Your time to die has come..." This time Caelus did not smile, it was clear that he was angry and the Mana around him changed.

"I won’t hold back anymore, I didn’t want to go this far but it seems I have no choice." But Caelus was still standing, he looked at the wound on his side and then at the blood on the ground and then opened his hand.
[Father’s Blood.]
The blood on the ground shook, the drops rose against gravity and red threads separated from the ground and returned toward Caelus’s body.
The wound started closing, the flesh did not dry, it did not freeze but actually joined together.
The veins connected again, the skin closed over it.
Only a few seconds later, nothing remained of the deep wound except a red line.
"What the hell is this..." Seris said with a frown.
"Your time to die has come..." This time Caelus did not smile, it was clear that he was angry and the Mana around him changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: The Forgotten Tree X
paragraphs: [Rootless Step.]
For a moment, the Cindari leader’s feet sank into the roots beneath the ground and his body disappeared. Not with normal speed, but as if the ground itself had swallowed him.
Seris immediately sensed the danger, but Caelus was not heading toward her.
"Aren!"
Aren turned around, but it was already too late!
The Cindari leader emerged from the dead roots right behind him.
The native of the Ruined Realm raised both of his hands.
[Earth Wall.]
A thick wall rose between them and Caelus punched it, the stone exploded and broken pieces hit Aren in the face.
The second punch landed directly on his chest, Aren was lifted from the ground and thrown several meters away ... he rolled across the ground and the air was forced out of his lungs.
One roared and attacked again, the roots wrapped around his legs but One moved forward with raw power.
The first root was torn apart ... the second ... the third, the fourth held him for a few moments but he turned his body and broke it as well.
Among the three of them, One had the highest Level and the greatest raw power and his jaws were so powerful that they could destroy almost anything.
Their opponent might be Level 35, but with the power all three of them had, especially the young Pendragon, fighting him had become possible.
But victory was not certain, especially now that their enemy had started attacking with all his power.
Seris attacked from the other side and Caelus was forced to activate Crown of Thorns again.
But this time Seris and One were coordinated, the former lowered her head and the latter ran directly across the armor on her back.
One step.
Second.
The giant ant threw its body upward at that exact moment and She was launched into the air like a Projectile, her sword rising with her.
[King’s Breaker.]
The first strike hit Crown of Thorns.
Crack!
Seris spun in the air and brought her sword down with power again, and the second strike landed.
The cracks became larger!
The third strike and finally the Barrier broke!
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
A rain of Slashes fell on Caelus from above, one on his shoulder, one on his face, three cuts on his arm, two lines across his chest.
The Cindari leader took several steps back and there were so many wounds that he could not close all of them at once.
Seris landed, but at that exact moment her Predator-like instinct sensed danger from a blind angle.
Unfortunately, it was too late and one of the roots from First Root Dominion came in from behind.
Its white tip pierced directly through her thigh, the root blade entered from the back of her leg and came out from the front of her thigh and warm blood spilled onto her boot.
Seris held her breath for a moment, but she did not scream.
She lowered her hand, grabbed the root and pulled it out of her body in one movement, causing even more blood to gush out.
Her knee bent for a moment, but she still remained standing.
"Your toughness, you truly deserve to serve Father." Caelus gave her a brief look.
"Shut up." Seris raised her sword.
One Charged again, this time the Cindari did not move away, his eyes became cold and he lowered his hand toward the ground.
[First Root: Impaling Bloom.]
The ground beneath One split open, the first root shot out like a huge spear, the ant moved his body aside and the root passed beside his armor.
The second came from the left, he caught it with his jaws and a cracking sound rang out.
But the third ... came out from a point exactly beneath his stomach, there was no time left to escape and the tip of the root entered the soft part beneath his armor.
A moment later, it came out from the upper part of his stomach, One’s cry of pain filled the entire Dead Zone, dark blood splashed across the white root.
A thick liquid flowed down from the wound in his body.
"One!" Seris lost control of her expression for the first time.
The ant struggled with his legs ... his jaws opened and closed, but the root lifted his body into the air.
Caelus moved his hand, the root also twisted and One’s stomach wound opened even more.
Then with another movement, the giant ant’s body was thrown several meters through the air, directly into one of the huge roots of the Forgotten Tree.
The sound of his natural armor breaking could be heard and pieces of his black shell fell onto the ground ... One fell, his legs moved for several seconds.
He tried to stand up.
One leg.
Second.
Then his body fell onto the ground again ... he was alive, barely and in very bad condition ... but he could no longer fight.
Aren saw the scene and something changed in his expression.
He had not even known One for very long.
But seeing a creature that had helped them and fought for them so honestly made his anger grow even more.
He slammed both hands onto the ground and forced Mana through his Channels, the skin around them burned and pain moved through his body like a blade.
But Aren did not back down.
[Earth Titan’s Grasp.]
The ground rose on both sides of Caelus, two huge stone hands formed, each several meters tall, and the stone fingers closed from both sides.
The Cindari leader was trapped between them, the pressure increased and the stones began to break.
"Seris!" Aren shouted.
Seris moved forward with her injured leg, but Caelus did not allow it anymore.
[Father’s Thorn.]
The ground beneath Aren shook, he sensed the first blade and pulled his body backward, a thin black root passed beside his body.
For a moment, he thought he had dodged it, but then the second blade came out from another angle.
He did not even have time to look and then came the cut!
For a moment there was no pain, only a feeling of becoming lighter, then his right arm was separated above the elbow and fell onto the ground.
Blood came out with force and Aren opened his mouth, his scream had not even fully come out when the third attack came.
Another root came from the left, his second arm was also cut off and both hands fell onto the ground.
He fell onto his knees, this time his scream was loud and blood from both severed arms flowed over his chest and onto the ground, his face became pale within seconds.
He had lost both of his hands ...
"I told you ... you angered Father... and your time to die has come!" the Cindari leader growled with the same cold calmness.
"Shut up!" Seris changed her path for a moment and cold anger could be seen in her eyes.
Aren breathed in short, broken breaths and tried to control Mana without his hands, the ground around his wounds rose.
Soil and stones were pressed against the severed parts, only pressure, to reduce the bleeding, but even this caused more pain.
Aren fell onto the ground, he was conscious, but he was almost out of the fight.
Now only Seris remained, her right leg had been pierced, and there were several cuts on her shoulder.
Her side was wounded by one of the Root Slashes, blood had dried on her clothes and fresh blood was mixed with it, and her breathing had become heavy.
Her Mana reserve had dropped very low, but she was still holding her sword.
"Surrender." Caelus came out from the remains of Earth Titan’s Grasp and several pieces of stone fell from his robe.
"No." Seris wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth with the back of her hand.

"Why? Does the life of one Human matter so much to you? There are so many of you, aren’t there?" The Cindari leader looked toward the Cocoon, as if he wanted to check its condition, and then looked back at her.
"It doesn’t matter." The young Pendragon felt like she had just heard one of the stupidest possible reasons and then looked at One and Aren for a moment.
"And Lian wants her to be protected, so I’ll protect her."
She wouldn’t and couldn’t let anything happen to that Cocoon.

chapters.title: Chapter 335: The Forgotten Tree XI
paragraphs: "Lian? Who is he?" Caelus asked with some curiosity.
Seris did not continue the conversation, she knew normal attacks were not enough.
King’s Breaker.
Moonless Severance.
Thousand Petal Swordstorm.
Even Stargrave Draw.
All of them had wounded him, but none of them had been able to bring him down and there was one Skill left, the strongest attack she had.
And using it would take almost all of her remaining Mana, but did she have any other choice? If she did not use all of her remaining power, all of them would die here.
She held the sword with both hands and planted her injured leg firmly on the ground, then closed her eyes.
The remaining Mana rose from her entire body and all of it entered the sword.
[Heavenfall Execution.]
The air changed.
Caelus raised his head, there were no real clouds in the sky.
But the light of the Dead Zone became darker, Mana gathered high above, not in the form of a giant sword but something much simpler and more frightening.
A line ... from the sky to the target.
As if Seris had turned the space between him and the sky into a place of Execution.
Anything inside that line had to be cut, Caelus did not wait this time and lowered both of his hands.
[First Root Dominion: Crowned Sanctuary.]
The ground exploded all around him, dozens of huge roots rose.
White.
Black.
Golden.
They wrapped around Caelus in several layers, forming a huge dome.
"Die!" Seris opened her eyes, the sword came down.
Heavenfall Execution descended!
At first there was silence.
Then destructive pressure spread across the entire dead field beneath them.
The first layer of Crowned Sanctuary shattered instantly.
The second cracked, the third exploded and the roots scattered through the air like pieces of wood.
The ground split, a wave of gray dust spread outward from the center.
Aren lowered his body against the ground.
Even while injured, One was pushed back several centimeters by the pressure.
The sound of the explosion continued for several seconds and then dust rose into the air.
Seris was almost leaning on her sword, she could barely breathe, her Mana was almost completely gone and she even received a system notification that her remaining Mana was below 5 percent.
But her eyes were still fixed on the center of the battlefield, hoping to see the result of that bastard’s destruction ...
The dust slowly cleared, Crowned Sanctuary had been destroyed and Caelus was standing in the middle of a broken crater.
No.
For a moment, he had one knee on the ground, a large part of his white robe was gone, and the skin on his shoulder and chest had been torn open.
Blood ran down his face, one of his arms had a deep wound but he was alive.
"Damn it..." Seris whispered.
"For a Human... you’re too troublesome." The Cindari leader said with some pain and annoyance.
[Rootless Step.]
Seris barely reacted, her sword rose, but she was in no condition to do anything anymore.
Caelus appeared in front of her, the first strike came and metal collided with a hard root.
The young Pendragon barely defended herself.
The second strike and her sword moved several centimeters backward.
The third strike and Seris’s hands shook, she was reaching her limit!
Caelus increased his speed.
The girl followed him with her eyes but she practically had no Mana left, and her injured leg also limited her speed.
A thin blade made of root formed in Caelus’s hand and the attack came directly toward her face.
Seris pulled her head back but it was too late!
The blade passed over her left eye and pain exploded inside her skull ... for a moment she could not see anything.
Blood immediately covered half of her face and her injured eye did not open again, she lost her balance.
During that attack, one of her eyes had been completely pierced and destroyed.
Caelus did not stop and placed his palm against her chest, releasing pressure.
Seris was lifted from the ground, her body flew directly into one of the huge roots of the Forgotten Tree.
The sound of bone and wood colliding rang out, the sword left her hand and fell several meters away on the ground.
She fell down ... for several seconds she did not move.
Blood from her destroyed eye, nose and the corner of her mouth dripped onto the ground.
Her entire body hurt.
One was unable to move, Aren was almost unconscious and had lost both hands and now Seris no longer had the strength to stand either.
For several seconds, the Dead Zone became silent again.
Then—
THUMP.
Everyone who was still conscious turned their heads toward the Cocoon.
The roots around the Cocoon suddenly contracted and a panel appeared in front of Seris’s only remaining eye.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 83.4%]
Her healthy eye opened wider and the number changed again.
Then
"No..." Seris tried to pull herself up with her elbow.
And the final number appeared.
And stopped.
Now almost half of the Cocoon was covered with black veins, the golden light could barely be seen in some parts.
Selina’s body moved more inside the Cocoon, her fingers curled, her head tilted for a moment, her lips opened, but no sound came out.
Caelus stared at the Cocoon, and then something broke inside his expression.
Calmness ... control ... that cold and royal face ... all of it disappeared and he raised his head toward the gray sky.
He opened his hands, a sick smile appeared on his face.
"Oh... Heavenly Father..."
"Oh Father of all darkness..."
His eyes were full of madness, not the madness of a moment, but the madness of someone who had waited for this day for years.
"Oh Father..." A broken laugh came from his throat.
"Soon, one of your children will be free again."
Even in his condition, Aren’s expression changed for a moment.
One of your children.
Not "Black Silence".
One of the children.
That meant perhaps The Black Silence was only one of something much greater.
Caelus continued looking at the sky, his hands open and a smile on his face, as if he were standing in a holy temple instead of in the middle of a Dead Zone.
And because of this, he did not see something, the quiet sound of a body being dragged across the ground.
Seris was still moving, she could not stand, she could not even stay on both knees.
She had placed one hand on the ground and used it to pull herself forward, her injured leg dragged behind her.
Blood from her left eye ran down her cheek and chin and fell drop by drop onto the gray ground.
She was not far from the Cocoon, five meters ... four.
Caelus finally heard the movement, lowered his head and looked at the girl who was dragging herself forward for a moment.
An almost amused expression returned to his face.
"You’re still alive?"
Seris did not answer, she moved another meter forward and her hand touched something metallic ... the sword hilt and her fingers closed around it.
"What are you trying to do, Human?" The Cindari leader looked more carefully this time.
The young Pendragon pulled the sword toward herself and painfully raised her body onto one knee.
The Cocoon was directly in front of her, three meters ... maybe less.
"I won’t let you kill her." Lian’s sentence returned to her mind.
Seris knew why Lian had said this, at least part of the reason.
Selina was their friend, perhaps she could be saved, she understood that, no one wanted to watch their friend die.
But Lian was no longer here, it was not clear when he would return, while a crazy and mentally unstable Cindari was here instead.
And if the Cocoon reached one hundred percent, not only Selina, but their entire world would no longer remain.
All the other Awakened who were in the Special Area would also be killed ...
Seris could not bet everything on the unclear possibility that Lian would eventually find a way.
Not when the number was 92, not when the man who called this Calamity a "Child of Father" was standing several meters away.
If she destroyed this Calamity, the Main Quest would be completed and all the Awakened could return to their own world and sacrificing one person was worth it.
Her mouth was full of blood and she spat it onto the ground, her healthy eye closed for a moment.
"I’m sorry, Lian." She said quietly.
She held the sword with both hands, her body was shaking, almost no Mana remained, less than 5 percent of her Mana was left, which was a terrible amount.
But she put every small amount that remained into the blade.
Caelus did not understand for several seconds, then his eyes moved from Seris to the Cocoon.
His expression changed instantly, the madness and satisfaction disappeared and were replaced by fear.
"No—"
Seris put all of her body weight behind the attack, the sword rose and then came down with all her strength.
Directly toward the heart of the Cocoon.
The blade moved toward the semi-transparent surface of the Cocoon at high speed.
One meter.
Half a meter.
A few centimeters.
And right before impact--

But Lian was no longer here, it was not clear when he would return, while a crazy and mentally unstable Cindari was here instead.
And if the Cocoon reached one hundred percent, not only Selina, but their entire world would no longer remain.
All the other Awakened who were in the Special Area would also be killed ...
Seris could not bet everything on the unclear possibility that Lian would eventually find a way.
Not when the number was 92, not when the man who called this Calamity a "Child of Father" was standing several meters away.
If she destroyed this Calamity, the Main Quest would be completed and all the Awakened could return to their own world and sacrificing one person was worth it.
Her mouth was full of blood and she spat it onto the ground, her healthy eye closed for a moment.
"I’m sorry, Lian." She said quietly.
She held the sword with both hands, her body was shaking, almost no Mana remained, less than 5 percent of her Mana was left, which was a terrible amount.
But she put every small amount that remained into the blade.
Caelus did not understand for several seconds, then his eyes moved from Seris to the Cocoon.
His expression changed instantly, the madness and satisfaction disappeared and were replaced by fear.
"No—"
Seris put all of her body weight behind the attack, the sword rose and then came down with all her strength.
Directly toward the heart of the Cocoon.
The blade moved toward the semi-transparent surface of the Cocoon at high speed.
One meter.
Half a meter.
A few centimeters.
And right before impact--

chapters.title: Chapter 336: The Forgotten tree XII
paragraphs: Seris’s sword came down.
All the Mana remaining in her body, all the strength still left in the muscles of her blood-covered arms, and even the last bit of her strength were put into that one strike.
She no longer cared what happened after that.
She did not care how Lian would react.
She did not care whether Selina could still be saved or not.
The only thing she could see with her healthy eye was one number.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 92.0%]
Eight percent more.
There were only eight percent between something that could still be stopped and the birth of a new Calamity Vessel.
The sword came down with all its power toward the semi-transparent surface of the Cocoon.
Caelus completely lost his calm, his eyes widened and his hand moved forward without thinking.
"No!" This was what he and his predecessors had planned and prepared for over many years.
He could not let the new Vessel be destroyed at any cost! Otherwise, Father would become angry!
But the distance was too great.
Rootless Step also needed a fraction of a second to reach Seris.
And he did not have that fraction of a second.
The edge of the sword was only a few centimeters away from the Cocoon.
Four centimeters.
Three.
Two.
Then—
Blue light cut across the entire battlefield.
[Thunder Step.]
The sound of thunder like a compressed explosion spread right in front of the Forgotten Tree.
Exactly between the sword and the Cocoon, something appeared from inside the blue light.
A hand.
And just before the blade hit the surface of the Cocoon, the fingers closed around the edge of the sword.
The sound of metal hitting skin spread through the air.
The remaining Sword Aura was released from the blade and a short wave of Mana spread between the roots, pushing the soil under their feet several centimeters away.
Several white strands of the Cocoon moved because of the pressure.
But the sword stopped, completely and did not move down even a single centimeter.
Seris did not understand what had happened for a moment, her healthy eye first stopped on the hand holding her sword.
The skin on the fingers had turned dark gray and several blue sparks moved between the joints.
Then her gaze slowly moved up.
The forearm.
The shoulder.
The dusty and torn clothes.
And finally, a familiar face that should not have been there at that moment.
Lian.
Thunder was still moving around his legs, gray dust covered his shoulders and hair, and even part of his sleeve was burned.
His breathing was a little heavier than usual, not like someone who had run out of breath after a battle, more like someone who had traveled an unreasonable distance without stopping even once.
He first looked at the edge of the sword stopped in his palm.
Then he looked at Seris, saying nothing for several seconds, as if he was trying to understand the situation.
"I told you not to kill her." He then said calmly.
Seris looked at him with only one eye, and for a moment something like disbelief could be seen on her blood-covered face.
Then the corner of her lips moved slightly upward, so little that if Lian had not been looking directly at her, he might not have noticed.
"You’re late.
Those two words were the last thing she could say without difficulty, the strength left her fingers and the sword became loose in her hand.
Her legs could no longer support her weight.
Seris fell forward.
Lian let go of the sword and caught her around the body before she hit the ground.
The girl’s weight fell onto him and at that moment he finally had the chance to really see what had happened.
A few minutes ago, he had not had such a chance, he had only felt the pain.
One’s pain.
A few minutes ago, Rootcrown had entered full Lockdown.
The sound of the Alarm was spreading through the entire Lord’s Root Palace, the inner gates were closing one after another.
Hundreds of Guards were moving through the corridors and Mana Barriers were activating along the exit paths.
Lian had just come up from the hidden tomb of Cindar Vael when something suddenly exploded inside his mind.
Through the Hive Link, a pain so strong that his steps stopped for a moment.
He did not receive a clear image, but One’s feelings were clearer than any image.
Pain.
Pressure.
Then something warm leaving One’s body, blood and more importantly, a sudden and serious weakness.
One had been injured and not with an ordinary wound, but something serious enough that the Hive Link transferred it to Lian with all its strength.
At that moment he had made his decision, it was clear that something bad had happened near the Forgotten Tree and he had to return as soon as possible.
Abyss Veil was turned off, he no longer cared who saw him.
The first group of Guards appeared in front of him when he left the Archive.
"Stop—"
[Thunder Step.]
Lian passed through them.
The second group created a Barrier across the corridor, he did not even slow down.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
His shoulder hit the Barrier.
The Mana glass across the entire corridor cracked, a moment later it exploded. The next gate was made of Steel.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Lian’s fist hit its center directly, the sound of thunder shook the entire floor and the several-hundred-kilogram metal gate was torn from its frame and thrown into the next hall.
The Guards moved aside, some tried to chase him but none of them even came close.
[Fallen Wolf Speed.]
[Thunder Step.]
Again.
And again.
And again.
Lian was no longer following the exit path, he was following the shortest path, if there was a wall between him and outside, the wall broke.
If there was a Barrier, the Barrier was destroyed, if a Guard came in front of him, he was hit only hard enough that he could no longer be an obstacle.
Chaos had spread across the entire Cindari city because of his behavior and actions, everyone was terrified about what had happened and was trying to deal with the threat.
But this threat was so fast that they could not see him with their naked eyes at all.
In less than a few dozen seconds, he had passed through the inner area, then the outer wall of Rootcrown and then Emberroot.
And from that moment on, Lian had combined Thunder Step with Fallen Wolf Speed almost without stopping.
Mana was being consumed at an alarming speed, it did not matter.
Every time he felt the Hive Link, One’s pain did not become weaker ... it became worse!
And when the Forgotten Tree finally appeared in the distance, Lian had traveled almost the entire last path with Thunder Step.
Exactly when Seris’s sword was coming down.
And now in the present.
Lian held Seris’s body in his arms.
And now he saw it, this girl’s armor almost no longer had its original color, blood covered a large part of it.
Her right thigh had been pierced and dried and fresh blood could be seen on both sides of the wound.
Her side had been cut open, there were several deep cuts on her shoulder and arms.
Her lips were cracked, but the worst part was her face, the left side of her face was completely covered in blood and her left eye remained closed.
And even without checking further, Lian understood that the eye was no longer healthy.
’Did all of this happen while I was gone? What happened after I left?’ He thought to himself.
"Cocoon..." Seris took a short breath, her voice was weaker than usual.
"Ninety-two percent."
Lian turned his head slightly.
The panel immediately appeared.
[Black Silence Fetus]
[State: Gestating]
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 92.0%]
The number was stable, at least for now.
"One..." Seris closed her healthy eyelid for a moment, then said only one word.
Lian did not need to ask.
The pain was still reaching his mind through the Hive Link, but what he felt was different from what he saw now.
He turned his head.
One was lying several dozen meters away beside one of the huge roots of the Forgotten Tree.
Part of the natural armor on his stomach was broken, a large hole went through the lower part of his body and dark blood had gathered under his body, making the gray soil almost black.
Several armor plates on his side were cracked, two of his legs still moved sometimes, and his antennae also showed a weak reaction.
He was alive.
But his condition was even worse than what Lian had imagined through the Hive Link.
Then his eyes fell on Aren, the man was lying several meters away on the ground, his face was almost completely white.
Two arms ... were gone, both had been cut off above the elbows.
Compressed soil and stone around the wounds had partly stopped the bleeding, but a large pool of blood had formed under his body.
Then Lian looked at Seris again, and finally raised his head, Caelus Vael was still standing in the same place.
Among everyone on the battlefield, he was the healthiest.
There were wounds on his body, part of his robe was torn, and traces of blood remained on his chest and face.
But compared to Seris, Aren and One, he looked almost unharmed.
Lian’s gaze fixed on him, and something in the atmosphere changed.
There was nothing visible, but even Seris in her half-conscious state noticed it.
Lian was angry.
Very angry and the angrier he became, the calmer he seemed.
Lian did not shout, he did not threaten him, he simply carefully placed the girl beside one of the healthier roots of the Forgotten Tree.
He took a Recovery Potion from his Inventory.
"Drink this."
Seris looked at the bottle, then very slowly raised her hand and pushed the Potion away.
Lian made a very small frown.
Without arguing, Seris opened her own Inventory.
Three Potions came out of her storage space, she drank one immediately and then placed another beside herself.
"I have some, it won’t take more than a few minutes." What she meant was clear.
She had no plan to simply lie in one corner during the rest of the battle.
She was the kind of person who had to take revenge herself ... and today, no matter the cost, she would tear apart with her own hands that bastard who had destroyed her eye!

chapters.title: Chapter 337: The Forgotten Tree XIII
paragraphs: "Good." Lian nodded and did not argue, he knew there was no point in arguing with this stubborn girl.
He turned around, first heading toward Aren, then he knelt beside him, the latter slowly opened his eyes with difficulty and when he saw him, he gave a very weak smile.
"Finally..."
Lian took out a stronger Healing Potion.
"Open your mouth."
Aren did not even have the energy to protest and took the Potion from him.
The liquid entered his body, a very weak light appeared around his wounds, and the bleeding decreased.
The open tissues started to close, but his arms did not return, the Potion could keep Aren alive.
It could not regenerate two severed limbs from nothing.
Lian looked at the two hands lying on the ground, there was no time for complete treatment for now.
If reconnecting or Regeneration was possible later, they had to act quickly, but for now, only staying alive mattered.
Then he stood up and went toward One without wasting any time.
With every step he got closer, the pain coming through the Hive Link became clearer.
When he reached the giant ant, he placed his hand on the healthy part of its head.
One moved its antenna very weakly, and the feeling was immediately transferred.
Pain, anger, and ... shame, and deep inside all of them, happiness that Lian had returned.
"That’s enough, sorry I was late." Lian kept his hand there for a moment.
He took another Potion from his Inventory, the amount was small for One’s huge body, but it could stop the process of death.
He poured the liquid directly into its mouth.
Then through the Hive Link, he sent only one command.
Stay alive.
The response was very weak, but it came, pain and obedience and something like stubbornness.
Lian pulled his hand back and slowly stood up.
Now there was nothing left between him and Caelus.
The leader of the Cindari had been watching him the whole time, he had neither attacked nor tried to touch the Cocoon.
Lian’s sudden arrival had changed the situation that had been completely under his control only a few moments ago.
His eyes stayed on the Human for a few seconds, then on the Cocoon, and finally on the sword that was still lying beside Seris.
"I did not expect a Human to appear at the last moment, but I have to thank you for saving His Majesty." Caelus took a calm breath and a smile appeared on his face.
Lian, who was walking toward him, stopped, looked at him for a few seconds, and then looked at the Cocoon.
Selina was still floating motionlessly inside the Cocoon, and Black veins could be seen on part of her neck.
His gaze returned to Caelus.
"His Majesty?" For a moment, he really thought he might have heard wrong, and his eyebrows rose slightly.
"You just called the Calamity that almost destroyed your entire world before... His Majesty?"
"That’s right." Caelus answered without the slightest hesitation.
Lian stayed silent for a few moments, no, he had not heard wrong, an idiot had really called the thing that almost destroyed their world His Majesty!
Of course, he did not simply think it was because the man was stupid, he definitely knew there was a bigger reason behind it.
Something like serving a Calamity...?

"You Outsiders don’t understand, you are one-dimensional, short-sighted and empty, and what you call a Calamity... is actually a Blessing." Caelus continued, and something like worship and fanaticism appeared in his eyes.
"Now I’m sure you’re crazy." Lian looked at him for a few seconds, then gave a short laugh, not because he found it funny but because he could not believe it.
His smile disappeared as quickly as it had appeared, and his gaze became cold, the images of the Tomb returned to his mind.
Cindar Vael.
A body in Suspended Death, 0.03% biological activity.
The dying Forgotten Tree, the Black Silence Fetus, Selina as the new Vessel,
And the conclusion he had reached himself.
Cindar could not control these events in his current state, there had to be someone else, someone who would continue his plan.
And now a man was standing in front of Lian who knew about the Cocoon, knew about the Gestation Progress, and had entered the Dead Zone without any fear.
He was the current leader of all the Cindari, he called The Black Silence "His Majesty" and called the one responsible for destroying his own world a Blessing.
The pieces fit together too well.
"So it’s you.
"The one continuing the work of that corpse under Rootcrown."

Caelus’s expression really changed, not a small frown like during the battle and not simple surprise, but his eyes opened wider for a fraction of a second, even the calm Mana around him fluctuated for a moment.
"You... entered that place?" How? How had a Human entered that place? He was sure he had placed the best security systems in the Archive and the hidden floor!
Then how!?

"Of course, but there was nothing in the First Archive, but what was underneath it was much more interesting, Cindar Vael, Suspended Death, a body that had been kept almost dead for hundreds of years, but not completely, I found many interesting things." Lian got closer to the enemy with every word that came out of his mouth.
Caelus’s eyes became colder with every sentence.
"The one who betrayed the old leaders during the Final Battle against the Corrupted Titan..."
For a moment, Aurelia’s words played through his mind again.
"And even before that, he allowed the Black Silence to enter this world..." His eyes were fixed directly on Caelus.
"Cindar is that traitor, right? You are also one of the dogs continuing his path, aren’t you?"
For a few seconds, no one spoke.
Even Caelus, and then the corner of his lips rose slightly, but this time his smile was different from before, colder, more ruthless, and filled with killing intent.
"You understood more than you should have, but Traitor is not the right word." There was even something like pride in his voice.
"Brother Cindar made the right choice, he was the first one to accept the truth."
"The first one who understood that true salvation does not come from resisting Father." His eyes shone slightly.
"...But from worshiping him."
"Brother Cindar? God Father? Are you guys part of some cult?" Lian looked at him for a few seconds and then burst into laughter.
Caelus showed no reaction, but that itself was enough of an answer.
"Very well." The young Vorhelm’s smile disappeared and he took another step forward.
"Then before I kill you, I have a few questions for you."
Caelus narrowed his eyes slightly, but Lian was no longer looking at him.
He opened his panel.
[Power: 750]
[Spirit: 450]
[Speed: 500]
[Mana: 975]
[Resistance: 533]
[Free Stat Points: 792]
His eyes stayed on the last number, during everything that had happened recently, he had not had the chance to really use them.
These points had been earned, they were only waiting to be assigned and he no longer saw any reason to keep them.
A Level 35 was standing in front of him.
He had pushed Seris to the edge of death, pierced One, and cut off both of Aren’s arms.
And if he had arrived a few seconds later, the Cocoon would probably have been destroyed too.
Now was no longer the time to save them.
[physical Strength +250]
[physical Strength: 750 → 1000]
[Speed +200]
[Resistance +192]
[Resistance: 533 → 725]
[Mana +100]
And finally
[Spirit +50]
The final panel appeared.
[Status Updated.]
[physical Strength: 1000]
[Spirit: 500]
[Speed: 700]
[Resistance: 725]
[ Stat Points: 0]
Lian opened and closed his right fist for a moment, he immediately felt the difference.
Physical Strength, one thousand.
Speed, seven hundred.
He had now officially reached the peak of power that was possible for him, and he had reached a level that no Awakened below the First Evolution had ever reached in all of history.
He had officially set a new record.
The most powerful young Awakened in history below the First Evolution... a record that was far better than the previous best, and he highly doubted anyone in history could reach it.
Caelus also felt the change, his expression became a little more serious, he did not know why, but he had a bad feeling.
He might not be able to see Lian’s panel, but the sudden increase in physical pressure and Mana could not be hidden.
"Your friend also thought he could kill me, you saw the result." He then said and pointed toward Seris, a mocking smile appearing on his face.
"Yeah." Lian looked at Seris for a moment and then looked back at Caelus.
"Then you should understand the difference between—" The Cindari leader sneered, but before he could finish his sentence...
[Thunder Step.]
The rest of the sentence was never said.
Even Caelus, with Level 35, saw only blue light for a fraction of a second.
Seven hundred Speed with Thunder Step was nothing like what he had faced a few minutes ago.
Lian appeared directly in front of his face and the distance between them became zero.
Caelus could only open his eyes wider, and his right fist was already pulled back.
Blue and white lightning wrapped around his arm.
[Thunder Calamity.]
One thousand physical Strength was released in a short movement.
There was no need for a big Swing, there was no need for long Momentum, the distance was less than half a meter. The fist hit Caelus directly in the jaw!
BOOM!
The sound of the hit was more like an explosion than a fist hitting a face.
Lightning was released at the moment of contact. A circular shockwave pushed the dirt around them away.
The Cindari’s head turned to one side and his feet left the ground, his body was thrown backward as if it had no weight.
The first dry root in his path hit his back.
It broke.
The second one also failed to stop him.
Caelus passed through it.
The third dead tree cracked.
His body was thrown more than thirty meters across the ground and between the roots before finally landing inside a pile of gray dirt and broken wood.
For several seconds, silence filled the area.
Aren raised his head slightly with a pale face.
Seris opened her only healthy eye.
Even One weakly moved one of his antennae.
Where Caelus had fallen, dirt was still in the air, then a movement could be seen, a hand came out from between the pieces of roots.
He slowly pulled himself up, he looked confused, blood was running from the corner of his mouth, the inside of his lip was split.

When he opened his mouth slightly, one of his back teeth was broken, his face was still fine, but the swelling on his jaw became clear within a few seconds... He spat the blood inside his mouth onto the ground.
Then he looked at Lian in disbelief.
The young Vorhelm was still standing in the same place where he had thrown the punch, lightning was moving slowly around his fingers.
His face showed no special emotion, no satisfaction, no pride, no obvious anger, but only coldness, very cold.
"You..." Caelus said with difficulty.
"Your mistake was thinking that because you defeated them... I am also like them." Lian did not let him finish his sentence, he slowly started walking toward him.
"Level 35? I expected more, maybe you won’t believe it, but even a Level 35 ant was at least able to take one of my punches.

sentences.text: "Good." Lian nodded and did not argue, he knew there was no point in arguing with this stubborn girl.
He turned around, first heading toward Aren, then he knelt beside him, the latter slowly opened his eyes with difficulty and when he saw him, he gave a very weak smile.
"Finally..."
Lian took out a stronger Healing Potion.
"Open your mouth."
Aren did not even have the energy to protest and took the Potion from him.
The liquid entered his body, a very weak light appeared around his wounds, and the bleeding decreased.
The open tissues started to close, but his arms did not return, the Potion could keep Aren alive.
It could not regenerate two severed limbs from nothing.
Lian looked at the two hands lying on the ground, there was no time for complete treatment for now.
If reconnecting or Regeneration was possible later, they had to act quickly, but for now, only staying alive mattered.
Then he stood up and went toward One without wasting any time.
With every step he got closer, the pain coming through the Hive Link became clearer.
When he reached the giant ant, he placed his hand on the healthy part of its head.
One moved its antenna very weakly, and the feeling was immediately transferred.
Pain, anger, and ... shame, and deep inside all of them, happiness that Lian had returned.
"That’s enough, sorry I was late." Lian kept his hand there for a moment.
He took another Potion from his Inventory, the amount was small for One’s huge body, but it could stop the process of death.
He poured the liquid directly into its mouth.
Then through the Hive Link, he sent only one command.
Stay alive.
The response was very weak, but it came, pain and obedience and something like stubbornness.
Lian pulled his hand back and slowly stood up.
Now there was nothing left between him and Caelus.
The leader of the Cindari had been watching him the whole time, he had neither attacked nor tried to touch the Cocoon.
Lian’s sudden arrival had changed the situation that had been completely under his control only a few moments ago.
His eyes stayed on the Human for a few seconds, then on the Cocoon, and finally on the sword that was still lying beside Seris.
"I did not expect a Human to appear at the last moment, but I have to thank you for saving His Majesty." Caelus took a calm breath and a smile appeared on his face.
Lian, who was walking toward him, stopped, looked at him for a few seconds, and then looked at the Cocoon.
Selina was still floating motionlessly inside the Cocoon, and Black veins could be seen on part of her neck.
His gaze returned to Caelus.
"His Majesty?" For a moment, he really thought he might have heard wrong, and his eyebrows rose slightly.
"You just called the Calamity that almost destroyed your entire world before...
His Majesty?"
"That’s right." Caelus answered without the slightest hesitation.
Lian stayed silent for a few moments, no, he had not heard wrong, an idiot had really called the thing that almost destroyed their world His Majesty!
Of course, he did not simply think it was because the man was stupid, he definitely knew there was a bigger reason behind it.
Something like serving a Calamity...?

"You Outsiders don’t understand, you are one-dimensional, short-sighted and empty, and what you call a Calamity... is actually a Blessing." Caelus continued, and something like worship and fanaticism appeared in his eyes.
"Now I’m sure you’re crazy." Lian looked at him for a few seconds, then gave a short laugh, not because he found it funny but because he could not believe it.
His smile disappeared as quickly as it had appeared, and his gaze became cold, the images of the Tomb returned to his mind.
Cindar Vael.
A body in Suspended Death, 0.03% biological activity.
The dying Forgotten Tree, the Black Silence Fetus, Selina as the new Vessel,
And the conclusion he had reached himself.
Cindar could not control these events in his current state, there had to be someone else, someone who would continue his plan.
And now a man was standing in front of Lian who knew about the Cocoon, knew about the Gestation Progress, and had entered the Dead Zone without any fear.
He was the current leader of all the Cindari, he called The Black Silence "His Majesty" and called the one responsible for destroying his own world a Blessing.
The pieces fit together too well.
"So it’s you.
"The one continuing the work of that corpse under Rootcrown."

Caelus’s expression really changed, not a small frown like during the battle and not simple surprise, but his eyes opened wider for a fraction of a second, even the calm Mana around him fluctuated for a moment.
"You... entered that place?" How?
How had a Human entered that place?
He was sure he had placed the best security systems in the Archive and the hidden floor!
Then how!?

"Of course, but there was nothing in the First Archive, but what was underneath it was much more interesting, Cindar Vael, Suspended Death, a body that had been kept almost dead for hundreds of years, but not completely, I found many interesting things." Lian got closer to the enemy with every word that came out of his mouth.
Caelus’s eyes became colder with every sentence.
"The one who betrayed the old leaders during the Final Battle against the Corrupted Titan..."
For a moment, Aurelia’s words played through his mind again.
"And even before that, he allowed the Black Silence to enter this world..." His eyes were fixed directly on Caelus.
"Cindar is that traitor, right?
You are also one of the dogs continuing his path, aren’t you?"
For a few seconds, no one spoke.
Even Caelus, and then the corner of his lips rose slightly, but this time his smile was different from before, colder, more ruthless, and filled with killing intent.
"You understood more than you should have, but Traitor is not the right word." There was even something like pride in his voice.
"Brother Cindar made the right choice, he was the first one to accept the truth."
"The first one who understood that true salvation does not come from resisting Father." His eyes shone slightly.
"...But from worshiping him."
"Brother Cindar?
God Father?
Are you guys part of some cult?" Lian looked at him for a few seconds and then burst into laughter.
Caelus showed no reaction, but that itself was enough of an answer.
"Very well." The young Vorhelm’s smile disappeared and he took another step forward.
"Then before I kill you, I have a few questions for you."
Caelus narrowed his eyes slightly, but Lian was no longer looking at him.
He opened his panel.
[Power: 750]
[Spirit: 450]
[Speed: 500]
[Mana: 975]
[Resistance: 533]
[Free Stat Points: 792]
His eyes stayed on the last number, during everything that had happened recently, he had not had the chance to really use them.
These points had been earned, they were only waiting to be assigned and he no longer saw any reason to keep them.
A Level 35 was standing in front of him.
He had pushed Seris to the edge of death, pierced One, and cut off both of Aren’s arms.
And if he had arrived a few seconds later, the Cocoon would probably have been destroyed too.
Now was no longer the time to save them.
[physical Strength +250]
[physical Strength: 750 → 1000]
[Speed +200]
[Resistance +192]
[Resistance: 533 → 725]
[Mana +100]
And finally
[Spirit +50]
The final panel appeared.
[Status Updated.]
[physical Strength: 1000]
[Spirit: 500]
[Speed: 700]
[Resistance: 725]
[ Stat Points: 0]
Lian opened and closed his right fist for a moment, he immediately felt the difference.
Physical Strength, one thousand.
Speed, seven hundred.
He had now officially reached the peak of power that was possible for him, and he had reached a level that no Awakened below the First Evolution had ever reached in all of history.
He had officially set a new record.
The most powerful young Awakened in history below the First Evolution... a record that was far better than the previous best, and he highly doubted anyone in history could reach it.
Caelus also felt the change, his expression became a little more serious, he did not know why, but he had a bad feeling.
He might not be able to see Lian’s panel, but the sudden increase in physical pressure and Mana could not be hidden.
"Your friend also thought he could kill me, you saw the result." He then said and pointed toward Seris, a mocking smile appearing on his face.
"Yeah." Lian looked at Seris for a moment and then looked back at Caelus.
"Then you should understand the difference between—" The Cindari leader sneered, but before he could finish his sentence...
[Thunder Step.]
The rest of the sentence was never said.
Even Caelus, with Level 35, saw only blue light for a fraction of a second.
Seven hundred Speed with Thunder Step was nothing like what he had faced a few minutes ago.
Lian appeared directly in front of his face and the distance between them became zero.
Caelus could only open his eyes wider, and his right fist was already pulled back.
Blue and white lightning wrapped around his arm.
[Thunder Calamity.]
One thousand physical Strength was released in a short movement.
There was no need for a big Swing, there was no need for long Momentum, the distance was less than half a meter.
The fist hit Caelus directly in the jaw!
BOOM!
The sound of the hit was more like an explosion than a fist hitting a face.
Lightning was released at the moment of contact.
A circular shockwave pushed the dirt around them away.
The Cindari’s head turned to one side and his feet left the ground, his body was thrown backward as if it had no weight.
The first dry root in his path hit his back.
It broke.
The second one also failed to stop him.
Caelus passed through it.
The third dead tree cracked.
His body was thrown more than thirty meters across the ground and between the roots before finally landing inside a pile of gray dirt and broken wood.
For several seconds, silence filled the area.
Aren raised his head slightly with a pale face.
Seris opened her only healthy eye.
Even One weakly moved one of his antennae.
Where Caelus had fallen, dirt was still in the air, then a movement could be seen, a hand came out from between the pieces of roots.
He slowly pulled himself up, he looked confused, blood was running from the corner of his mouth, the inside of his lip was split.
When he opened his mouth slightly, one of his back teeth was broken, his face was still fine, but the swelling on his jaw became clear within a few seconds...
He spat the blood inside his mouth onto the ground.
Then he looked at Lian in disbelief.
The young Vorhelm was still standing in the same place where he had thrown the punch, lightning was moving slowly around his fingers.
His face showed no special emotion, no satisfaction, no pride, no obvious anger, but only coldness, very cold.
"You..." Caelus said with difficulty.
"Your mistake was thinking that because you defeated them...
I am also like them." Lian did not let him finish his sentence, he slowly started walking toward him.
"Level 35?
I expected more, maybe you won’t believe it, but even a Level 35 ant was at least able to take one of my punches.

chapters.title: Chapter 338: The Forgotten Tree XIV
paragraphs: After Lian’s words echoed through the area, Caelus only stared at him, the strange confidence that had been on his face since he entered the Forgotten Tree had still not disappeared, but now something could be seen behind it.
Anger of course not explosive anger, not the kind of anger that made him lose control, but a cold kind of anger that came from being humiliated.
He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth with the back of his hand.
"Human..."
But Lian did not even let him finish the sentence, and the ground under Caelus’s feet started to shake.
[First Root Dominion.]
The dead roots around the Dead Zone reacted at the same moment, first one of the gray roots beside his foot moved.
Then a second one, then dozens of roots came out from under the ground. Some were thicker than a human body, some were thin and sharp.
Some were white and some had strange black lines moving across their surface.
The Cindari leader raised his hand, the roots started wrapping around the battlefield, it was clear that he intended to do the same thing he had done to Seris again.
Taking full control of the Battlefield, limiting the escape routes and forcing the enemy to fight on the ground he had chosen.
But Lian had no intention of giving him such a chance.
[Thunder Step.]
Blue light exploded.
Caelus had not even finished First Root Dominion when Lian appeared directly in front of him.
The distance went from twenty meters to less than half a meter, his right fist pulled back.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Caelus immediately brought his hands in front of his body.
[Crown of Thorns.]
Black and white roots quickly wrapped around his chest and face, creating a thick Barrier.
Lian’s fist hit it.
BOOM!
The first layer of the Barrier cracked at that moment, the Cindari opened his eyes slightly wider.
The young Vorhelm pulled back his second fist, this time there was no pause between the two attacks and the second hit landed exactly on the same spot.
Lightning passed through the cracks.
The Barrier exploded and pieces of Root Armor scattered in every direction.
Caelus stepped backward.
But Lian was not finished yet.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
His shoulder hit the Cindari leader directly in the chest and the heavy sound of something breaking came from under the man’s clothes.
Caelus left the ground, his body passed through one of the thick roots.
The root broke, taking a second one with it and finally he rolled several meters away across the dirt.
Lian stood there, his expression was cold.
A few minutes ago, Caelus had been a real Boss for Seris.
To defeat him, Seris had been forced to use almost all of her Skills one after another.
Even so, she had lost.
But to him, this man was still only a strong enemy, nothing more, not strong enough to become a threat to him, although he could still cause some trouble.
Caelus stood up from the ground, Father’s Blood immediately reacted.
The blood that had fallen from under his robe onto the dirt separated from the ground, like red threads returning to his body.
Two broken ribs in his chest returned to their places with an unpleasant sound. The damaged tissues started repairing themselves and before they were completely fixed, he suddenly disappeared.
[Rootless Step.]
His body sank into one of the roots under his feet.
Predator’s Instincts reacted at the same moment, a very clear warning of danger came from behind.
Lian did not even turn around completely and moved his right elbow backward, lightning gathered around his arm.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Caelus came out from the Root directly behind him, and at the same moment the young Vorhelm’s elbow hit his face directly.
The sound of the hit was dry and brutal and the Cindari’s head turned to the side and blood sprayed from his nose, his body passed beside the human and slid across the ground.
"Your attacks are too predictable, don’t tell me this is all you have." Lian calmly turned around and said with mockery.
"Shut up!" Caelus pressed his teeth together and opened his hands.
[Crown of Thorns.]
This time the Barrier was not for defense and the roots closed around Lian from four sides, one around his ankle, the second around his arm and three thicker roots rose around him like a cage.
In less than a second, his body was almost hidden inside a mass of Roots.
"Crush him!" Caelus closed his hand.
The roots contracted and seemed to want to crush the thing they had trapped! But before the pressure reached a dangerous level
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
A short wave was released from inside Lian’s body, compressed and controlled and all the energy went directly into the Roots holding his body.
For a fraction of a second, the roots remained still and then... they cracked from the inside.
Their pieces exploded in every direction and he came out through the dust, completely unharmed and only the armor he was wearing was damaged.
Caelus raised his other hand, six Root Spears formed behind him.
The tip of each one was covered with white and golden Mana and with a movement of his hand, they all shot forward.
Lian moved, all of his senses had now reached a level where he could easily see each of these spears.
The first passed beside his head, the second passed beside his side and he bent under the third, he jumped over the fourth but caught the fifth.
His fingers closed around the body of the Root Spear and the Momentum of the spear made his foot slide several centimeters across the dirt.
Then he stopped and gave it a short look before squeezing.
CRACK.
The Root Spear broke in half, he spun the broken piece in his hand like a real spear.
Then with one thousand Strength he threw it toward Caelus and the air split along the path of the Projectile, the second one moved his head to the side.

And the Root Spear passed only a few centimeters from his face and hit the ground with destructive power, creating a large crater... he slowly breathed, if it had been only a few centimeters closer, his head would have been crushed right now!
But at that exact moment—
[Thunder Step.]
Lian appeared on the same side Caelus had chosen to dodge toward.
It was as if even escaping only brought him directly to the next punch.
A punch to the stomach, a knee to the face and then a left punch to the side... three attacks in less than one second!
Caelus tried to activate Rootless Step again but unfortunately, he grabbed his wrist and did not let him do it.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice spread from Lian’s fingers across the Cindari leader’s wrist, reaching his elbow and completely freezing that part.
Caelus exploded his Mana and freed his hand, but at the same moment the young Vorhelm placed his foot on his knee and threw him backward with force.
The Cindari was dragged several meters across the ground and pain spread through his body.
"Damn it! Where did this human come from...-"
Every Exchange... every time he used a Skill... every time he tried to create distance, Lian found a way to break his rhythm.
The problem was not only the difference in their stats, because in that aspect the advantage was almost his.
It was that the human he was fighting had Skills that created a direct answer to almost all of his strengths.
Rootless Step?
Predator’s Instincts sensed the danger before the movement was completed.
Crown of Thorns?
Cataclysm Pulse or raw power could break it.
First Root Dominion?
Thunder Step did not allow Lian to stay inside the controlled area.
Regeneration?
Glacial Reaper Claw slowed down the healing process.
Caelus stood several meters away, his breathing had become heavier, he realized that if the battle continued like this, he would definitely lose.
And on the other hand, this time Lian did not attack, not because of mercy but only because he wanted to see his reaction.
But at that moment, behind him, the sound of metal against the dirt was heard.
Lian understood who had moved without turning around.
Seris.
The Potions she had drunk a few minutes ago had finally started to work.

The wound on her thigh was still not completely closed, the left side of her face was still covered in blood and her left eye could no longer open, her remaining Mana was also nothing compared to what she had before the battle.
But her hand was once again wrapped around the handle of her sword.
"Stay there." The young Vorhelm said with a frown.
"No." But the young and stubborn Dragon simply stood up and walked toward him.
"You only have one eye and the condition of your body is not good, you should rest."
"But I still have one eye and it is enough." Seris answered with the same expression as always.
"Do whatever you want." Lian stayed silent for two seconds and then turned his head.
"That is exactly what I’m going to do."
Caelus looked at both of them, this time there was no sign of the confident smile from a few minutes ago and he put his hand on his chest.
Father’s Blood was still repairing his ribs.
But it was clear that the process was not as fast as before, every time Regeneration used a considerable amount of Mana and Mana was not unlimited.
Lian activated Thunder Step again.
The Cindari leader raised his hand and Lian’s fist hit his defense.
"Ughhhhhhh!" The second hit came from below and Caelus’s chest made another sound, this time one of his ribs completely broke and he had no choice but to move backward.
Blood ran from his mouth, Father’s Blood activated, but for the first time, he stopped it in the middle of the healing.
Something in his eyes had changed, it seemed that he had finally accepted the result he did not want to accept.
With his current power, he could not defeat this human and he placed his hand on the center of his chest and something under his clothes started to glow.
"Congratulations, Human, you deserve to face Father’s wrath!"

chapters.title: Chapter 339: The Father’s Wrath
paragraphs: Lian frowned when he heard those words.
Predator’s Instincts sensed not the presence of a new enemy, but the sudden change in the level of danger.
The Mana pressure around Caelus suddenly changed, and Seris noticed it too, raising her sword slightly.
A strange bad feeling appeared in both of their hearts.
"I didn’t think I would have to use this."
A golden line rose from under his clothes, then another black line, and the two colors appeared on his neck.
Lian’s eyes narrowed slightly, and suddenly the System panel appeared in front of him.
[Warning.]
[External Authority Detected.]
[Authority of the First Son]
[Target Combat Capacity Has Increased Drastically.]
"Authority of the First Son?" He frowned when he saw the panel, these words and the names of Father and Son were confusing him, and he could not understand their exact reference.
The only guess he had was that the First Son probably referred to one of the Five Calamities, the Black Silence Calamity.
But he had no idea who this Father was or exactly what they were facing, but if he had to guess, it seemed that the power behind the Calamities was this Father.
Could this Father be the reason behind the opening of the Rifts, the appearance of the Ruined Realms, and even the monsters?
