paragraphs: "So who chose her?" Lian asked coldly.
From the moment he learned that Selina had been chosen as the new Vessel of the Calamity, this question had come to his mind.
Why her? Why, among all the humans present and even the Cindari, was Selina the one who had to be chosen? Was there something special about her that no one knew about?
Was it just a completely random and accidental matter? Or was there a much more complicated mechanism behind it?
Who was even responsible for choosing her? That bastard, the leader of the Cindari? Their founder? The Tree itself or the Calamity itself? Or even... that being who was called Father?
There were so many scattered possibilities that it was basically impossible to make any proper conclusion.
Caelus moved back, roots rose from the ground but the young Vorhelm moved through them.
"Someone who had been watching your world even before your ancestors were born."
Lian did not stop his attacks even after hearing those words, but they made his mind even more confused.

The sentence was clear, but its meaning was impossible to understand without knowing more information, but did this mean that someone had been watching their world for thousands of years and then brought the Calamity of the monsters down upon them?
In fact, it was not only their world, at least all ten Ruined Realms had been destroyed by these Calamities and this small Special Area was also almost destroyed.
So was there really someone behind all of this? But could the words of this Cindari even be trusted?
Of course, this partly answered his question, it was probably the work of the same being who was called Father.
"What did you do to the Forgotten Tree?"
"The Tree?" Caelus actually laughed this time.
One of the roots targeted Lian but he caught it with Glacial Reaper Claw and broke it.
"It’s just a lock."
Seris sent Moonless Severance from the other side. And the Cindari dodged, although the second line of his clothes was cut.
"And locks don’t stay closed forever."
"Why are you freeing Black Silence?" Lian activated Thunder Step and punched him in the jaw.
"Freeing? You still think it’s imprisoned?" Caelus smiled even after the hit.
The young Vorhelm frowned.
The leader of the Cindari put his hand on the ground and First Root Dominion raised a wave of roots.
"The child is only returning home."
"What home?" Lian destroyed the first wave with Cataclysm Pulse.
Why was this idiot talking like a madman?
Caelus suddenly looked at the sky and his eyes were shining.
"When the sky becomes black again... the gates will open."
Lian only looked at him for a moment, none of the answers were complete, they were more like pieces of a mad sermon.
This stupid Cindari was not even trying to speak logically anymore.
He appeared behind him with Thunder Step and his hand closed around Caelus’s throat, lifting him from the ground and then smashing him into the ground with all his strength.
BOOM!
The ground under his body cracked and Lian put his foot on his chest.
"What exactly does Cindar want? What is his goal?"
"Brother Cindar?" The madman’s smile changed.
"He was simply the first one to understand that death is not the end."
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 95.7%]
Seris also saw the panel, and looked at the young Vorhelm.

Lian sighed, nothing useful was going to come out of this man anymore, every question had a half-answer and they were basically illogical and unbelievable and God knows if they were even the truth or a lie or an illusion.
Every answer was mixed with fanatical madness and they also had no time.
"Nothing useful is coming out of him anymore." He then looked at Seris.
"You finally understood." The young Pendragon answered tiredly.
"We should finish this right now."
"Then let’s finish it."
Caelus got up from the ground, First Son’s Authority was still active, the golden and black veins on his body were shining.
Father’s Blood was healing the last injuries.
He might have thought he had another chance to attack but... he didn’t.
Seris moved forward.
[Sovereign’s Judgment.]
The mental pressure landed directly on the Cindari’s mind, this time he was expecting it, he resisted but even a fraction of a second of stopping ... was enough.
[King’s Breaker.]
Her sword hit directly at the center of the Root Armor on his chest.
The first hit.
Crack.
The second.
The Mana structure of the defense became unstable.
The third.
The central Barrier broke.
Caelus immediately activated Rootless Step, his body started sinking into the roots under his feet.
But Lian had sensed the direction of the movement before it was complete and he was not going to let him escape.
[Thunder Step.]

The leader of the Cindari appeared at the new location and Lian was already there, the man’s eyes opened for a moment and it was clear that he had not expected it and at that moment a direct punch hit his stomach.
The air left his lungs, his body bent and pain spread through his body again.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice moved from his wrist to his elbow, shoulder and then reached his chest.
Caelus activated Father’s Blood, heat and Mana rose to break the ice.
But Seris appeared behind him, they were not going to let this bastard have any chance.
[Moonless Severance.]
The sword moved and the Slash appeared with a delay along the Cindari’s back.
A deep wound appeared from his shoulder to the bottom of his waist. Caelus fell onto one knee, but First Son’s Authority was still active.
He hit the ground with his hand and the roots started rising.
Although Lian stepped in and did not let him.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
His shoulder hit Caelus’s body directly, this time the goal was not only to throw him away, he carried him with himself.
Ten meters.
Fifteen.
Twenty.
Then Caelus was smashed into the broken ground with great force and at the exact moment of impact—
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
The destructive wave entered through the Cindari’s body, from the inside, the inner Root Armor, Mana Channels and defenses strengthened by the Authority.
All of them shook from the inside for a moment.
Caelus opened his mouth and blood came out.
Lian did not move back and clenched his right fist, this time Thunder Calamity was different.

The lightning did not only move around his fist, it was gradually compressed, every extra spark was pulled toward the same point and for a moment the sound of the area mixed with a heavy buzzing sound.
The leader of the Cindari tried to create Crown of Thorns but Seris attacked from the side and cut the new roots.
He tried to activate Father’s Blood but the young Vorhelm did not wait for the healing.
[Thunder Calamity.]
The punch landed directly at the center of his chest.
BOOOOOOM!
The lightning entered from the front of his body and came out from his back, the blue and white wave tore the ground several meters away and Caelus’s entire body was covered in light for a moment.
First Son’s Authority shook, the golden veins on his neck went out one by one.
Black.
Gold.
All of them disappeared.
The System reacted.
[External Authority Disrupted.]
[Bloodline Resonance Collapsing.]
Caelus was still standing, but only because Lian was holding his collar and when he let go of him, the man took one step back.
Then a second.
Father’s Blood tried to close the wound, blood rose from the ground and reached his chest, but this time nothing happened, his internal structure had been damaged too badly.
Everything had been damaged by that same attack, he looked at the bloody hole in his chest and then slowly raised his head.
Lian expected fear, or anger, but his enemy only smiled, a real smile as blood ran from the corner of his mouth.
His eyes moved past the human in front of him and went to the Cocoon. Then they moved to the gray sky of the Dead Zone and finally he said in a broken voice.
"You think..." He coughed and blood fell onto his chin.
"I was protecting the Birth?"
Lian frowned, he felt that bad feeling again, he really did not like these bad feelings and recently he had been feeling them too often.
"No..." His legs shook.
"I was only... buying time until the family arrived."
"Family? What do you mean?" The young Vorhelm asked coldly.
But Caelus seemed unable to hear him anymore and his eyes were looking at the sky.
"When the dead return..." His smile was still there.
"You will understand why Father never forgets his children."
His breathing became shorter, but he still said one more sentence.
"Those who should be dead... have awakened right now."
Then his body became limp.
Caelus Vael fell to the ground, for several seconds nothing moved, First Root Dominion disappeared and the roots that were in the air fell to the ground.
The golden light disappeared from his body and finally the man died...
[You killed a Level 35 Cindari]

[External Authority Disrupted.]
[Bloodline Resonance Collapsing.]
Caelus was still standing, but only because Lian was holding his collar and when he let go of him, the man took one step back.
Then a second.
Father’s Blood tried to close the wound, blood rose from the ground and reached his chest, but this time nothing happened, his internal structure had been damaged too badly.
Everything had been damaged by that same attack, he looked at the bloody hole in his chest and then slowly raised his head.
Lian expected fear, or anger, but his enemy only smiled, a real smile as blood ran from the corner of his mouth.
His eyes moved past the human in front of him and went to the Cocoon.
Then they moved to the gray sky of the Dead Zone and finally he said in a broken voice.
"You think..." He coughed and blood fell onto his chin.
"I was protecting the Birth?"
Lian frowned, he felt that bad feeling again, he really did not like these bad feelings and recently he had been feeling them too often.
"No..." His legs shook.
"I was only... buying time until the family arrived."
"Family?
What do you mean?" The young Vorhelm asked coldly.
But Caelus seemed unable to hear him anymore and his eyes were looking at the sky.
"When the dead return..." His smile was still there.
"You will understand why Father never forgets his children."
His breathing became shorter, but he still said one more sentence.
"Those who should be dead... have awakened right now."
Then his body became limp.
Caelus Vael fell to the ground, for several seconds nothing moved, First Root Dominion disappeared and the roots that were in the air fell to the ground.
The golden light disappeared from his body and finally the man died...
[You killed a Level 35 Cindari]

chapters.title: Chapter 341: I Will Become The Vessel
paragraphs: "Finally." Seris whispered quietly but even though they had succeeded, there was no smile or relief on either of their faces.

First, it had been an excellent battle, the two of them had worked together perfectly and managed to crush and defeat their enemy, however, the words he had said before his death did not let them relax for some reason.
And second... they still had a bigger problem.
And at that moment—
THUMP.
The Cocoon pulsed again and the System appeared.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 99.0%]
One percent, only one percent remained!
Lian took a deep breath, part of his Mana had been used during the battle, there were several wounds on his forearm and shoulder and a cut on his cheek.
But compared to Seris, his condition was still very good, the girl placed her sword on the ground and leaned on it to keep her balance.
"What are you going to do now? It’s at ninety-nine percent, with this situation, I don’t think we have any other choice except destroying it." And then her eyes moved to the Cocoon.
Lian was still silent and looked at Selina’s face, black veins had almost covered her entire neck and part of her face.
The white roots of the Cocoon were now more black than gold and his System Quest appeared in his mind.
[Evolution Quest]
[Objective: Devour The Black Silence.]
They still did not have all the pieces, they did not know many of the secrets, and they still did not know exactly what they were dealing with.
But there was one possibility, a completely stupid and very dangerous possibility and perhaps the only option that could both save Selina and make his Quest possible.
"I’m going to replace Selina." Lian said quietly.
Seris did not react.
Three seconds, four, five seconds and then she slowly turned her head toward him.
"I think I heard wrong, what did you just say?"
"I’m going to replace her, I will become the Vessel myself."
"You’re crazy." The young Pendragon became completely silent, even with half of her face covered in blood, her disbelief could be seen.
Lian shrugged and did not seem to want to give an answer.
"That thing is a Calamity." Seris pointed at the Cocoon with a frown.
"I know."
"Not a normal Monster."
"I know."
"It might destroy you the moment it enters your body."
"I know."
"Then why are you answering like I’m talking about the weather?" Seris became truly angry this time.
He did not answer, this was the only way he could think of for Evolution, unfortunately he thought Glutton might be able to help him but it did not seem that way.

Although maybe it was because it was not fully available yet, it was still inside an incomplete process, if Black Silence was transferred to the Vessel, maybe it would exist in a more focused form for a moment.
And if he himself was the Vessel? He would not have to take it from outside.
The Calamity would enter him, where Glutton might be able to directly fight it.
His innate skill could only devour skills and talents, maybe it could also devour the Calamity in the same way.
But he was not sure, all of these were assumptions without any base or logic and were based on luck.
Maybe if he became the new Vessel, he would not even need to do anything else and the System would directly register it as Devouring.
But there were many risks... such as the fact that he did not even know if he would still be himself after becoming the new Vessel.
"Maybe if I become the Vessel and that thing enters me, I can destroy it." Then he slowly added.
"And are you sure you can? How exactly are you going to replace her?!" Seris asked seriously.
"No, I’m not sure and I have no idea either."
"That was a very hopeful answer."
"But Selina can’t do it, I at least have a chance." The young Vorhelm looked at the Cocoon again.
Seris opened her mouth to say something, but at that moment Lian’s entire body became stiff.
Predator’s Instincts.
The warning moved like a wave of needles from the back of his neck to his spine, but this time it was not one danger, he sensed several dangers.
He slowly raised his head and the young Pendragon also sensed something at almost the same time.
Several powerful presences were approaching from far away.
One.
Second.
Third.
Fifth.
More.
"Again?" Seris frowned and raised her sword again.
Her tone was more tired than angry, even she no longer had the desire for another battle.
They guessed that probably several Cindari or infected Monsters were coming toward them.
One was still unable to move, Aren was lying on the ground without both hands.
Seris herself had lost one eye and her Mana was very low.
Lian had also used a significant amount of Mana on the way to Rootcrown and in the two consecutive battles.
And more importantly, they had a very important problem that they had to deal with!
And now several presences were getting closer to them.
Both of them turned their eyes toward the place where they could feel the presences... at first nothing could be seen, only the gray sky.
Then a point appeared in the distance.
A human figure, in the air, not on a Flying Beast and not on an Artifact but floating by itself!
Then a second figure.
Third.
More.
They entered their view from different directions and slowly moved along the same path toward the Forgotten Tree.
They were in no hurry, as if they were sure that no one could stop them and the closer they got, the clearer their appearance became.
"These..." Seris frowned even more for a moment.
They were Cindari, at least they had once been Cindari, but the appearance of their bodies looked more like corpses than living beings.
White skin, not the normal pale color but white like the body of someone who had not had blood normally flowing through their body for years.

Dark veins could be seen on their necks and faces, some of their eyes were half-open and the hair of some was completely white, their bodies were dry and their clothes did not belong to the current era of the Cindari.
One wore armor whose design looked like nothing worn by any soldier in Vhalaris.
Another wore a long and rotten robe with old royal symbols.
One had a broken Crown on his head.
Another carried a sword that even from a distance had a very old aura around it.
The System reacted one after another.
[Cindari — Lv.34]
[Cindari — Lv.36]
[Cindari — Lv.35]
[Cindari — Lv.38]
[Cindari — Lv.37]
"You have to be kidding." The young Pendragon looked at the panels for several seconds and then said in a dry voice.
No one answered and she lowered her sword slightly.
"Who the hell are these people?"
Lian did not look at the others at first, from the moment the central figure came out of the fog, all his attention had been locked onto that one person.
A very old robe, black and white and parts of it were rotten, but it was still decorated with golden lines.
Long white hair reaching the back of his shoulders, dry and pale skin and sunken cheeks, dark veins.
Exactly the same face and exactly the same body that he had seen several hours ago inside the coffin, under the First Archive.
Without movement and in a state between death and life, the same Cindari who had been almost dead and yet now that corpse was floating in the sky.
His eyes were open.
Cindar Vael.
The founder of the Cindari race!
Lian remained silent and Seris noticed that his eyes were fixed on one person.
"Do you know him?"
He did not answer immediately and only the last words Caelus had said before his death came back to his mind.
"I was only buying time until the family arrived."
At that moment Lian had not taken those words seriously and did not think they were important, thinking they were the nonsense of a madman before his death.
Now he understood that he had been wrong, he meant exactly these people, people who should have died years or even centuries ago.
"These are people who should be dead."
"I guessed that part myself." Seris moved her eyes across the group.
"Especially that one." Lian did not take his eyes off the man in the center, pointing at Cindar with his finger.
"Why?" The young Pendragon looked at the white and dry figure in the center of the group.
"Because he is the founder of the Cindari race."

chapters.title: Chapter 342: Becoming The New Vessel I
paragraphs: "How? How is that man alive?" Seris asked in disbelief.

"I don’t know either, at first I thought all of this was a plan for his resurrection, but it seems I was wrong, this bastard and the others are probably some kind of undead, their goal is to protect their plan, which is the Cocoon." Lian thought for a moment and answered.
At first, he thought the founder was definitely behind everything and his goal was his own resurrection, but now he understood that he had been wrong.
The real goal of the resurrection had been Black Silence’s resurrection all along.
"So this is the Cocoon’s final layer of protection, huh?" the young Pendragon whispered.
For several seconds, even the sound of the wind could not be heard in the Dead Zone.
Lian kept his head raised and looked at the beings floating in the gray sky above them.
Five figures, five Cindari who normally should not be there.

Some of them had probably lived hundreds of years ago based on the appearance of their clothes and armor, and some others, if what Lian had seen in the First Archive was correct, had even come from the time when Rootcrown was founded.
But none of them spoke, even Cindar Vael, the man whose name had cast a shadow over almost all of Cindari history, was standing in the air at the center of the group and showed no reaction.
Not to Caelus’s corpse that was still lying on the ground.
Not to Lian, not even to Seris and her dried eye, his eyes were only fixed on the Cocoon and the others had almost the same behavior, they did not look like living beings watching something.
They looked more like guards who had started moving again after centuries of sleep, only to carry out an order.
Seris also looked at the same group.
Her sword was still in her hand, but unlike the previous battles, there was no sign of wanting to attack on her face.
The Potions had returned a small part of her strength, but her condition was still terrible.
Her left eye was gone, her right thigh had only just started to close and her Mana was at the lowest level Lian had seen since he met her.
One was still lying beside the huge root of the Forgotten Tree and could not even stand up.
Aren was also on the ground with both arms cut off and remained conscious only with the help of a Healing Potion and the pressure of the stones against his wounds.
"We have no chance of winning this battle." The young Pendragon finally said.
Lian gave her a short look.

If he had heard this sentence from anyone else, it would not have been strange, but Seris? The girl who a few minutes ago, with one eye, a pierced leg and almost no Mana, had still decided to destroy the Cocoon herself?
If she said they had no chance of winning, it meant the situation was really this bad.
The young Vorhelm looked at the undead again.
Several Level 35 or higher, one Level 38 and the problem here was that this was not the peak of their power, when they were truly alive they were probably much stronger.
But after spending so many years between life and death, it was clear that their strength had greatly decreased.
"I know, but we have no choice." He then nodded, he could also see that there was no way to win, but could they really do anything else?
At that moment, a deep sound came from behind them.
THUMP.
The roots of the Cocoon contracted at the same time and the black light inside its veins became stronger for a moment and a new panel appeared in front of the two.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 99.1%]
"Whatever you’re going to do to replace her, now is the time." Seris gave the man beside her a serious look and said.
Lian opened his mouth, but before he could speak, the girl raised her sword.
"I’ll hold them back, as long as I can." Both of them knew what this sentence meant.
In her current condition, Seris could not last for long even against one of them.
Three?
Four?
This was no longer a battle, it was buying time with her own life.
The young Vorhelm looked at her for several seconds, if the situation were normal, he would not allow it, if they even had a few extra minutes, maybe he could find another way.
But the number 99.1% was in front of their eyes, and behind that number was their own world.
The Main Quest had clearly said that if they failed, Black Silence would gain access to their world, there was no room for discussion, not for this girl and not for himself.
"Be careful, I won’t take long." He finally only said.
"Better not." Seris answered without looking at him.
Then she walked past him, her first few steps were a little unstable, but with every step, her body position changed again.
Shoulders lowered, sword at a proper angle, the remaining Mana gathered inside the Blade and the undead finally reacted in front of her.
Not all of them but three separated from the Formation, the first was a man with very old armor and a long sword, the second wore a gray robe and floated in the air without any Staff or Weapon.
The third was almost two meters tall and white Root-like strands came out of his dry arms like veins.
None of them spoke, none of them even changed their expressions, it seemed that in their current state they could not speak and they only started coming down.
[Moonless Severance.]
No wave came out of the blade, the undead swordsman came directly toward her but a moment later, an invisible line opened in the space between them.
The creature raised its sword, the compressed Mana slash hit its metal and the force pushed it several meters back.
The other two Cindari entered at the same time from two directions and Seris turned her body.
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
Dozens of thin Slashes like petals of light appeared around her.
Of course, not to kill but to build a wall and block their path, to force them to defend.
The first undead raised its hand and formed a Barrier of gray Mana, the second sent white roots out of its arm and dozens of Sword Auras hit them.
Seris threw herself between them without waiting for the result.
She was not supposed to win, she only needed to keep them busy long enough for Lian to finish his work.
Although before she had a chance to breathe, four more undead attacked the young Vorhelm at high speed.
"Watch out!"
But before they could reach him, a huge ant blocked their path with its body, gave a huge roar and showed its jaws.
The warning was clear, even if it died, it would not let them get close to its master!
The undead showed no reaction and attacked One, Seris frowned and increased her attacks.
Lian only looked behind him once, three undead were fighting Seris and two others were fighting One.
He took his eyes away from the battle, he could no longer help Seris or One, if he lost even thirty seconds on that battle, there might be nothing left to protect.
He stood in front of the Cocoon.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 99.1%]
The plan he had told that girl a few minutes ago looked very simple at that moment.
"I’ll become the Vessel myself."
But now that he was actually standing in front of the Cocoon, the problem became clear.
How?
He could not enter a System Panel and change the Host.
He could not order Black Silence to release Selina and choose him.
The process was almost complete, thousands of Root Strands had entered Selina’s body from the Cocoon.
Black veins were moving under her skin and the Calamity’s Signature had almost become one with her body.
"First, I need to understand why you were chosen in the first place." He looked at Selina’s unconscious face.
This was the most important question.
Why Selina? Among all the humans who had entered the Special Area, why her?
Lian did not remember anything special about her Talent, she did not have an extraordinary Class that made her different from the others.
There was also no unknown Bloodline, at least as far as they knew.
She was an Awakener, stronger than some and weaker than others, but there was nothing that could explain why an ancient Calamity would choose her as its Vessel.
So maybe the question was wrong, maybe Selina had not been chosen because of something she had, maybe she had been chosen because of what she was.
Lian put himself in Black Silence’s position for a moment.
If it were an entity without a body, an entity that needed a Vessel to remain in the material world.
What kind of body would it want? First, something that could endure its power, second, something that was easy to control.
And third, a body that would not become a new prison for it, a body that would not limit its freedom.
"Freedom..." He became still for a moment and his eyes narrowed slightly.
"Freedom to move between places?"
A spark appeared in his mind and he immediately opened the Main Quest.
[Failure: The Black Silence Gains Access to Earth.]
Lian had seen this line many times, he had read it many times, but until this moment he had never asked himself exactly how.
Black Silence was in this Realm.
Earth was another World.
If the Calamity could go from one world to another whenever it wanted, why had it not done that until now?
Why had it not gone to another world thousands of years ago, when its power was greater and the Forgotten Tree still did not have its current form?
Why had it limited itself to this Realm?
Did it not want to? That was illogical.. Or maybe it simply could not.

None of them spoke, none of them even changed their expressions, it seemed that in their current state they could not speak and they only started coming down.
[Moonless Severance.]
No wave came out of the blade, the undead swordsman came directly toward her but a moment later, an invisible line opened in the space between them.
The creature raised its sword, the compressed Mana slash hit its metal and the force pushed it several meters back.
The other two Cindari entered at the same time from two directions and Seris turned her body.
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
Dozens of thin Slashes like petals of light appeared around her.
Of course, not to kill but to build a wall and block their path, to force them to defend.
The first undead raised its hand and formed a Barrier of gray Mana, the second sent white roots out of its arm and dozens of Sword Auras hit them.
Seris threw herself between them without waiting for the result.
She was not supposed to win, she only needed to keep them busy long enough for Lian to finish his work.
Although before she had a chance to breathe, four more undead attacked the young Vorhelm at high speed.
"Watch out!"
But before they could reach him, a huge ant blocked their path with its body, gave a huge roar and showed its jaws.
The warning was clear, even if it died, it would not let them get close to its master!
The undead showed no reaction and attacked One, Seris frowned and increased her attacks.
Lian only looked behind him once, three undead were fighting Seris and two others were fighting One.
He took his eyes away from the battle, he could no longer help Seris or One, if he lost even thirty seconds on that battle, there might be nothing left to protect.
He stood in front of the Cocoon.
[Calamity Gestation Progress: 99.1%]
The plan he had told that girl a few minutes ago looked very simple at that moment.
"I’ll become the Vessel myself."
But now that he was actually standing in front of the Cocoon, the problem became clear.
How?
He could not enter a System Panel and change the Host.
He could not order Black Silence to release Selina and choose him.
The process was almost complete, thousands of Root Strands had entered Selina’s body from the Cocoon.
Black veins were moving under her skin and the Calamity’s Signature had almost become one with her body.
"First, I need to understand why you were chosen in the first place." He looked at Selina’s unconscious face.
This was the most important question.
Why Selina?
Among all the humans who had entered the Special Area, why her?
Lian did not remember anything special about her Talent, she did not have an extraordinary Class that made her different from the others.
There was also no unknown Bloodline, at least as far as they knew.
She was an Awakener, stronger than some and weaker than others, but there was nothing that could explain why an ancient Calamity would choose her as its Vessel.
So maybe the question was wrong, maybe Selina had not been chosen because of something she had, maybe she had been chosen because of what she was.
Lian put himself in Black Silence’s position for a moment.
If it were an entity without a body, an entity that needed a Vessel to remain in the material world.
What kind of body would it want?
First, something that could endure its power, second, something that was easy to control.
And third, a body that would not become a new prison for it, a body that would not limit its freedom.
"Freedom..." He became still for a moment and his eyes narrowed slightly.
"Freedom to move between places?"
A spark appeared in his mind and he immediately opened the Main Quest.
[Failure: The Black Silence Gains Access to Earth.]
Lian had seen this line many times, he had read it many times, but until this moment he had never asked himself exactly how.
Black Silence was in this Realm.
Earth was another World.
If the Calamity could go from one world to another whenever it wanted, why had it not done that until now?
Why had it not gone to another world thousands of years ago, when its power was greater and the Forgotten Tree still did not have its current form?
Why had it limited itself to this Realm?
Did it not want to?
That was illogical..
Or maybe it simply could not.

chapters.title: Chapter 343: Becoming The New Vessel II
paragraphs: For a moment, the sound of a sword spread through the area, but Lian’s eyes fixed on Selina again.
The sound of swords hitting each other came from behind him, Seris pushed one of the Returned several meters back with King’s Breaker.
But he could almost no longer hear the battle, his mind was locked onto an old sentence.
Aurelia’s voice, a memory he had seen in the Legacy Dungeon.
"Someone among us allowed The Black Silence to enter."
Allowed it to enter, until now Lian had understood it like a normal phrase.
Someone opened a gate, someone helped the Calamity, but maybe Aurelia had been more precise than he had thought.
Allowed it to enter.
Now he felt that he finally understood what this sentence meant!
"To enter a World... an Anchor!" His eyes widened and everything suddenly made more sense.
Maybe the Calamity could not simply pass through a Rift.
Maybe to enter a new World, it needed something that belonged to that World.
A Body, a Soul, a living being whose existence was made from the laws of that World.
An Anchor!
In the past, how had Black Silence entered this Realm?
He did not know exactly how it had entered, but he knew that its first Vessel was the Primordial Root and it spread from there.
In the end, the leaders of the old civilizations destroyed the Primordial Root in order to suppress it, and imprisoned Black Silence inside the corrupted Titan.
Everything was connected to the same point.
But now? Black Silence no longer only wanted to remain in this Realm.
The Main Quest was clear, its next target was Earth and to enter Earth, it needed an Anchor from Earth.
Lian stared at Selina.
This girl had been chosen not because of her Talent, not because of her Class, and not because she was the most special human in Special Area.
But simply because she was from Earth.
"So that’s it." Almost the entire mystery changed shape in a single moment.
Selina might have even been chosen randomly.
Among the Humans who had gotten close enough to Forgotten Tree or a mechanism related to the Calamity, she was simply the first suitable Candidate.
It did not matter who the Vessel was, it only needed to belong to Earth.
That stupid Cindari leader, with all the nonsense he said, either wanted to fool them or simply believed the nonsense he was saying.
Either way, when the Gestation was complete, Black Silence would no longer have a local Vessel.
Its Vessel would be an Earthling, a living Anchor to Earth, and maybe that was enough to open the path.
Lian looked at Aren for a moment, the man was still lying on the ground several dozen meters away.
Another mystery was also solved at that moment, for twenty-five years, the Cindari had been searching for Aren for years, but their goal was not to kill him.
They had asked him about the Rift many times, they had tried many times to find out which World he came from, they had told him they were looking for a way out of the Realm.
Maelor had also claimed that the Cindari needed Humans so they might find a way to escape from their dying World.
But what if this whole story was only a cover? Not necessarily a lie that all Cindari knew about.
Most Cindari probably truly believed that their leaders were looking for a way to escape in order to save their civilization.
But the leaders? The generations that had access to the secret of Cindar and Black Silence? They had never been looking for a way out.
They were looking for a Human, an Anchor and a Vessel.
Aren was not supposed to find a way to his own World, Aren himself was supposed to be that path.
All this time they had only been looking for him so they could use him as a Vessel, but when they finally managed to capture him, that was also when new Humans entered this World.
And among those Humans, one of them was randomly chosen as the new Vessel and the process began.
And at that point they no longer needed Aren, so he was thrown away and the Cindari leader allowed the others to do whatever they wanted with him.
"So that’s why they kept you..." He then whispered.
"Damn it."
The whole story now had a new meaning, the leaders of every Cindari generation could control their people with one simple goal.
The World is dying, Forgotten Tree is becoming weaker and we must find a way to another World.
If we find a Human, keep them alive, ask them about their World, ask about the Rift, ask about the way back.
But the truth? They were only waiting for the right time to turn the Human into the next Anchor of the Calamity.
"Now everything makes sense together."
Suddenly, an explosion happened behind him, Lian turned his head for a moment, Seris had clashed with one of the Returned.
The ancient swordsman had brought his blade down and the girl had barely managed to redirect it with her own sword.
The Returned Mage sent several gray Projectiles from above her head.
Seris dropped to one knee, passed under the attack and filled the space between them with Thousand Petal Swordstorm.
But two more Returned had separated from the main Formation from the right.
However, the girl’s condition had become much worse, her entire body was covered in blood and she could no longer use one of her hands.
She was using her trump cards and had somehow managed to survive until now.
Time was running out and Lian looked at the Cocoon again, understanding why Selina had been chosen was only half of the problem.
"Now how do I replace myself with her without killing you?"
The progress was 99.1%.
The process was at a stage where even the smallest disturbance could complete it.
Or release Black Silence, or kill Selina.
"I need to trick it for a few seconds." He thought for a few seconds and then an idea came to his mind.
His hand went into his Inventory and he took something out.
A Core, heavier and larger than normal Cores, but unlike active Cores, it was almost empty inside.
An aura came from it that felt like it wanted to destroy and ruin everything.
[Demon-Rank Core]
The same Core he had taken from Vorhelm a long time ago.
At that time he had no immediate use for it, he was not even sure why he had kept it, but his instincts had told him that one day it would be useful.
Maybe that day had finally come.
Monster Cores were not only sources of Mana, they were Containers.
Natural structures that a Monster’s body created to store energy.
Mana.
Elemental Energy.
Bloodline Energy.
Corruption.

And in very powerful creatures, even more complex energies, Monsters had one Core before their first Evolution, but as their Rank and Evolution became higher, their body structure became more complex.
After Evolution, they increased the number of their Cores, because of the limit of their capacity, no matter how strong one Core was, it was not infinite.
And the Core in front of Lian was Demon Rank, empty and ready to receive energy.
And unlike Selina, there was still no living Structure inside it that could resist the Calamity.
"It isn’t enough for a permanent Vessel, but maybe it will work for a few seconds."
That was all he needed, just a few seconds, divert Black Silence from Selina to the Core, then take Selina out and enter himself.
Then he would let the Core be destroyed, at that moment, he would be the only Candidate left.
There was only one problem.
How could he enter the Cocoon? The surface of the Cocoon was completely closed.
If he made a hole in it with Thunder Calamity, the Structure might collapse.
Glacial Reaper Claw might also Freeze the Root Strands inside it.
Cataclysm Pulse would be even worse.
"Now I need to enter this thing without damaging it."
At that moment something moved inside the Inventory.
Again.
Tap.
Tap.
His eyebrows came together.
"What?"
The System reacted.
[Devourer Egg Is Reacting.]
[Devourer Egg Wishes to Assist.]
Lian looked at the panel for several seconds, then put his hand into the Inventory and took the Egg out.
The strange Egg rested in his palm, its surface was the same as always, but almost immediately after coming out it started shaking.
"You?"
The Egg gave a strong shake and Lian raised it slightly.
"Can you really help?"
Another shake, and this time it was even more certain.
"I don’t trust you."
The Egg immediately became completely still.
"Don’t tell me you want to devour the whole Cocoon?"
The Egg suddenly started shaking violently, so clearly that even without a language, its protest could be understood.
"Yeah, yeah. Completely trustworthy." Lian said sarcastically.
At that moment, the sound of a heavy impact came from behind him, one of the Returned slammed Seris into the ground.
The girl rolled away and moved aside before the next blade came down, then used Moonless Severance almost from the ground.
A Slash appeared on the enemy’s chest after a delay and pushed him back.
One’s condition was also not good at all, two of his arms had been torn off and more holes had appeared in his body.
If Seris had not also been protecting him, even that Ant would already be dead.
Lian looked at the Egg again, there was no time for jokes and unfortunately, it seemed there was no other choice.
"Listen, I only need an entrance." He pointed at the Cocoon with his free hand.
"Create an entrance between the outside and the inside, you don’t cut anything, you don’t eat any of those black veins and you don’t touch the Calamity." Then he looked directly at the Egg.
"And if you eat even one hair of Selina..."
"Even if it is the last thing I do in my life, I will make fried eggs out of you."
The Egg became completely still, then gave a very small shake.
If Lian had to translate it, it was probably something like, "I understand."
"Good." He pointed at the surface of the Cocoon.
"Only the shell."
The Egg moved back and forth.
The young Vorhelm took a short breath and looked at the battle.
This time Seris had kept four Returned at a relatively close distance from herself, how she was still standing was another question.
But this could not continue like this, even that girl had a limit.
It was time for the replacement to begin.
"Now, start your job!" He then said to the Devourer Egg!

chapters.title: Chapter 344: Becoming The New Vessel III
paragraphs: Lian held the Egg in front of the Cocoon.
A weak light appeared on the surface of the Egg.
The space around it started to bend.
"Three..."
Vorhelm’s eyes locked onto the Cocoon.
"Now."
The Egg’s energy was released immediately, a strange color between dark gold and black that seemed to pull the light into itself.
The space in front of the Cocoon changed shape for a moment and a small circle appeared on the shell.
Then... that part disappeared!
It did not break, burn, or melt, not even a Fragment fell onto the ground, instead, part of the Cocoon was removed so cleanly that it was as if it had never existed in the first place.
A circular hole appeared on the surface of the Cocoon, large enough for Lian to pass his hand and then his body through it.
But what really stopped him was how precise the result was.
The Root Strands, completely unharmed.
The black veins? Untouched.
The energy membrane inside the Cocoon? Still stable.
Even the Mana flow had not stopped for even a moment.
The System confirmed it.
[Localized Devouring Complete.]
[Gestation Structure Integrity: Stable.]
Lian looked at the Egg, and he was actually a little impressed.
"Not bad."
The Egg immediately started shaking with pride.
"Be proud later."
Then he picked up the Demon-Rank Core and immediately took it through the hole inside the Cocoon.
At first, nothing happened, the Core was placed a short distance away from Selina’s body.
Lian waited.
One second.
Two seconds.
Then—
THUMP!
The entire Cocoon shook.
The black veins that had been spread across Selina’s body and the Root Strands until that moment stopped at the same time.
Then their direction changed!
Like a group of snakes that had suddenly smelled fresh prey, the black veins moved back toward the Demon Core.
It was not that they immediately separated from Selina’s body, but the flow of energy had clearly changed.
[Foreign Energy Container Detected.]
[Calamity Gestation Pattern Altering.]
[Temporary Vessel Candidate Detected.]
Lian’s eyes lit up.
"I got you."
His guess had been correct, the Core was not a complete Vessel in the eyes of Black Silence.
It had no Soul, it had no proper connection to a World, but on an instinctive level it had something Selina did not.
Empty space, a capacity ready to accept energy, and also the Core of a Demon! An extremely powerful and high-level being that was more valuable than Selina from every point of view.
For a few moments, that was enough for the Calamity to move its attention away from the main Host, the black veins on the girl’s neck started moving back.
Lian acted immediately, he put his right hand through the hole.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice formed over his fingers and palm, but this time he did not intend to Freeze Black Silence.
This layer was only for protection, a barrier between his skin and the Root Strands he had to cut.
The first strand was wrapped around Selina’s wrist, he grabbed it and closed the ice claw.
Cut.
At that moment, a strong pain spread through his fingers.
"Damn! What is this?" Lian frowned, the skin under the Ice started smoking, at first he thought it was heat.
But it was not, his skin was being destroyed from the inside! It was as if something was turning the structure of his cells into liquid.
[Warning.]
[Calamity Rejection Mechanism Activated.]
[Foreign Interference Detected.]
"Of course it’s not easy." Lian clenched his teeth.
He grabbed the second strand and cut it, the black effect moved from his fingertips to his palm.
A small part of his skin cracked and the tissue underneath became visible, he strengthened Glacial Reaper and Ice formed over the wound again.
But even the Ice started turning black, Black Silence was not destroying it immediately, instead, it was slowly spreading through the structure of the Ice like decay.
And Selina was not safe either, when the third strand was cut, her unconscious body suddenly shook and the black veins on her neck became brighter.
Not pure black but red and black! The skin around them started turning red and then a very small amount of steam rose from it!
The System immediately gave a warning.
[Host Separation Detected.]
[Gestation Preservation Mechanism Activated.]
Lian’s expression became cold, this mechanism existed to prevent exactly this situation.
If someone tried to separate the Host during Gestation, the process would destroy both the Host and the one interfering with it.
Or it would cause enough damage to force them to stop, but this time Black Silence had another problem.
The Demon Core.
Every moment, more of the Calamity’s existence was being pulled toward it, the surface of the Core started turning black from the inside.
The old purple veins went out one after another and were replaced by dark matter.
At the same time, the burning lines on Selina’s body became a little weaker.
Lian understood, the more Black Silence focused on the temporary Vessel, the weaker the mechanism protecting the Host became.
"Then I have to be faster."
The next strand, cut, and the burning pain reached his wrist.
The fifth strand was cut and another part of the Ice melted.
The sixth strand was cut and the skin on two of his fingers was almost completely destroyed.
Resistance 725 made the damage reach the deeper tissue more slowly, but it did not stop it.
Lian continued without stopping and Selina suddenly convulsed inside the Cocoon for a moment, her head moved backward and the Black Veins on her chest became bright again.
"Hold on! There is no other way!"
He did not know if she could hear him or not, probably not, but it did not matter.
One of the thicker Root Strands had entered through the back of her shoulder, Lian grabbed it with Glacial Reaper, this one resisted.
Ice formed over it but the Root contracted and the Black Energy moved back into Lian’s hand, causing the skin on his wrist to immediately start melting.
Vorhelm frowned and put more Power into the claw!
CRACK!
The strand broke and Selina took a very short breath, the first clear sign of a living reaction.
Lian cut the next strand, and then the next.
The number of Root Strands connected to her body became smaller and at the same time the Demon Core became more and more black.
The veins on Selina also became fewer and the last strand was passing through the back of her neck.
He put his injured hand over it, the pain had moved from his fingers to his elbow and Glacial Reaper activated again.
Ice closed around the Root.
"The last one."
He pushed and the Root resisted for a moment.
Then—
It broke!
At that moment, almost all of the Black Veins on Selina’s body disappeared and Lian wrapped his healthier arm around her waist.
He pulled her, the Cocoon resisted for a moment, the cut Root Strands moved toward her body like living strings.
Lian pushed them away with Glacial Reaper, pulled again, and the girl came out of the inside of the Cocoon.
Both of them lost their balance and fell onto the ground, he ignored the pain in his hands and immediately put two relatively healthy fingers on Selina’s neck.
One second.
A heartbeat.
Then again.
Regular.
Weak, but regular, thankfully the girl was completely alive, he was not sure if she was unharmed but at least she was alive.
"Good." Lian let out a breath of relief, if he could get her away from the Cocoon now, the remaining injuries could probably be treated later.
But a sharp sound came from inside the Cocoon.
CRACK.
Lian immediately turned his head.
The Demon-Rank Core.
A crack had appeared on its surface, then a second crack, the black veins had almost filled the entire inside of the Core.
[Warning.]
[Temporary Vessel Integrity: 31%]
The number immediately dropped.
Lian frowned, he had expected the Core to last longer.
But when he thought about it, it made sense, Monster Cores did not have unlimited capacity, the reason some powerful Monsters created several Cores after Evolution was exactly this.
One Core could store a huge amount of Mana or Elemental Energy.
But after reaching a certain limit, the structure would break, higher-Rank Monsters sometimes increased their number instead of making one Core too large.
Two.
Four.
And more...
Each Core carried part of the body’s energy load, the Demon-Rank Core in front of him was one of the best Containers Lian had access to until now.
But Black Silence was not a normal Monster, it was a Calamity!
Even this Core had only been able to withstand part of its existence for a few dozen seconds, if the Core had been a lower Rank? It probably would have exploded at the very first moment.
Lian looked at Selina, then at his own hands, the skin on several fingers was completely damaged.
Black spots had reached his wrist, although Glacial Reaper and Resistance had stopped them from spreading further.
"If I had pulled you out directly..."
He did not finish the sentence, there was no need, both of them would probably have died before he could separate half of the Root Strands.
A movement in his other hand caught his attention, the Devourer Egg was still there.
"That was a good help."
The Egg immediately shook with clear pride.
"Don’t get too excited."
Lian opened his Inventory, before putting the Egg back inside, he paused for a moment.
"Thank you."
The Egg suddenly became silent, it did not move for one or two seconds and then gave a small shake, and Lian put it inside the Inventory.
He had never thought that one day he would thank an Egg...
Anyway, it was time to enter the Cocoon!

sentences.text: Lian held the Egg in front of the Cocoon.
A weak light appeared on the surface of the Egg.
The space around it started to bend.
"Three..."
Vorhelm’s eyes locked onto the Cocoon.
"Now."
The Egg’s energy was released immediately, a strange color between dark gold and black that seemed to pull the light into itself.
The space in front of the Cocoon changed shape for a moment and a small circle appeared on the shell.
Then... that part disappeared!
It did not break, burn, or melt, not even a Fragment fell onto the ground, instead, part of the Cocoon was removed so cleanly that it was as if it had never existed in the first place.
A circular hole appeared on the surface of the Cocoon, large enough for Lian to pass his hand and then his body through it.
But what really stopped him was how precise the result was.
The Root Strands, completely unharmed.
The black veins?
Untouched.
The energy membrane inside the Cocoon?
Still stable.
Even the Mana flow had not stopped for even a moment.
The System confirmed it.
[Localized Devouring Complete.]
[Gestation Structure Integrity: Stable.]
Lian looked at the Egg, and he was actually a little impressed.
"Not bad."
The Egg immediately started shaking with pride.
"Be proud later."
Then he picked up the Demon-Rank Core and immediately took it through the hole inside the Cocoon.
At first, nothing happened, the Core was placed a short distance away from Selina’s body.
Lian waited.
One second.
Two seconds.
Then—
THUMP!
The entire Cocoon shook.
The black veins that had been spread across Selina’s body and the Root Strands until that moment stopped at the same time.
Then their direction changed!
Like a group of snakes that had suddenly smelled fresh prey, the black veins moved back toward the Demon Core.
It was not that they immediately separated from Selina’s body, but the flow of energy had clearly changed.
[Foreign Energy Container Detected.]
[Calamity Gestation Pattern Altering.]
[Temporary Vessel Candidate Detected.]
Lian’s eyes lit up.
"I got you."
His guess had been correct, the Core was not a complete Vessel in the eyes of Black Silence.
It had no Soul, it had no proper connection to a World, but on an instinctive level it had something Selina did not.
Empty space, a capacity ready to accept energy, and also the Core of a Demon!
An extremely powerful and high-level being that was more valuable than Selina from every point of view.
For a few moments, that was enough for the Calamity to move its attention away from the main Host, the black veins on the girl’s neck started moving back.
Lian acted immediately, he put his right hand through the hole.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice formed over his fingers and palm, but this time he did not intend to Freeze Black Silence.
This layer was only for protection, a barrier between his skin and the Root Strands he had to cut.
The first strand was wrapped around Selina’s wrist, he grabbed it and closed the ice claw.
Cut.
At that moment, a strong pain spread through his fingers.
"Damn!
What is this?" Lian frowned, the skin under the Ice started smoking, at first he thought it was heat.
But it was not, his skin was being destroyed from the inside!
It was as if something was turning the structure of his cells into liquid.
[Warning.]
[Calamity Rejection Mechanism Activated.]
[Foreign Interference Detected.]
"Of course it’s not easy." Lian clenched his teeth.
He grabbed the second strand and cut it, the black effect moved from his fingertips to his palm.
A small part of his skin cracked and the tissue underneath became visible, he strengthened Glacial Reaper and Ice formed over the wound again.
But even the Ice started turning black, Black Silence was not destroying it immediately, instead, it was slowly spreading through the structure of the Ice like decay.
And Selina was not safe either, when the third strand was cut, her unconscious body suddenly shook and the black veins on her neck became brighter.
Not pure black but red and black!
The skin around them started turning red and then a very small amount of steam rose from it!
The System immediately gave a warning.
[Host Separation Detected.]
[Gestation Preservation Mechanism Activated.]
Lian’s expression became cold, this mechanism existed to prevent exactly this situation.
If someone tried to separate the Host during Gestation, the process would destroy both the Host and the one interfering with it.
Or it would cause enough damage to force them to stop, but this time Black Silence had another problem.
The Demon Core.
Every moment, more of the Calamity’s existence was being pulled toward it, the surface of the Core started turning black from the inside.
The old purple veins went out one after another and were replaced by dark matter.
At the same time, the burning lines on Selina’s body became a little weaker.
Lian understood, the more Black Silence focused on the temporary Vessel, the weaker the mechanism protecting the Host became.
"Then I have to be faster."
The next strand, cut, and the burning pain reached his wrist.
The fifth strand was cut and another part of the Ice melted.
The sixth strand was cut and the skin on two of his fingers was almost completely destroyed.
Resistance 725 made the damage reach the deeper tissue more slowly, but it did not stop it.

"Hold on!

Vorhelm frowned and put more Power into the claw!
CRACK!
The strand broke and Selina took a very short breath, the first clear sign of a living reaction.
Lian cut the next strand, and then the next.

Ice closed around the Root.

It broke!

One second.
A heartbeat.
Then again.
Regular.
Weak, but regular, thankfully the girl was completely alive, he was not sure if she was unharmed but at least she was alive.
"Good." Lian let out a breath of relief, if he could get her away from the Cocoon now, the remaining injuries could probably be treated later.

CRACK.

chapters.title: Chapter 345: Becoming The New Vessel ( Final )
paragraphs: The sound of the battle had gotten closer.
Seris was no longer holding back only three undead.
Five of them were around her, she was almost completely on the defensive, Moonless Severance blocked the path of one.
One of the Cindari caught her sword with his blade, the ancient Mage sent a wave of Mana from above.
The young Pendragon moved aside, the wave hit the ground and exploded the dirt, many wounds could be seen all over her body.
In fact, there was almost nothing else on her body except wounds, her entire skin had become covered in blood, her only remaining eye was lifeless and it was clear that she had reached her limit.
The only reason she had been able to last this long was the trump cards she had received from her family and they were all gone.
But she was still standing, her healthy eye moved toward Lian for a moment.
She saw Selina, outside the Cocoon, alive and a little of the pressure left her face.
But Lian did not give her time to look any longer, he placed Selina in a safer place, behind one of the thick Roots.
Then he returned to the Cocoon, the hole created by the Devourer Egg was closing.
The white Roots were moving from the edges toward the center.
[Temporary Vessel Integrity: 9%]
He let out a short sigh and opened the Quest.
[Evolution Quest]
[Current Evolution: Dormant Monster]
[Next Evolution: Fallen Monster]
[Devour The Black Silence.]
His eyes moved between the Quest and the Cocoon.
"If it wasn’t for this damn Quest, I would just destroy this whole thing right now."
Unfortunately, right now he had no choice except to devour this Calamity so he could evolve, but if this stupid Evolution Quest did not exist, he could simply destroy the Cocoon.
Selina had been saved and there was no need to worry about her, so the only problem was the Cocoon and maybe everything would be solved by destroying it.
But after thinking about it again, he shook his head, even that did not guarantee that the problem would be solved.
If he exploded the Cocoon and the Demon Core also broke, where would Black Silence go?
Into the surroundings? To Titan? Or would it return directly to Selina?
He did not know, the only thing he had was a path, a very dangerous and stupid path but it was a path anyway.
Lian looked at the crack in the Cocoon.
[Temporary Vessel Integrity: 6%]
He had no time, he looked at Seris one more time.
She was kneeling in front of one of the Cindari, the enemy’s sword passed over her head, the young girl turned her body, appeared behind him and struck the back of his Armor with King’s Breaker.
But the undead only moved two steps back, two others came closer, suddenly One attacked them with its tentacles to take their attention away from the young Pendragon.
Then he entered the Cocoon.
[Temporary Vessel Integrity: 4%]
First one leg, then his shoulder and then his entire body, the inside of the Cocoon was warmer than he expected.
Of course, it was not the heat of fire but the heat of something alive, the released Root Strands were moving around him.
The black material inside the Demon Core was spinning like a living liquid.
Lian fully entered and at that moment--
CRACK!
The Core broke.
There was no large explosion, the shell of the Demon-Rank Core cracked from the inside.
Then it broke into pieces and the black material trapped inside it was released into the space of the Cocoon, like a cloud of dark liquid, or a shadow that had taken a physical form.
The hole behind Vorhelm closed at the same moment, the Roots came together, the shell became complete again and the light from outside disappeared.
Lian was left alone inside the Cocoon.
For a moment, Black Silence did not move, the dark existence was floating in front of him, for the first time he was able to look at a Calamity.
It felt strange, he felt like he was looking at something higher than and beyond the understanding of humans and all mankind, something that was above every concept and form of life.
But it was evil, dark and dangerous, something whose only goal was destruction, killing and chaos.
Without eyes, without a face, without a fixed form.
But Lian felt that he was being seen, of course, not with eyes but with something much deeper, as if his Soul, existence and deepest parts were being looked at.
[Calamity Entity Has Detected a New Vessel Candidate.]
[Compatibility Analysis Initiated.]
"Whatever you’re going to do, do it quickly."
[Compatibility Exceeds Previous Host.]
[Compatibility Exceeds Temporary Vessel.]
It was natural, the Demon Core was only a Container, but the next panels were no longer normal.
[Abnormal Potential Detected.]
[Abnormal Soul Structure Detected.]
[Monster Class Detected.]
[Unknown Devouring Attribute Detected.]
[Unknown Artifact Detected Deep Within the Entity.]
Lian stopped for a moment at the last line.
Glutton.
Black Silence had sensed something inside his Class, but it could not identify exactly what it was and then a larger panel appeared.
[The Black Silence Has Shown Extreme Interest in You.]
"...Seriously?" Lian looked at it for a few seconds, well, he did not expect to suddenly become the Calamity’s favorite ... he only hoped it was not something bad.
Its answer came immediately and all the black material moved at once.

Not slowly, not like when it had moved into the Demon Core and not like a wave when it had moved into Selina, but as if something that had only been curious until that moment had suddenly found much better food.
All of Black Silence rushed toward Lian, he did not even have time to breathe, the first strand entered the skin of his hand, the second entered his neck.
Then dozens.
Hundreds.
The pain was immediate, but it was not the pain of a wound, something entered his Mana Channels, something else entered his Bloodstream.
A cold pressure hit his Soul, the pain was deep inside his existence, a pain that shook his entire existence, a pain that wanted to tear his Soul apart!
Lian pressed his teeth together, a black strand entered his chest and then another, his vision became dark for a moment.
[Calamity Energy Has Entered the Host.]
[Foreign Conceptual Contamination Detected.]
[Mana Channels Under Attack.]
[Soul Contamination Detected.]
[Resistance Activated.]
The pain became stronger, much stronger! Stronger than what a human could endure! Black Silence was not only taking over his body.
It was touching every part that made Lian "Lian".
Blood, Mana, Soul, Class, consciousness and even something deep inside his mind, but before his consciousness completely broke down, he understood one more thing.
Selina was the first choice because she came from Earth, she was a suitable Anchor.
But when several Candidates were available to Black Silence, the Calamity was not satisfied with the first Vessel.
It chose the best one.
The Demon Core was more attractive than Selina as a Container.
But Lian?
More Power.
More Potential.
An abnormal Soul Structure.
Monster Class.
And something inside him that even the Calamity could not identify and that he himself did not know about.
"My guess was right ... so whoever has more potential..."
A very weak smile appeared on Lian’s face.
Black veins moved from his neck toward his face and his vision became almost completely black.
"...is more attractive to you."
[Calamity Vessel Replacement Initiated.]
[Previous Host: Selina]
[New Host: Lian Vorhelm]
[Anchor Compatibility Confirmed.]
[Gestation Process Reconstructing...]
And then ... Lian’s consciousness went dark.

chapters.title: Chapter 346: Surrounded On All Sides II
paragraphs: The wind passed between the half-burned towers of Vhalaris and moved the temporary flags on the walls of Ashfall.

On the surface, the city was still standing, the Bridges had not completely fallen yet, the temporary Barriers were still active, and the Watchtowers that had been quickly repaired during the past few hours still had guards.
But Rindo knew very well from the top of the eastern wall that this appearance was nothing more than a very thin shell, Ashfall was no longer just an occupied area in Vhalaris.
It had become an island, and around it, a sea of Cindari had formed.
Ever since they had seen the siege, they had understood that the situation was much worse than they had expected.

They had thought about different scenarios and prepared strategies for each one, the possibility that all the armies would attack them at the same time was one of them, they just did not expect something like this to actually happen.
This was not a situation they wanted to be in at all, among all the scenarios, this was the worst one! A real damn nightmare.
The Student Council President sighed, and suddenly the sound of fast footsteps came from behind him, one of the Awakened almost ran to reach the top of the wall.
His breathing was fast, and part of his clothes was covered in mud and dirt.
"The North Route is closed."
"How many Cindari?" Rindo did not take his eyes off the east.
"We don’t know exactly yet, but there are a lot, we saw the flag of Ashenreach."
Cassian, who was standing a few steps beside Rindo, frowned.
He had almost never stopped checking the Battlefield since the Cinderhold army appeared in the east.
"So the north is gone too."
"West?" Marcus stood with his arms crossed.
"It’s still open, but the direct path is not, several small units from Rootcrown have been seen around there." The sentence was simple, but its meaning was as heavy as the sound of a death sentence.
They had hoped that a few small areas would still be open, but unfortunately, it was a useless hope, almost all of their escape routes were also closed.
Ashfall was no longer a Fortress where they could retreat if their lines were broken.
There was no open Forest Route left, there was no safe Bridge to escape from.
If the defense broke, they had nowhere to go.
Rindo looked at the field in front of him again, from this height, he could see the structure of the Cinderhold army better.
Heavy Infantry in the front line, Mage Units farther behind, and several Siege Engines at a safe distance.
Large War Beasts with metal Armor attached to their bodies.
And behind all of them were lines of soldiers that were still entering the area from the horizon, compared to them, there were not many Humans inside Ashfall.
Their number could barely reach fifty, and most of them were not even close to Level 20.
Potions were limited and Mana Crystals were even more limited.
More importantly, they were inside a city whose original design was not made to defend against an attack from outside.
Rindo quickly reached the conclusion, if the Cindari started a full attack from three directions at the same time, there was no real Chance of winning.
Even a long defense was unlikely, so their goal should not be victory, only one thing mattered.
Time..
Lian’s words returned to his mind.
"Buy as much time as you can."
"Where is Maelor?" He took a calm breath and then said without taking his eyes off the army.
"Still in the prison cell, Kael and Tharos are also being kept separately from him."
"Don’t move any of them without my order and keep them alive." Then he pointed at one of the Officers.
"Send a message to the East Bridge, tell their Commander that their leaders are still alive."
"And then?" The Officer paused for a moment.
"Tell them we are willing to negotiate." Rindo said, the best way to buy time was negotiation.
Less than half an hour later, a small space for negotiations had been created on the largest eastern Bridge of Vhalaris.
The two sides stood several dozen meters away from each other, behind the Humans, two active Barriers were in place.
Behind the Cindari, a complete Formation of Guards was waiting.

Rindo had come forward himself, Marcus stood on his right and Seraphina on his left, while Cassian and several other Awakeners stood a little behind them, ready to respond if the negotiation turned into a fight at any moment.
From the Cindari side, a tall and broad-shouldered man stepped forward, his armor was made of black Steel and very thin golden lines could be seen on its surface.
He had a large two-handed sword on his back.
The System showed a short panel to several Humans who had the ability to see Levels.
[Race: Cindari]
[Level: 28]
Beside him, a woman wearing a white Rootcrown robe also moved forward, she seemed younger, but she had a calm and strong presence, and neither of them looked friendly.
The main Commander, Tavren, stopped a few meters before the center of the Bridge.
Rindo also stopped there, and for a few seconds, they only looked at each other.
"The conditions are simple." The Cindari Commander said calmly.
"Tell me."
"All Outsiders put down their weapons, Ashfall is evacuated immediately, Maelor Veyn, Kael Varun, Tharos Keln, and all Cindari Prisoners are released." Tavren continued without changing his tone.
He paused for a moment and then said the fourth condition.
"And all Outsiders will be handed over to Rootcrown for investigation."
Marcus said nothing and slightly looked at Rindo, Seraphina also frowned.
Rindo understood immediately, these people had not come to negotiate at all, they were only demanding unconditional surrender.
How stupid ... did they really think they were stupid enough to simply surrender like this?

sentences.text: The wind passed between the half-burned towers of Vhalaris and moved the temporary flags on the walls of Ashfall.

On the surface, the city was still standing, the Bridges had not completely fallen yet, the temporary Barriers were still active, and the Watchtowers that had been quickly repaired during the past few hours still had guards.
But Rindo knew very well from the top of the eastern wall that this appearance was nothing more than a very thin shell, Ashfall was no longer just an occupied area in Vhalaris.
It had become an island, and around it, a sea of Cindari had formed.
Ever since they had seen the siege, they had understood that the situation was much worse than they had expected.

They had thought about different scenarios and prepared strategies for each one, the possibility that all the armies would attack them at the same time was one of them, they just did not expect something like this to actually happen.
This was not a situation they wanted to be in at all, among all the scenarios, this was the worst one!
A real damn nightmare.
The Student Council President sighed, and suddenly the sound of fast footsteps came from behind him, one of the Awakened almost ran to reach the top of the wall.
His breathing was fast, and part of his clothes was covered in mud and dirt.
"The North Route is closed."
"How many Cindari?" Rindo did not take his eyes off the east.
"We don’t know exactly yet, but there are a lot, we saw the flag of Ashenreach."
Cassian, who was standing a few steps beside Rindo, frowned.
He had almost never stopped checking the Battlefield since the Cinderhold army appeared in the east.
"So the north is gone too."
"West?" Marcus stood with his arms crossed.
"It’s still open, but the direct path is not, several small units from Rootcrown have been seen around there." The sentence was simple, but its meaning was as heavy as the sound of a death sentence.
They had hoped that a few small areas would still be open, but unfortunately, it was a useless hope, almost all of their escape routes were also closed.
Ashfall was no longer a Fortress where they could retreat if their lines were broken.
There was no open Forest Route left, there was no safe Bridge to escape from.
If the defense broke, they had nowhere to go.
Rindo looked at the field in front of him again, from this height, he could see the structure of the Cinderhold army better.
Heavy Infantry in the front line, Mage Units farther behind, and several Siege Engines at a safe distance.
Large War Beasts with metal Armor attached to their bodies.
And behind all of them were lines of soldiers that were still entering the area from the horizon, compared to them, there were not many Humans inside Ashfall.
Their number could barely reach fifty, and most of them were not even close to Level 20.
Potions were limited and Mana Crystals were even more limited.
More importantly, they were inside a city whose original design was not made to defend against an attack from outside.
Rindo quickly reached the conclusion, if the Cindari started a full attack from three directions at the same time, there was no real Chance of winning.
Even a long defense was unlikely, so their goal should not be victory, only one thing mattered.
Time..
Lian’s words returned to his mind.
"Buy as much time as you can."
"Where is Maelor?" He took a calm breath and then said without taking his eyes off the army.
"Still in the prison cell, Kael and Tharos are also being kept separately from him."
"Don’t move any of them without my order and keep them alive." Then he pointed at one of the Officers.
"Send a message to the East Bridge, tell their Commander that their leaders are still alive."
"And then?" The Officer paused for a moment.
"Tell them we are willing to negotiate." Rindo said, the best way to buy time was negotiation.
Less than half an hour later, a small space for negotiations had been created on the largest eastern Bridge of Vhalaris.
The two sides stood several dozen meters away from each other, behind the Humans, two active Barriers were in place.
Behind the Cindari, a complete Formation of Guards was waiting.

Rindo had come forward himself, Marcus stood on his right and Seraphina on his left, while Cassian and several other Awakeners stood a little behind them, ready to respond if the negotiation turned into a fight at any moment.
From the Cindari side, a tall and broad-shouldered man stepped forward, his armor was made of black Steel and very thin golden lines could be seen on its surface.
He had a large two-handed sword on his back.
The System showed a short panel to several Humans who had the ability to see Levels.
