chapters.title: Chapter 347: Surrounded On All Sides III
paragraphs: "Council Head!" The young Awakened said with difficulty, unable to catch his breath.
Rindo turned around, and the Awakened did not even wait for permission.
"West Drain! Ashenreach Units are entering through the old channels!"
It became clear that while they were negotiating, the enemy forces had already started trying to infiltrate!
Silence fell over the Bridge, the Student Council President very calmly turned his head back toward Tavren.
There was no obvious anger on his face, but his voice became completely cold.
"So you never intended to negotiate from the beginning."
"We intended to make you surrender." Tavren did not deny it either.
Rindo looked at him for several seconds, then turned around, there was nothing left to say.

They also did not really want to negotiate and their main goal had been to buy time, now that it was clear the enemy’s goal was also only to distract them and use the element of surprise, there was no reason to waste more time.
"Cassian."
"I’m ready."
"Alert all Units and close the Bridges."
Marcus pulled out his sword, Seraphina gathered Mana in her hand.
Tavren also took a step back.
"Then war." Rindo said before passing through the Barrier for the last time.
"You chose this yourselves."
"No, you chose to hurry and make a deadly decision."
The first Horn sounded less than a minute later in the east, and Vhalaris exploded.
Not in the literal sense at that exact moment, but it felt like it, hundreds of Cindari moved at the same time.
Shield Units moved forward, Archers took Formation, and Mages prepared their Spells.
The Siege Engines changed their angles, and all across Ashfall, the Humans also moved into their prepared positions.
Rindo had not designed this defense to hold the city forever, such a thing was impossible.
Ashfall had been divided into three Layers, each Layer had only one goal.
Slow them down.
Layer One—
The Bridges.
The East Bridge was the first place where the clash happened, Cindari Shield Units moved forward in a tight Formation.
The Steel shields were connected edge to edge, and Spearmen moved behind them.
Archers fired from behind, and the first rain of arrows came toward the Humans.
"Barrier!"
Three Awakened Mages raised their hands at the same time, a blue Mana wall formed in front of the Bridge.
Dozens of Arrows hit it, waves of light spread across the surface of the Barrier.
But it did not break.
The Humans’ Ballistas answered, two heavy Projectiles hit the Formation.
The first shield cracked.
The second threw several Cindari backward, but the Formation continued.
"Not yet." Rindo watched from the eastern position, his eyes were cold, he was truly angry and it was clear that he had put aside all of his kindness.
He knew there was no place for kindness in the current situation, if he showed mercy, they would be the ones who died.
"They’re entering the second Range." Marcus said coldly.
"I see."
The Cindari moved farther forward, ten meters ... twenty meters ... and the Formation became tighter.
Exactly what Rindo wanted, one of the Cindari Commanders shouted and the front line increased its speed.
And he raised his hand, waiting.
One second.
Two.
Three.
Then he lowered it.
The explosive traps under the Bridge activated, first red lines, then white.
Then—
Explosion!
The middle of the Bridge cracked from below like the stomach of a huge creature, stone and iron were thrown into the air, dozens of Cindari lost their balance.
The tight Formation that was their advantage became a weakness in an instant.
The people in the back fell onto the ones in front, some fell into the gap, and several Shield Units fell from the Bridge.
The Humans’ Archers fired at the same moment, Mages focused their Fire and Wind Spells on the broken area.
For several seconds, the Cindari were completely stopped.
"Finally, something good." Cassian, who was standing beside one of the Barricades, said with a short smile.
They knew they had no chance in a direct fight, that was why they had filled the entire city with traps, each trap was supposed to cause huge losses to the enemy.
"This is only the first wave." Rindo did not even look at him and did not become happy immediately, victory was not going to be easy ... if victory was even possible.
And exactly as he had said, the second wave came.
This time, the Cindari did not use the main Bridge, two side routes became active.
At the same time, a report came that Ashenreach forces had entered the outer part of Ashfall through the West Drain.
"Hold Layer One, no one should chase Kill Count, retreat in two minutes." He raised the Communication Crystal.
"We’re still holding them!" A voice came from the Crystal.
"You’re not here to hold the Bridge, you’re here to buy time, two minutes and then retreat!"
When the Cindari entered the streets of Ashfall, they thought the first line of defense had been broken.
The Humans had intentionally retreated, a large part of the Streets was empty and the first Barricades had been abandoned, some buildings even had their doors open.
The Cindari entered, and exactly there, Layer Two began.
The first Shield Unit entered a narrow street with tall buildings on both sides, there was no Human in front of them.
The Commander pointed forward, the Unit entered.
Ten people.
Twenty.
Thirty.
"Don’t close the line!" Marcus’s voice came from one of the buildings above.
One of the Awakeners who was waiting behind a temporary Barrier looked at him in surprise.
"Let them come inside." Marcus repeated.
The Cindari moved forward, when almost the entire Unit was inside the Kill Zone, Marcus lowered his hand.
"Now!"
The Barrier behind the Cindari closed, at the same time, another Barrier rose in front of them.
The Shield Unit was trapped between two Mana walls, the windows on both sides of the street opened.
Archers appeared, Mages aimed down from the Roof, and Awakeners entered from the Side Alleys.
Marcus jumped down from the second floor, landing directly on the first Cindari, his attack pushed the man’s shield down and with his second punch, he hit him into the soldier behind him.
"Don’t move forward!" One of the Awakeners wanted to chase the retreating enemy.
"This is our Kill Zone, not theirs! If you move forward, you will put yourselves in danger!" Their advantage was the environment and the traps they had prepared.

Most of the normal Cindari soldiers were around the same Level as them, and only the Commander of each Unit reached Level 20 or slightly higher, so in this way, they had neither an advantage nor a weakness.
The only difference was the number of soldiers, which was a major weakness for them, and even that would not be a problem as long as they were fighting inside areas filled with traps.
A Fire Spell exploded from the top of the building and landed on the Formation, the Cindari were put under heavy pressure for several moments.
But things were not going as well in the southern part.
Ethan let the blade of a Spear pass within a few centimeters of his face.
He stepped inside, grabbed the Cindari’s arm, turned his body, and pushed his own sword under the enemy’s side.
The man fell to the ground.
A young Awakener was breathing heavily behind Ethan.
"Be careful, you’re fighting Awakened creatures, they can use tricks too."
"I know." The young Awakened nodded.
Suddenly, a green Projectile passed beside Ethan.
The young Awakener reacted too late, the explosion threw him against the wall.
"Damn it!" Ethan turned around and reached him, the man was still alive, but blood was coming from his shoulder.
He grabbed the man’s arm and pulled him behind the Barricade, this time, he did not make any jokes.
"Healer!"
In the north of Ashfall, the situation suddenly became worse.
Rindo’s Communication Crystal shook.
"North Street Breach!"
"Location?"
"Third Root Avenue!"
"Liana." Rindo activated the second Crystal.
"I’m listening." The sound of fast breathing came from the other side.
"North Street!"
"I’m going! Damn it! How many people do you think I am? I have limits too!" The girl complained, but followed the order.
A few seconds later, the Shadow Wolf jumped from the roof of one of the buildings, Liana was leaning over its back.
The Wolf landed on the next roof and jumped again.
The distance that a normal Awakener would need one minute to cross was passed in only a few seconds.
When they reached Third Root Avenue, the Cindari Captain had just pushed aside the half-broken Barrier.
Liana jumped off the Shadow Wolf.
The Captain did not even have time to turn around completely, the attack passed beside his neck and blood splashed across the wall.
But two more Elites immediately entered the street.
One was Level 16 and the other was Level 19.
Liana landed and the Shadow Wolf growled beside her, and they quickly understood that this Breach would not end with only one Captain.
For some time, Rindo’s strategy worked, every street had a Trap, every building had a Firing Position.
Every retreat followed a prepared route, and the Cindari suffered more losses in Layer Two than they had expected.
But a real army did not repeat the same mistake for long.
Tavren Korr understood the Pattern very quickly, the orders changed.
The tight Formations were broken and the Mages moved forward, placing their hands on the ground.
The roots under the streets began to move.
The hidden Barrier Nodes were destroyed one after another from below.
On East Street, the ground under one of the Reinforced buildings rose, the main pillar broke, and the building leaned to one side.
The Archers on the Roof were forced to jump.
At the same time, other Units stopped moving through the marked streets, they went directly through the walls of the buildings.
A Cindari Soldier came out from inside a wall with his huge Shield and surprised five Awakeners.
At the same time, other Units arrived from above, they were moving across the roofs!
The Archers who had a Safe Position until that moment suddenly found themselves in Melee.
Cassian watched the Battlefield from the top of one of the middle towers.
"They’re changing the Pattern." He raised a Communication Crystal and immediately gave a warning!
"I know." Rindo answered immediately, he knew the enemy was not stupid and sooner or later they would understand the Pattern and find a way through.
"Abandon Layer Two." He sighed and added.
"Now? Is it really necessary? We’re still holding it."
"In five more minutes, both you and Layer Two will fall." The Student Council President warned.
"Ah ... Understood."
"Everyone to Inner Ashfall, no one stays behind to take corpses or Equipment." Rindo continued.

This order was bitter for some people, but necessary, he preferred to abandon a Line that was still standing rather than have that same Layer be destroyed five minutes later along with the Awakened inside it under a multi-directional attack.
At least if they retreated now ... they could prevent more losses.
But in any case, the situation was not looking good.

Suddenly, a green Projectile passed beside Ethan.
The young Awakener reacted too late, the explosion threw him against the wall.
"Damn it!" Ethan turned around and reached him, the man was still alive, but blood was coming from his shoulder.
He grabbed the man’s arm and pulled him behind the Barricade, this time, he did not make any jokes.
"Healer!"
In the north of Ashfall, the situation suddenly became worse.
Rindo’s Communication Crystal shook.
"North Street Breach!"
"Location?"
"Third Root Avenue!"
"Liana." Rindo activated the second Crystal.
"I’m listening." The sound of fast breathing came from the other side.
"North Street!"
"I’m going!
Damn it!
How many people do you think I am?
I have limits too!" The girl complained, but followed the order.
A few seconds later, the Shadow Wolf jumped from the roof of one of the buildings, Liana was leaning over its back.
The Wolf landed on the next roof and jumped again.
The distance that a normal Awakener would need one minute to cross was passed in only a few seconds.
When they reached Third Root Avenue, the Cindari Captain had just pushed aside the half-broken Barrier.
Liana jumped off the Shadow Wolf.
The Captain did not even have time to turn around completely, the attack passed beside his neck and blood splashed across the wall.
But two more Elites immediately entered the street.
One was Level 16 and the other was Level 19.
Liana landed and the Shadow Wolf growled beside her, and they quickly understood that this Breach would not end with only one Captain.
For some time, Rindo’s strategy worked, every street had a Trap, every building had a Firing Position.
Every retreat followed a prepared route, and the Cindari suffered more losses in Layer Two than they had expected.
But a real army did not repeat the same mistake for long.
Tavren Korr understood the Pattern very quickly, the orders changed.
The tight Formations were broken and the Mages moved forward, placing their hands on the ground.
The roots under the streets began to move.
The hidden Barrier Nodes were destroyed one after another from below.
On East Street, the ground under one of the Reinforced buildings rose, the main pillar broke, and the building leaned to one side.
The Archers on the Roof were forced to jump.
At the same time, other Units stopped moving through the marked streets, they went directly through the walls of the buildings.
A Cindari Soldier came out from inside a wall with his huge Shield and surprised five Awakeners.
At the same time, other Units arrived from above, they were moving across the roofs!
The Archers who had a Safe Position until that moment suddenly found themselves in Melee.
Cassian watched the Battlefield from the top of one of the middle towers.
"They’re changing the Pattern." He raised a Communication Crystal and immediately gave a warning!
"I know." Rindo answered immediately, he knew the enemy was not stupid and sooner or later they would understand the Pattern and find a way through.
"Abandon Layer Two." He sighed and added.
"Now?
Is it really necessary?
We’re still holding it."
"In five more minutes, both you and Layer Two will fall." The Student Council President warned.
Understood."
"Everyone to Inner Ashfall, no one stays behind to take corpses or Equipment." Rindo continued.

This order was bitter for some people, but necessary, he preferred to abandon a Line that was still standing rather than have that same Layer be destroyed five minutes later along with the Awakened inside it under a multi-directional attack.
At least if they retreated now ... they could prevent more losses.
But in any case, the situation was not looking good.

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Surrounded On All Sides IV
paragraphs: With the situation as it was, there was no other choice, and everyone retreated to Layer Three.
Layer Three was smaller, much smaller, only a few central streets of Ashfall, two Plazas, three Reinforced Buildings, and one main Healing Station.
And the underground Bunker where the Prisoners had been moved, there was not much Terrain left for them to retreat to.
They were slowly reaching the limit of how much they could use the traps, cause heavy losses, and then retreat.
Unfortunately, this plan no longer worked.

Rindo himself stood in the middle of the Plaza, all the Unit Leaders were around him, some were injured, some had less than half of their Mana, no one was in good condition, and things were only getting worse.
"Listen."
The sounds of the Battlefield came from a distance, the Cindari were still advancing,
"Nobody try to be a Hero, if the line breaks, retreat, if your friend falls and you can save them without dying, do it." A moment later, his tone became colder.
"But if two of you have to die to save one person, leave them."
"What?" one of the young Awakeners immediately said.
"Isn’t that too cruel?"
"Wouldn’t it be better to save them? Especially since we don’t have enough people?"
"If both of you die, nobody gets saved, this war isn’t about becoming a Hero, it’s about staying alive." Rindo answered seriously.
No one objected anymore and everyone sighed in silence, the Student Council President they were looking at was very different from the person he had been only a short while ago.
It was as if his personality had completely changed ... or maybe he had simply understood that there was no place for mistakes and kindness in this situation.
The battle started again, and this time it was bloodier.
The central streets of Ashfall turned into something that no longer looked like a residential area within a few minutes.
A Root Spear passed through the Barrier and pierced the chest of an Archer on the Tower.
His body stayed on the spear for a moment and then fell down.
Another Mage used so much Mana to keep the Barrier up that his knees finally bent, blood came from his nose, and then he fainted.
Two people pulled him back, inside the Healing Station, a female Healer stood between two injured Awakeners.
One had his stomach cut open and the other’s Mana Channels were burned, there was only one Recovery Potion left.
Her hand shook for a few seconds and then she made her decision, she gave the Potion to the one who had a better chance of returning to the battle.
She kept the other alive with normal Healing Magic, no one said anything about her choice, because they knew every choice had a heavy price.
So in the end, they had to make the best choice.
On the eastern street, a Cindari Soldier broke the Barricade with one strike, five Humans were thrown backward.
Marcus entered with an injured shoulder, his first strike knocked the Shield down but his right arm felt a sharp pain after the impact.

One of the Cindari attacked from the side with a Slash and he barely managed to move away, although the blade cut through his shoulder and blood spilled onto his clothes, he still turned around and broke the enemy’s knee with his foot.
The battle was no longer clean.
Nobody was using beautiful Skills for show, anything that made the enemy move forward one second later was valuable.
Almost one hour later, Cassian made his way to the command center, part of his face was covered in blood, part of his Armor was broken.
Rindo understood that he did not have good news the moment he saw him.
"North Line has fallen." And yes ... the news was not good at all.
"How far did they retreat?"
"Two streets."
"South?" Rindo asked after thinking for a moment.
"Ethan." Rindo activated the Crystal, he had no information about the situation in the south and needed to contact the Commander of that Unit.
"We’re still here." A voice full of heavy breathing came from the other side.
At that moment, a large explosion could be heard through the Crystal, followed by a short silence.
"I’ll correct that...we won’t be here for long." Ethan said again and then cut the Communication Crystal.
Silence returned, the Student Council President looked at the ground in silence, as if he was thinking, but even he did not know what he was thinking about.
What could he even do? All the lines were falling, and at the same time Marcus arrived, his right arm was no longer moving properly.
"We completely lost East Bridge." And he gave them another terrible piece of news.
Rindo looked at the temporary map of Ashfall, the sections of Layer One had been crossed out.
Layer Two was almost completely lost, and now even the Outer Section of Layer Three had been broken in several places.
Only Inner Ashfall remained, the most central and most important fortress they had left, the place where if they lost it, they would practically lose this war.
And with this situation, it would not take long for the battle lines to reach here too.
Seraphina returned from the Reserve Position, the Mana around her hand was weaker, but her eyes once again went toward the distant east for a moment.
Toward the same path where Lian and Seris had gone ...
"Keep your focus here, for now we have to save ourselves." Rindo noticed.
"I know, but if he doesn’t come back, none of this matters."
"That’s why we have to stay alive until he returns." The Student Council President nodded.
Seraphina finally looked at him but gave no answer.
The Horn sounded, and for a moment the Cindari attacks became weaker, some Units moved back a few steps.
The Humans used the opportunity to move the wounded.
Then Tavren Korr’s amplified voice spread through the area.
"Outsiders."
Several Awakeners looked toward the East with exhaustion.
"Put down your weapons." The Commander’s voice could be heard through all the streets.
"This is your last chance."
Rindo climbed onto the central Barricade, there was fire around him, two bodies were lying beside the stairs and the wall behind him was broken.
"I told you, we have no problem handing over the city and leaving this place, but you blocked the roads." He then said calmly.
They had already considered escaping if the situation became too bad, and they had also built several secret paths, but the siege was arranged in a way that they had no chance to do that.
And these bastards did not want to let them escape either, they wanted to capture them.
They could have escaped earlier, but would the final result have been any different? Where could they run to? They had a Quest that they had to complete.
The Giant Forest was so dangerous that they would be killed as soon as they entered, and going to Glassthorn Forest was not easy either, they would be surrounded before they could reach it.

"Your time is over, I told you that you only had twenty minutes to surrender, but you didn’t listen, this is your last chance to surrender." Tavren stood in the distance, behind the Cinderhold Formation, and said calmly.
"We are not going to surrender." Rindo said calmly.
"And now you have lost your last chance too." The Horn sounded again, this time louder, and the Assault started again.
The Awakeners understood that they could no longer hold all of Inner Ashfall.
Every street they held meant losing more people, and now the important number was no longer Territory, it was Minutes.
So they activated the last big Trap.
"All Units in Sector Four retreat!." Rindo picked up the Communication Crystal.
"Sector Four?" Marcus, who was beside him, immediately understood.
"Yes."
"There are still buildings there." Marcus looked toward the west, three streets, several large buildings.
"They have been evacuated."
"Everyone retreat." Rindo said loudly again through the Communication Crystal and then waited.
The Cindari thought the Humans had finally broken, hundreds of them entered Sector Four.
Heavy Infantry in front, Mages behind them, Root Units among them, and when the last group had almost completely entered the area—
"Blow it up!" Rindo said.
The explosives hidden under the main paths activated, for a moment the entire street was covered with red lines.
Then the ground collapsed!
Three large buildings fell toward the center of the street at the same time, the paths collapsed and hundreds of meters of the road were blocked by stone, iron, and debris.
The dust reached the central Plaza, many Cindari were trapped under the rubble and the rest were forced to retreat.
For several minutes, the western path was practically blocked, but the price was clear.
Ashfall became even smaller, there was no way back to Sector Four anymore.
Every Layer that Rindo burned only bought them a few minutes.

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Surrounded On All Sides ( Final )
paragraphs: Time passed.
The battle passed one hour ... then another hour, and the gray light of the Realm slowly changed.
Nobody knew exactly how many hours they had been fighting, only their bodies knew.
Cassian had a deep cut on his side.
Marcus could no longer raise his right arm completely.
Ethan was covered in blood from head to toe, although a large part of the blood was not his own.
Liana was breathing heavily, Shadow Wolf was wounded on its side and one of its back legs was limping when it moved.
Seraphina had used a large part of her Mana.
Even Rindo was no longer only giving orders, when one of the Cindari Captains passed through the Inner Barrier, he entered the battle himself.
His first strike pushed Rindo back, the second broke his personal Barrier and the Student Council President passed beside the third Slash and used his Skill directly on the man’s side.
It was not enough.
The Captain turned around.
But Marcus entered from the blind side, attacked with his healthy shoulder, and the man lost his balance.
Rindo took the chance and pushed his blade into a gap in the Armor.
The Captain fell to the ground and Marcus stood there for several seconds and sighed, all of them were reaching their limits.
Another Awakened messenger arrived, this one could barely stand on his feet.
"West Inner Barrier has fallen."
"Send Reserve." Rindo immediately said.
"We have no Reserve."
This time even the sounds of the Battlefield seemed far away for a moment, Rindo said nothing, the reality was so simple that it needed no explanation.
There was no Reserve left.
Every Awakener who could hold a sword, cast a Spell, or even keep a Barrier up was already on one of the lines.
The Healers had almost no Potions left and their defensive, offensive, and healing abilities had reached their limits.
If another Breach happened, there would be no fresh person to stop it.
"How much longer do we have to hold on? We can’t do this anymore!" Seraphina reached them, there was a thin line of blood beside her face.
"I don’t know." Rindo looked at her, how could he know?
"Lian told us to buy time, I hope he also knows how expensive we are paying for it." Marcus, who was leaning against the wall, took a short breath.
Nobody answered, because they were all thinking exactly the same thing.
Tavren Korr finally understood that the Humans had reached their end, and the order for the final Assault was given.
The Cinderhold Horns sounded at the same time.
Ashenreach Heavy Units moved forward.
Emberwell Mage Formations entered Range.
The Mages focused all the Mana they had left on breaking the last Barriers.
Rindo looked at the battle from a distance, some were barely standing, some were holding weapons that were already broken.
Some drank their last Potion at that moment.
No long Speech was needed, everyone knew the situation.
"There is no next line."
Several people raised their heads, deep inside, all of them knew that they might die here ...
Were they afraid...? Of course! How could they not be afraid? We were talking about life and death, and all these Awakeners were only young people with promising futures.

Every single one of them was afraid, Marcus, Cassian, Ethan, Liana, and even Seraphina were afraid, each of them was afraid because of the wishes, dreams, and future they could have had, but which could end today.
"This is it, if we break here, it’s over." Rindo pointed toward the central Barrier.
But in the end, nobody ran, there was nowhere to run, every part of the city was surrounded, by thousands of soldiers!
Mana rose, swords were ready.
The Barriers were strengthened one last time, the Mages prepared to use the last amount of Mana they had left.
...and the two sides finally reached each other!
The first Unit hit the Barrier, blue light spread in all directions and the Barrier shook.
The second strike.
Crack.
Marcus threw himself forward, Seraphina stopped two Cindari from the right.
Liana and Shadow Wolf entered from the north.
Ethan came out from under the rubble of a half-broken Barricade and fought again.
The Cindari entered like a wave, the Humans resisted like a wall that had already been cracked.
But the wall was breaking, a Heavy Soldier smashed the Barrier with the third strike and the explosion threw Marcus several meters backward.
His body hit the ground.
Ethan was buried under part of the wall, Seraphina was trapped between two more soldiers.
Rindo also entered the battle and charged directly toward the Cindari.
Everyone knew that this was the final battle, the final battle of this damned and unfair war, they would either resist until Lian could complete the mission or return.
Or all of them would be killed, or at best, captured.
There was no shortcut, there was no second path, there was no hope ... and everyone was fighting in despair.
After killing two Cindari, Seraphina looked into the distance, toward the place where she had last seen Lian ...
Their only hope right now was that man ... but had he even reached the Tree? Could he complete the mission before all of them died...?
Even she was starting to lose hope in her childhood friend ...
And at that exact moment, the ground shook.
At first, it was weak, so weak that most people did not even notice, the Battlefield was already full of explosions, a normal earthquake would not make much difference.
But a few seconds later, the second shake came, and this time nobody could ignore it.
"What the hell is happening? What was that earthquake?"
All of Vhalaris shook. The entire fucking city shook!
The Towers shook, windows broke, the old Bridges made loud sounds, the huge trees that had been part of the city for centuries twisted like living creatures for the first time.
Even the Cindari stopped their attacks.
"What was that?" Rindo barely kept his balance and looked around.
Nobody had an answer, because everyone was looking for one.
Then the third shake passed through the ground, this time bigger, much bigger, and the problem was that only Vhalaris was not shaking.
In Emberroot, the huge trees bent almost at the same time, branches that were dozens of meters long hit each other.
Monsters hidden among the roots came out of their nests.
In Giant’s Forest, creatures that normally would not even leave their Territory when enemies appeared started running.
In Emberwell, the surface of the huge Reservoirs first began to wave, then water spilled over the stone edges.
In Ashenreach, the walls of several mines cracked.
The Miners ran out of the tunnels, in Rootcrown, very old Statues on the central Plazas shook.
On one of the Statues of Cindar Vael, a thin crack appeared from the neck to the chest.
In Giant’s Graveyard, huge chains that held the Corrupted Titan deep underground were pulled.
One of them moved several meters with a sound like a mountain breaking.
And in Glassthorn, all the glass and trees started shaking.
The entire small World was shaking!
Not like an Earthquake, an Earthquake came from the movement of the ground.
This came from something deeper, as if the structure of the World itself was being changed by the pressure of something.
"What the hell is happening?"
"Could this be the apocalypse?"
Then the shaking suddenly stopped, but calm did not return, something worse took its place.
Mana.
Seraphina was the first to notice, she unconsciously put her hand on her chest.
"This...
Her eyes moved around, all the Mana in the area was moving, not like a normal flow, not like when a powerful Mage activated a Skill, but it had a direction.
All the Mana in Vhalaris was being pulled toward a certain place ... toward the Forgotten Tree!
The Cindari Mages also felt it, several of them became completely still.
Even Tavren turned his head toward the east in the distance, for some reason, he felt a very bad feeling.
The sky changed, it did not become night, the light of the World itself became weaker, the gray color of the sky became darker for a few seconds.
In the distance, the sounds of Monsters rose.
Roars.
Howls.
Screams.
Fear.
Even the battle almost completely stopped, Humans and Cindari had felt the same thing.
The System appeared in front of every Awakener present.
[Warning.]
[Catastrophic World Event Detected.]
Several people stared at the panels and the next line appeared.
[Calamity Is Manifesting.]
[Origin Detected: Forgotten Tree.]
"Forgotten Tree..." Liana’s face changed immediately.
"Lian!" Seraphina said only one name.
Those who knew at least part of what was happening suddenly had countless guesses in their minds.
Everyone kept their eyes on the panel, but no other panel appeared.
Then ... a sound came ... not from the sky, not from underground, but from everywhere!
THUMP.
A sound like a Heartbeat, but so deep that it was not only heard, it was also felt in the bones.
All of Vhalaris became still for a moment, even the distant Monsters became silent, and a few seconds later—
THUMP.
The second time.
This time the Roots under the city shook with the beat, the black cracks that existed in some of the old parts of the ground lit up for a moment.
Black light...something that made no sense, but everyone saw it.
"What the hell are they doing?..." Rindo whispered in disbelief, God knew what Seris and Lian were doing that was causing these things to happen.
Cassian, whose face was covered in blood and dust, came closer by several steps.
And everyone looked into the distance, toward the direction where the Forgotten Tree was located very far away.
The battle had completely stopped.
Not because of a ceasefire or because of surrender, not because of any Commander’s order, but because every living creature in Vhalaris had felt the same thing.
Something in the distance was waking up.
Not a Monster, not even something that could be explained with a simple Level, something whose presence was enough to make the entire Realm shake.
Then the third beat came.
THUMP.
This time the sky above became completely black for a moment, as if part of the World had forgotten light for a fraction of a second.
And at that exact moment, the System finally showed one single message in front of all the Awakeners.
[Warning.]
[A Calamity Is Being Born.]
Rindo looked toward the Forgotten Tree without moving, nobody in Vhalaris knew what had happened there.
Nobody knew whether Lian was still alive or not, nobody knew whether the Main Quest was failing or something completely different was happening.
But everyone understood one thing, the thing they had fought to prevent from being born and the reason for all of this ... was being born at that exact moment.

Every Awakener who could hold a sword, cast a Spell, or even keep a Barrier up was already on one of the lines.
The Healers had almost no Potions left and their defensive, offensive, and healing abilities had reached their limits.
If another Breach happened, there would be no fresh person to stop it.
"How much longer do we have to hold on?
We can’t do this anymore!" Seraphina reached them, there was a thin line of blood beside her face.
"I don’t know." Rindo looked at her, how could he know?
"Lian told us to buy time, I hope he also knows how expensive we are paying for it." Marcus, who was leaning against the wall, took a short breath.
Nobody answered, because they were all thinking exactly the same thing.
Tavren Korr finally understood that the Humans had reached their end, and the order for the final Assault was given.
The Cinderhold Horns sounded at the same time.
Ashenreach Heavy Units moved forward.
Emberwell Mage Formations entered Range.
The Mages focused all the Mana they had left on breaking the last Barriers.
Rindo looked at the battle from a distance, some were barely standing, some were holding weapons that were already broken.
Some drank their last Potion at that moment.
No long Speech was needed, everyone knew the situation.
"There is no next line."
Several people raised their heads, deep inside, all of them knew that they might die here ...
Were they afraid...?
Of course!
How could they not be afraid?
We were talking about life and death, and all these Awakeners were only young people with promising futures.

Every single one of them was afraid, Marcus, Cassian, Ethan, Liana, and even Seraphina were afraid, each of them was afraid because of the wishes, dreams, and future they could have had, but which could end today.
"This is it, if we break here, it’s over." Rindo pointed toward the central Barrier.
But in the end, nobody ran, there was nowhere to run, every part of the city was surrounded, by thousands of soldiers!
Mana rose, swords were ready.
The Barriers were strengthened one last time, the Mages prepared to use the last amount of Mana they had left.
...and the two sides finally reached each other!
The first Unit hit the Barrier, blue light spread in all directions and the Barrier shook.
The second strike.
Crack.
Marcus threw himself forward, Seraphina stopped two Cindari from the right.
Liana and Shadow Wolf entered from the north.
Ethan came out from under the rubble of a half-broken Barricade and fought again.
The Cindari entered like a wave, the Humans resisted like a wall that had already been cracked.
But the wall was breaking, a Heavy Soldier smashed the Barrier with the third strike and the explosion threw Marcus several meters backward.
His body hit the ground.
Ethan was buried under part of the wall, Seraphina was trapped between two more soldiers.
Rindo also entered the battle and charged directly toward the Cindari.
Everyone knew that this was the final battle, the final battle of this damned and unfair war, they would either resist until Lian could complete the mission or return.
Or all of them would be killed, or at best, captured.
There was no shortcut, there was no second path, there was no hope ... and everyone was fighting in despair.
After killing two Cindari, Seraphina looked into the distance, toward the place where she had last seen Lian ...
Their only hope right now was that man ... but had he even reached the Tree?
Could he complete the mission before all of them died...?
Even she was starting to lose hope in her childhood friend ...
And at that exact moment, the ground shook.
At first, it was weak, so weak that most people did not even notice, the Battlefield was already full of explosions, a normal earthquake would not make much difference.
But a few seconds later, the second shake came, and this time nobody could ignore it.
"What the hell is happening?
What was that earthquake?"
All of Vhalaris shook.
The entire fucking city shook!
The Towers shook, windows broke, the old Bridges made loud sounds, the huge trees that had been part of the city for centuries twisted like living creatures for the first time.
Even the Cindari stopped their attacks.
"What was that?" Rindo barely kept his balance and looked around.
Nobody had an answer, because everyone was looking for one.
Then the third shake passed through the ground, this time bigger, much bigger, and the problem was that only Vhalaris was not shaking.
In Emberroot, the huge trees bent almost at the same time, branches that were dozens of meters long hit each other.
Monsters hidden among the roots came out of their nests.
In Giant’s Forest, creatures that normally would not even leave their Territory when enemies appeared started running.
In Emberwell, the surface of the huge Reservoirs first began to wave, then water spilled over the stone edges.
In Ashenreach, the walls of several mines cracked.
The Miners ran out of the tunnels, in Rootcrown, very old Statues on the central Plazas shook.
On one of the Statues of Cindar Vael, a thin crack appeared from the neck to the chest.
In Giant’s Graveyard, huge chains that held the Corrupted Titan deep underground were pulled.
One of them moved several meters with a sound like a mountain breaking.
And in Glassthorn, all the glass and trees started shaking.
The entire small World was shaking!
Not like an Earthquake, an Earthquake came from the movement of the ground.
This came from something deeper, as if the structure of the World itself was being changed by the pressure of something.
"What the hell is happening?"
"Could this be the apocalypse?"
Then the shaking suddenly stopped, but calm did not return, something worse took its place.
Mana.
Seraphina was the first to notice, she unconsciously put her hand on her chest.
"This...
Her eyes moved around, all the Mana in the area was moving, not like a normal flow, not like when a powerful Mage activated a Skill, but it had a direction.
All the Mana in Vhalaris was being pulled toward a certain place ... toward the Forgotten Tree!
The Cindari Mages also felt it, several of them became completely still.
Even Tavren turned his head toward the east in the distance, for some reason, he felt a very bad feeling.
The sky changed, it did not become night, the light of the World itself became weaker, the gray color of the sky became darker for a few seconds.
In the distance, the sounds of Monsters rose.
Roars.
Howls.
Screams.
Fear.
Even the battle almost completely stopped, Humans and Cindari had felt the same thing.
The System appeared in front of every Awakener present.
[Warning.]
[Catastrophic World Event Detected.]
Several people stared at the panels and the next line appeared.
[Calamity Is Manifesting.]
[Origin Detected: Forgotten Tree.]
"Forgotten Tree..." Liana’s face changed immediately.
"Lian!" Seraphina said only one name.
Those who knew at least part of what was happening suddenly had countless guesses in their minds.
Everyone kept their eyes on the panel, but no other panel appeared.
Then ... a sound came ... not from the sky, not from underground, but from everywhere!
THUMP.
A sound like a Heartbeat, but so deep that it was not only heard, it was also felt in the bones.
All of Vhalaris became still for a moment, even the distant Monsters became silent, and a few seconds later—
THUMP.
The second time.
This time the Roots under the city shook with the beat, the black cracks that existed in some of the old parts of the ground lit up for a moment.
Black light...something that made no sense, but everyone saw it.
"What the hell are they doing?..." Rindo whispered in disbelief, God knew what Seris and Lian were doing that was causing these things to happen.
Cassian, whose face was covered in blood and dust, came closer by several steps.
And everyone looked into the distance, toward the direction where the Forgotten Tree was located very far away.
The battle had completely stopped.
Not because of a ceasefire or because of surrender, not because of any Commander’s order, but because every living creature in Vhalaris had felt the same thing.
Something in the distance was waking up.
Not a Monster, not even something that could be explained with a simple Level, something whose presence was enough to make the entire Realm shake.
Then the third beat came.
THUMP.
This time the sky above became completely black for a moment, as if part of the World had forgotten light for a fraction of a second.
And at that exact moment, the System finally showed one single message in front of all the Awakeners.
[Warning.]
[A Calamity Is Being Born.]
Rindo looked toward the Forgotten Tree without moving, nobody in Vhalaris knew what had happened there.
Nobody knew whether Lian was still alive or not, nobody knew whether the Main Quest was failing or something completely different was happening.
But everyone understood one thing, the thing they had fought to prevent from being born and the reason for all of this ... was being born at that exact moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 350: The Young Pendragon I
paragraphs: Seris held her sword in front of her body.
There were five undead in front of her.
Four Ancient Cindari, each of whom alone was enough to turn this battle into a nightmare, and in the center of them stood a man whose name was connected to almost all of Cindari history.
Cindar Vael.
The Founder, someone who according to everything Seris knew until a few hours ago, should have been dead for centuries, or maybe even longer.
But now he was there.
In the sky, silent, and his dry eyes were not fixed on her, but on the Cocoon.
None of the five spoke, and she could not even hear the sound of their breathing.
Seris was not sure if they were even breathing.
This silence was more disturbing than any scream, behind Seris, Lian had gone toward the Cocoon, his last words were still in her mind.
"I won’t take long."
Now that she looked at the five creatures in front of her, she finally understood that answer might have been one of the stupidest things she had ever said in her life.
Her left eye could no longer see anything.
Not darkness, not shadow, not even light, it simply did not exist anymore.
The sharp pain from before had almost disappeared, replaced by a heavy pulse that every few seconds spread from the empty eye socket to her temple and half of her skull.
Her right thigh burned with every movement, the wound on her side pulled whenever she breathed, and her muscles were still shaking from the previous battle with Caelus.
And most of her Mana was gone, although she had managed to recover some of it, it was not enough, she opened her own panel and looked at it.
[Name: Seris]
[Race: Human]
[ Class : Warrior ]
[ Talent : God’s Sword ( SS ) ]
[Level: 20]
[Strength: 520]
[Spirit: 260]
[Speed: 540]
[Mana: 400]
[Resistance: 280]
[ Stat Points: 0]
[Total Stat Points: 2,000]
Seris stared at the last line for a few seconds, the corner of her blood-covered lips rose slightly, she did not like having a limit.
This meant that until she completed the Evolution Quest, she could not progress ... and completing that Quest ... she sighed, it was not easy.
She closed the panel, and raised her sword again, she had always considered herself strong.
Not in a way that made her think she was unbeatable, she was not stupid enough to ignore other people’s Levels or Talents.
But there was one simple fact, among people her age, there were very few who could actually defeat her in direct combat.
Seris had become used to this fact, to entering herself, killing the enemy herself, making her own decisions and leaving the battlefield herself.
But ever since Lian had entered her life, this annoying order had been broken more and more.
Several times she had been forced to trust his decisions, several times she had moved behind him, several times without knowing exactly what he was thinking, she had allowed him to choose the path.
And Seris did not like this feeling.
Not Lian, but what Lian had made her feel ... needing someone, trusting someone and sometimes being forced to accept that another person knew something she did not.
And worst of all, a few minutes ago, when Lian had seen her destroyed eye and blood-covered body and simply said "Be careful," Seris had actually wanted to listen to him.
To stay alive.
That part annoyed her the most.
"Since when did I become this stupid?"
She had no answer.
Maybe since that birthday ceremony in the Vorhelm family? Since the moment she was defeated by someone her own age for the first time ...?
Had that caused her to unconsciously develop these strange feelings... ? Or was there something else, something that even she did not know about yet ...?
Seris tightened her fingers around the handle.
It did not matter.
For now, she had only one goal.
None of these five could reach Lian.
Several thin metal leaves came out of her Storage.
Six leaves.
Each one was slightly smaller than her palm and made of green-gold metal, with very small Rune lines moving across their surface.
[Brand Leaves]
[ Rank : B ]

[ Description : A very rare consumable Artifact, each leaf can temporarily increase part of the user’s Mana, physical strength and Skill control, but after being activated, it burns and leaves heavy pressure on the body. ]
Seris looked at the six leaves.
Under normal conditions, even using two of them one after another was not a smart choice.
Now? Normal conditions had ended a long time ago.
She had received these things from her family so she could use them if she ever faced a dangerous situation, until now she had never had a chance where she needed them.
But against five creatures who were at least 15 Levels above her ... she had no choice.
She took one of the leaves between two fingers, Mana entered the Rune and the leaf began to burn.
Its metal surface turned into golden light and entered Seris’s arm like a thin thread.
A sudden pressure of Mana spread through her body, the muscles in her injured thigh tightened and the pain became stronger for a moment.
But then ... more power, faster, sharper and one of the undead finally moved.
The swordsman standing on the left side of Cindar attacked the girl with all his strength, wanting to destroy this annoying obstacle.
Seris activated her Skill at the same moment.
[Moonless Severance.]

Her sword came down diagonally, no Projectile appeared and the Attack Line remained hidden in space for a fraction of a second and then it was supposed to cut through the entire distance between her and the target.
But the undead moved his sword.
Not after the Slash appeared, but before it!
The edge of his blade stopped exactly where Moonless Severance should have appeared.
CLANG!
The space shook for a moment and the Attack Line broke!
"What...?" Seris’s healthy eye opened slightly wider.
It was the first time someone had read a Skill almost before it was fully created.
The undead disappeared, not with a teleport Skill but only with raw speed and the young Pendragon saw only a weak flash of metal.
She raised her sword.
CLANG!
The attack was so heavy that Seris’s fingers around the handle shook.
Her body left the ground, she was pushed ten meters back and the soles of her boots made lines in the dirt, her thigh wound opened again at the same moment.
Warm blood moved under her clothes.
"...Damn."
And still, only one of the five had actually attacked.
The second undead raised his hand, white roots came out from under the ground.
The third rose into the air, white ash gathered around his body.
The fourth had no weapon, a wide body, broken armor and gray skin.
And Cindar was still almost completely still.
"Very well." Seris took a short breath.
She activated the second Brand leaf, another light entered her body and at the same moment she released her next Skill.
[Swordheart Overdrive]
[ Rank : Holy ]
A Holy Skill! A Skill that even went beyond the Divine Rank.
Skills with this level of potential were extremely rare and obtaining them required a great amount of luck.
Even she had received this Skill as a gift from her father and had used all the Fragments she had collected during this time to raise it to this level.
Mana rushed into all Channels connected to her legs, arms, Reflex and Sword Control.
Seris’s body was artificially pushed beyond its natural capacity.
The System immediately gave a warning.
[Swordheart Overdrive Activated.]
[1000% Power Output Increased.]
[1000% Speed Increased.]
[1000% Reaction Speed Increased.]
[ Sword Attack Damage Increased By 100% ]
[Pain Suppression Activated.]
[Warning: Current Physical Condition Is Unsuitable.]
[Estimated Safe Duration: 21 Seconds.]
This Skill helped increase all of her overall abilities to the level of a Level 38 Awakener, it raised all her stats and attacks to that level.
"Enough." And she moved, for a moment only a line of light remained where she had been standing.
The Ancient Swordmaster attacked again but this time Seris saw the path, she turned her blade and the metals collided.
The young Pendragon passed beside the Blade.
[Thousand Petal Swordstorm.]
One Slash.
Dozens of Sword Aura.
The second.
Again, dozens.
In less than two seconds, hundreds of thin Blades filled the space in front of her.
The undead mage raised both hands, white and black roots created several layers of Barrier and the Sword Aura crashed into them.
The first layer broke, the second cracked but another Cindari also moved his hand forward and a huge wave of white ash and gray fire came down from the sky.
Seris lowered her body, rolled across the ground and a large part of the wave passed over her body, but the heat burned the back of her clothes.
Before she could stand up, another one of them came out through the same fire and punched her directly in the stomach.
The girl held her sword horizontally in front of her body, the attack hit the Blade and the force from the sword entered her hands and shoulders.
Her body was thrown again, blood came out of her mouth but even before she landed—
[Moonless Severance.]
The sword moved through the air, the hidden Slash appeared in front of the attacker with a delay and the undead brought his hands in front of his body.
The cutting line hit his forearm, the gray skin split open and a piece of dry flesh came out.
But the Cindari did not seem to feel the pain.
"Great." Seris landed on the ground, put her hand on the dirt and pushed herself up, then wiped the blood from the corner of her lips.
"You can’t even feel pain."
The roots suddenly came from both sides, the girl cut one, jumped over the second, the third wrapped around her injured ankle.
The pain reached her brain even with Pain Suppression and Seris turned in the air and brought her Blade down and the root was cut with force.
The Swordmaster used that moment, a Slash went directly toward her neck.
And the young Pendragon bent down and the edge of the sword cut a few strands of hair.
[King’s Breaker.]
The first attack hit the undead’s Blade, his sword shook.
And the second—
